examples.en: This patient lift is for assisted transfers.
examples.zh: 这款患者移位机用于辅助移乘。

examples.en: May I demonstrate the patient lift controls?
examples.zh: 我可以演示移位机的控制器吗？

examples.en: Please confirm bed clearance before selecting a patient lift for your facility.
examples.zh: 为贵机构选购移位机前，请确认床下净空。

examples.en: Our quotation lists the patient lift and its compatible sling separately.
examples.zh: 我们的报价单分别列出移位机及兼容吊带。

examples.en: If your distributor needs a patient lift demonstration, we can arrange a session covering the specified controls, compatible accessories, and documented operating limits.
examples.zh: 如果贵经销商需要移位机演示，我们可安排介绍规定控制方式、兼容配件及文件载明使用限制的演示。

examples.en: This powered patient lift uses an electric actuator.
examples.zh: 这款电动移位机采用电动推杆。

examples.en: Please check the powered patient lift battery.
examples.zh: 请检查电动移位机电池。

examples.en: We will confirm the powered patient lift configuration before preparing your quotation.
examples.zh: 我们将在准备报价前确认电动移位机配置。

examples.en: The inspection checklist includes the powered patient lift controls and warning labels.
examples.zh: 检验表涵盖电动移位机控制器及警示标签。

examples.en: Before approving the powered patient lift sample, please review the lifting controls and emergency procedures against the instructions supplied for that exact configuration.
examples.zh: 批准电动移位机样品前，请根据该具体配置的说明书核对升降控制和应急操作程序。

examples.en: This sling matches the specified patient lift.
examples.zh: 这条吊带与指定移位机匹配。

examples.en: Which sling size does your customer require?
examples.zh: 贵客户需要哪种尺寸的吊带？

examples.en: Please photograph the sling label when reporting a patient lift accessory issue.
examples.zh: 反馈移位机配件问题时，请拍摄吊带标签。

examples.en: We check sling attachment details against the approved patient lift specification.
examples.zh: 我们按已批准的移位机规格检查吊带连接细节。

examples.en: If you request a different sling for the patient lift, we must confirm compatibility and intended use before including it in the revised offer.
examples.zh: 如果您要求移位机改配其他吊带，我们必须先确认兼容性和预期用途，再将其列入修改后的报价。

examples.en: The spreader bar supports the lift sling.
examples.zh: 移位机吊架用于承托吊带。

examples.en: Please inspect this patient lift spreader bar.
examples.zh: 请检查这台移位机的吊架。

examples.en: The spreader bar attachment points must match the specified patient lift sling.
examples.zh: 吊架连接点必须与指定移位机吊带匹配。

examples.en: Our engineer needs clear photographs of the spreader bar before reviewing your complaint.
examples.zh: 工程师需要吊架清晰照片，才能评估您的投诉。

examples.en: When comparing patient lift quotations, check whether each spreader bar supports the proposed sling arrangement, because similar-looking attachments may have different compatibility requirements.
examples.zh: 比较移位机报价时，请检查各吊架是否支持拟用吊带方案，因为外观相似的连接件可能有不同兼容要求。

examples.en: The actuator raises the home care bed.
examples.zh: 电动推杆用于升起护理床。

examples.en: Which actuator model does this patient lift use?
examples.zh: 这台移位机采用哪款电动推杆？

examples.en: Please send the actuator label and nursing bed model in your email.
examples.zh: 请在邮件中发送推杆标签及护理床型号。

examples.en: Assembly staff verify actuator connectors against the approved hospital bed wiring diagram.
examples.zh: 装配人员按批准的病床接线图核对推杆连接器。

examples.en: If the actuator supplier proposes a replacement for the care bed, engineering must review its mounting dimensions and electrical compatibility before purchasing approves the change.
examples.zh: 若供应商建议护理床更换推杆，采购批准变更前，工程部门必须评审安装尺寸及电气兼容性。

examples.en: This patient lift has an adjustable base.
examples.zh: 这台移位机配有可调底座。

examples.en: Let me demonstrate the adjustable base movement.
examples.zh: 我来演示可调底座的动作。

examples.en: Please measure chair access before selecting the patient lift adjustable base configuration.
examples.zh: 选择移位机可调底座配置前，请测量轮椅接近空间。

examples.en: Our inspection report records the adjustable base movement under the specified test conditions.
examples.zh: 检验报告记录了规定测试条件下可调底座的动作。

examples.en: Before confirming the patient lift order, we should check whether the adjustable base dimensions suit your beds and chairs under the documented operating conditions.
examples.zh: 确认移位机订单前，应核对可调底座尺寸在文件规定使用条件下是否适合贵方床具和座椅。

examples.en: Please check the patient lift safe working load.
examples.zh: 请检查移位机的安全工作载荷。

examples.en: The hospital bed label shows its SWL.
examples.zh: 病床标签标示了安全工作载荷。

examples.en: We need the confirmed safe working load before preparing the care bed brochure.
examples.zh: 编写护理床宣传册前，需要确认安全工作载荷。

examples.en: Our email distinguishes patient lift SWL from the weight of the equipment itself.
examples.zh: 我们的邮件区分了移位机安全工作载荷与设备自重。

examples.en: If the hospital bed documentation defines safe working load as including accessories, the quotation and translated instructions must use that same definition consistently.
examples.zh: 若病床文件规定安全工作载荷包括配件，报价单和翻译后的说明书必须统一采用该定义。

examples.en: Please locate the patient lift emergency lowering control.
examples.zh: 请找到移位机的紧急下降控制装置。

examples.en: Can you explain this lift's emergency lowering procedure?
examples.zh: 您能解释这台移位机的紧急下降程序吗？

examples.en: The patient lift demonstration includes emergency lowering as described in its instructions.
examples.zh: 移位机演示包括按说明书介绍紧急下降操作。

examples.en: Please confirm whether the requested patient lift version uses manual or powered emergency lowering.
examples.zh: 请确认所需移位机版本采用手动还是电动紧急下降。

examples.en: Before training your service team on emergency lowering, we will identify the exact patient lift configuration and use the procedure approved for that model.
examples.zh: 培训贵方服务团队的紧急下降操作前，我们会确定移位机的具体配置，并采用该型号批准的程序。

examples.en: This walker folds for storage and transport.
examples.zh: 这款助行架可折叠，便于存放和运输。

examples.en: Which walker height does your customer need?
examples.zh: 贵客户需要多高的助行架？

examples.en: Please compare walker handle settings before confirming the sample for your showroom.
examples.zh: 确认展厅样品前，请比较助行架握把调节档位。

examples.en: Our factory checks walker locking points according to the approved inspection checklist.
examples.zh: 工厂按批准的检验表检查助行架锁止点。

examples.en: If your buyer needs a walker with different grip dimensions, we should review the drawing and sample before agreeing to any production change.
examples.zh: 如果买方需要不同握把尺寸的助行架，应先评审图纸和样品，再同意生产变更。

examples.en: This rollator includes a seat and brakes.
examples.zh: 这款带轮助行器配有座板和制动器。

examples.en: Would you like to inspect the rollator sample?
examples.zh: 您想检查带轮助行器样品吗？

examples.en: Please identify the rollator brake type when comparing offers from different suppliers.
examples.zh: 比较不同供应商报价时，请确认带轮助行器制动器类型。

examples.en: The rollator inspection record includes wheel movement and brake operation checks.
examples.zh: 带轮助行器检验记录包含轮子运动及制动操作检查。

examples.en: When you introduce the rollator at an exhibition, explain its specified brake operation and seating instructions rather than assuming customers know how this configuration works.
examples.zh: 在展会上介绍带轮助行器时，应说明规定的制动操作和座板使用要求，避免假定客户已了解该配置。

examples.en: This walker has a shaped handgrip.
examples.zh: 这款助行架配有成型握把。

examples.en: Please check the crutch handgrip for damage.
examples.zh: 请检查拐杖握把有无损坏。

examples.en: The buyer requested a different handgrip texture for the folding walker sample.
examples.zh: 买方要求折叠助行架样品采用不同握把纹理。

examples.en: Please email the handgrip drawing before changing the crutch component supplier.
examples.zh: 变更拐杖零件供应商前，请通过邮件发送握把图纸。

examples.en: If a handgrip complaint affects several walker batches, we will compare the material records and attachment details before proposing a corrective action plan.
examples.zh: 若握把投诉涉及多个助行架批次，我们会先比较材料记录和连接细节，再提出纠正措施计划。

examples.en: This crutch offers several height adjustment settings.
examples.zh: 这款拐杖提供多个高度调节档位。

examples.en: Let me demonstrate the walker height adjustment.
examples.zh: 我来演示助行架的高度调节。

examples.en: Please check both crutch height adjustment pins against the approved assembly instructions.
examples.zh: 请按批准的装配说明检查两侧拐杖高度调节销。

examples.en: Our care bed quotation specifies which height adjustment functions are included.
examples.zh: 护理床报价单说明包含哪些高度调节功能。

examples.en: Before approving a revised walker height adjustment range, engineering must verify the new hole positions and update the drawing, sample record, and relevant inspection criteria.
examples.zh: 批准修改助行架高度调节范围前，工程部门必须核实新孔位，并更新图纸、样品记录及相关检验准则。

examples.en: The walker folding mechanism locks into position.
examples.zh: 助行架折叠机构可锁定到位。

examples.en: Please inspect the wheelchair folding mechanism today.
examples.zh: 请今天检查轮椅折叠机构。

examples.en: Our demonstration explains the manual wheelchair folding mechanism using the supplied instructions.
examples.zh: 我们按随附说明书演示手动轮椅折叠机构。

examples.en: The supplier must submit a sample before modifying the walker folding mechanism.
examples.zh: 供应商修改助行架折叠机构前必须提交样品。

examples.en: If the wheelchair folding mechanism becomes difficult to operate, please provide its serial number and a short video so engineering can review the reported behavior.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅折叠机构难以操作，请提供序列号和简短视频，以便工程部门评估所反馈的情况。

examples.en: This rollator uses a cable-operated hand brake.
examples.zh: 这款带轮助行器采用拉线式手刹。

examples.en: Please demonstrate the rollator hand brake carefully.
examples.zh: 请仔细演示带轮助行器手刹。

examples.en: We inspect hand brake operation on the rollator before the final release review.
examples.zh: 最终放行评审前，我们检查带轮助行器手刹操作。

examples.en: Your email should identify which rollator hand brake requires service assessment.
examples.zh: 您的邮件应注明带轮助行器哪一侧手刹需要服务评估。

examples.en: Before accepting a different hand brake supplier for the rollator, we need to review the approved specifications and verify the assembled system against the inspection plan.
examples.zh: 接受带轮助行器更换手刹供应商前，需要评审批准的规格，并按检验计划验证装配后的系统。

examples.en: This rollator has a padded seat.
examples.zh: 这款带轮助行器配有软垫座板。

examples.en: Which wheelchair seat material would you prefer?
examples.zh: 您希望轮椅座面采用哪种材料？

examples.en: Please confirm the manual wheelchair seat dimensions before we prepare the sample.
examples.zh: 制作样品前，请确认手动轮椅座面尺寸。

examples.en: The buyer asked whether the rollator seat is included in our quotation.
examples.zh: 买方询问我们的报价是否包含带轮助行器座板。

examples.en: If your customer requests a different wheelchair seat material, we must assess compatibility and update the approved specification before introducing it into production.
examples.zh: 如果客户要求更换轮椅座面材料，我们必须评估兼容性并更新批准的规格，之后才能投入生产。

examples.en: Please confirm this walker wheel diameter first.
examples.zh: 请先确认这款助行器的轮径。

examples.en: The wheelchair drawing specifies the wheel diameter.
examples.zh: 轮椅图纸规定了轮径。

examples.en: We compare wheel diameter measurements with the approved rollator component specification.
examples.zh: 我们将轮径测量值与批准的带轮助行器零件规格比较。

examples.en: Please include wheel diameter details when requesting a revised manual wheelchair quotation.
examples.zh: 要求修改手动轮椅报价时，请附上轮径资料。

examples.en: If the rollator wheel diameter changes, engineering should review the related clearances and brake arrangement before the revised sample is submitted to your purchasing team.
examples.zh: 若带轮助行器轮径发生变化，工程部门应先评审相关间隙和制动配置，再向贵采购团队提交修改后的样品。

examples.en: This power wheelchair uses joystick steering controls.
examples.zh: 这款电动轮椅采用摇杆转向控制。

examples.en: May I show you the powered wheelchair sample?
examples.zh: 我可以向您展示电动轮椅样品吗？

examples.en: The power wheelchair quotation identifies the selected battery and controller configuration.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅报价单注明所选电池及控制器配置。

examples.en: Please send the powered wheelchair serial number when requesting technical support.
examples.zh: 申请技术支持时，请提供电动轮椅序列号。

examples.en: Before comparing power wheelchair prices, we should align the battery configuration, included accessories, documented operating limits, and warranty terms so both offers describe equivalent packages.
examples.zh: 比较电动轮椅价格前，应统一电池配置、所含配件、文件规定使用限制和保修条款，确保两份报价对应可比方案。

examples.en: This power wheelchair has a joystick controller.
examples.zh: 这款电动轮椅配有摇杆控制器。

examples.en: Please photograph the wheelchair joystick controller label.
examples.zh: 请拍摄轮椅摇杆控制器标签。

examples.en: We need the joystick controller model before checking the power wheelchair wiring details.
examples.zh: 核对电动轮椅接线资料前，需要摇杆控制器型号。

examples.en: Our exhibition demonstration explains the joystick controller functions listed in the wheelchair manual.
examples.zh: 展会演示介绍了轮椅说明书列出的摇杆控制器功能。

examples.en: If the joystick controller supplier proposes a substitute for the power wheelchair, engineering must assess compatibility before the purchasing team confirms the replacement order.
examples.zh: 若供应商建议电动轮椅采用替代摇杆控制器，采购团队确认替代订单前，工程部门必须评估其兼容性。

examples.en: Please check the power wheelchair drive motor.
examples.zh: 请检查电动轮椅的驱动电机。

examples.en: Which drive motor matches this wheelchair configuration?
examples.zh: 哪款驱动电机匹配这套轮椅配置？

examples.en: The power wheelchair inspection record identifies the installed drive motor model.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅检验记录注明安装的驱动电机型号。

examples.en: Please send drive motor photographs with the wheelchair fault description by email.
examples.zh: 请通过邮件发送驱动电机照片及轮椅故障描述。

examples.en: Before accepting a new drive motor for the power wheelchair, we need approved test criteria and compatibility evidence for the controller, mounting points, and related wiring.
examples.zh: 接受电动轮椅更换驱动电机前，需要批准的测试准则，以及控制器、安装点和相关接线的兼容性证据。

examples.en: This power wheelchair has a removable battery.
examples.zh: 这款电动轮椅配有可拆卸电池。

examples.en: Please identify the patient lift removable battery.
examples.zh: 请确认移位机的可拆卸电池。

examples.en: The quotation states whether a removable battery is included with the patient lift.
examples.zh: 报价单说明移位机是否包含可拆卸电池。

examples.en: We will confirm removable battery labeling before final packing of the power wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅最终包装前，我们会确认可拆卸电池标签。

examples.en: If you request an extra removable battery for the power wheelchair, we must confirm its compatibility and the applicable transport documentation before revising the quotation.
examples.zh: 若您要求电动轮椅额外配备可拆卸电池，我们必须先确认兼容性和适用运输文件，再修改报价。

examples.en: Please identify the wheelchair electromagnetic brake model.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅电磁制动器型号。

examples.en: The power wheelchair drawing lists an electromagnetic brake.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅图纸列有电磁制动器。

examples.en: Our engineer will explain electromagnetic brake operation using the power wheelchair instructions.
examples.zh: 工程师会依据电动轮椅说明书解释电磁制动器操作。

examples.en: Please provide the electromagnetic brake label when reporting a wheelchair braking concern.
examples.zh: 反馈轮椅制动问题时，请提供电磁制动器标签。

examples.en: If a power wheelchair electromagnetic brake is replaced, the service team must follow the approved procedure and record the relevant inspection results before returning the unit.
examples.zh: 若更换电动轮椅电磁制动器，服务团队必须按批准程序操作，并记录相关检验结果后再交回设备。

examples.en: Please confirm the power wheelchair driving range.
examples.zh: 请确认电动轮椅的续航里程。

examples.en: Does this wheelchair driving range include test conditions?
examples.zh: 这款轮椅的续航数据附有测试条件吗？

examples.en: The power wheelchair brochure states driving range alongside battery configuration and test conditions.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅宣传册将续航里程与电池配置、测试条件一起列出。

examples.en: We cannot compare wheelchair driving range figures without checking how each result was measured.
examples.zh: 不核查测量方式，就无法比较轮椅续航数据。

examples.en: When discussing the power wheelchair driving range with a distributor, explain the documented test conditions and avoid promising the same distance under every customer's operating conditions.
examples.zh: 与经销商讨论电动轮椅续航时，应解释文件中的测试条件，避免承诺在所有客户使用条件下均达到相同距离。

examples.en: Please check this wheelchair's specified turning radius.
examples.zh: 请检查这款轮椅规定的转弯半径。

examples.en: The power wheelchair specification includes its turning radius.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅规格中包含转弯半径。

examples.en: Our exhibition team can explain the wheelchair turning radius using the documented measurement method.
examples.zh: 展会团队可按文件规定测量方法解释轮椅转弯半径。

examples.en: Please confirm doorway dimensions before using turning radius figures to assess wheelchair access.
examples.zh: 用转弯半径评估轮椅通行条件前，请确认门口尺寸。

examples.en: If your customer needs to maneuver a power wheelchair in a restricted room, we should compare the actual layout with the documented turning radius and operating limits.
examples.zh: 若客户需在狭小房间内操纵电动轮椅，应将实际布局与文件规定的转弯半径和使用限制进行比较。

examples.en: This manual wheelchair folds for easier storage.
examples.zh: 这款手动轮椅可折叠，便于存放。

examples.en: Which manual wheelchair seat width do you need?
examples.zh: 您需要多大座宽的手动轮椅？

examples.en: Please inspect the manual wheelchair sample before confirming the upholstery color for production.
examples.zh: 确认量产座垫颜色前，请检查手动轮椅样品。

examples.en: Our quotation lists manual wheelchair accessories separately so you can compare the included items.
examples.zh: 报价单单列手动轮椅配件，方便比较所含项目。

examples.en: If you are comparing manual wheelchair suppliers, please align frame construction, seat dimensions, included accessories, and inspection requirements before deciding whether the quoted prices are comparable.
examples.zh: 比较手动轮椅供应商时，请先统一车架结构、座面尺寸、所含配件和检验要求，再判断报价是否可比。

examples.en: The manual wheelchair handrim has a smooth surface.
examples.zh: 手动轮椅手轮圈表面光滑。

examples.en: Please inspect this wheelchair handrim for damage.
examples.zh: 请检查这款轮椅手轮圈有无损坏。

examples.en: We check handrim clearance against the approved manual wheelchair drawing during assembly.
examples.zh: 装配时，我们按批准的手动轮椅图纸检查手轮圈间隙。

examples.en: The buyer requested handrim material details before approving the manual wheelchair sample.
examples.zh: 买方要求先了解手轮圈材料，再批准手动轮椅样品。

examples.en: If a handrim complaint concerns several manual wheelchairs, please send serial numbers and clear photographs so we can review the batch records and assess the affected scope.
examples.zh: 若手轮圈投诉涉及多台手动轮椅，请发送序列号及清晰照片，以便核查批次记录并评估影响范围。

examples.en: Please check the manual wheelchair rear wheel.
examples.zh: 请检查手动轮椅后轮。

examples.en: This wheelchair rear wheel matches the approved sample.
examples.zh: 这只轮椅后轮与批准样品一致。

examples.en: The rear wheel assembly must follow the approved manual wheelchair work instruction.
examples.zh: 后轮装配必须遵循批准的手动轮椅作业指导书。

examples.en: Please identify the rear wheel version when requesting replacement parts for your wheelchair.
examples.zh: 申请轮椅替换件时，请确认后轮版本。

examples.en: Before changing the rear wheel specification on the manual wheelchair, engineering should assess related clearances and fittings, then obtain approval for the updated drawing and sample.
examples.zh: 修改手动轮椅后轮规格前，工程部门应评估相关间隙和配合关系，再取得更新图纸及样品的批准。

examples.en: Please inspect the wheelchair caster for damage.
examples.zh: 请检查轮椅脚轮有无损坏。

examples.en: This hospital bed caster has a brake.
examples.zh: 这款病床脚轮带有制动器。

examples.en: We compare caster mounting dimensions with the approved hospital bed component drawing.
examples.zh: 我们将脚轮安装尺寸与批准的病床零件图纸比较。

examples.en: Please specify caster material when requesting a revised manual wheelchair quotation.
examples.zh: 要求修改手动轮椅报价时，请注明脚轮材料。

examples.en: If a caster supplier changes the mounting design for the hospital bed, we must assess compatibility and inspect the revised sample before authorizing the component change.
examples.zh: 若脚轮供应商修改病床安装结构，我们必须评估兼容性并检验修改样品，之后才能授权零件变更。

examples.en: This manual wheelchair has a removable footrest.
examples.zh: 这款手动轮椅配有可拆卸脚托。

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair footrest locking point.
examples.zh: 请检查轮椅脚托锁止点。

examples.en: Our wheelchair sample review includes footrest adjustment and attachment details from the specification.
examples.zh: 轮椅样品评审包含规格规定的脚托调节及连接细节。

examples.en: Please email the footrest part number before ordering spare parts for your wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 订购轮椅备件前，请通过邮件发送脚托零件号。

examples.en: If your customer requests a different footrest for the power wheelchair, engineering must review the mounting interface and approved adjustment limits before the quotation is revised.
examples.zh: 若客户要求电动轮椅改配其他脚托，修改报价前，工程部门必须评审安装接口和批准的调节限制。

examples.en: This wheelchair armrest folds up for access.
examples.zh: 这款轮椅扶手可向上翻起。

examples.en: Please identify the manual wheelchair armrest version.
examples.zh: 请确认手动轮椅扶手版本。

examples.en: We inspect armrest attachment points against the approved power wheelchair assembly drawing.
examples.zh: 我们按批准的电动轮椅装配图检查扶手连接点。

examples.en: The distributor asked whether the wheelchair armrest is included in the standard quotation.
examples.zh: 经销商询问标准报价是否包含轮椅扶手。

examples.en: Before approving a revised armrest for the manual wheelchair, please compare the sample with the drawing and confirm that the related attachment details meet the agreed specification.
examples.zh: 批准修改后的手动轮椅扶手前，请将样品与图纸比较，并确认相关连接细节符合约定规格。

examples.en: Please confirm the manual wheelchair seat width.
examples.zh: 请确认手动轮椅座宽。

examples.en: The power wheelchair quotation shows its seat width.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅报价单列明座宽。

examples.en: We need your required seat width before selecting the wheelchair sample for review.
examples.zh: 选择轮椅评审样品前，需要了解您要求的座宽。

examples.en: Our inspector records wheelchair seat width using the measurement points in the drawing.
examples.zh: 检验员按图纸测量点记录轮椅座宽。

examples.en: If you request several seat width options for the manual wheelchair, we should review the corresponding drawings and minimum quantities before confirming the final commercial offer.
examples.zh: 若您要求手动轮椅提供多种座宽，应先评审对应图纸和最低数量，再确认最终商务报价。

examples.en: This manual wheelchair uses a folding frame.
examples.zh: 这款手动轮椅采用折叠车架。

examples.en: Please inspect the walker folding frame joints.
examples.zh: 请检查助行架折叠车架的接合处。

examples.en: The wheelchair folding frame drawing identifies the approved hinge and locking details.
examples.zh: 轮椅折叠车架图纸标明批准的铰接及锁止细节。

examples.en: Please confirm folding frame dimensions before we update the manual wheelchair packing plan.
examples.zh: 更新手动轮椅包装方案前，请确认折叠车架尺寸。

examples.en: If the folding frame supplier changes a hinge detail, engineering must review the effect on the manual wheelchair assembly and approve the updated inspection requirements before production.
examples.zh: 若折叠车架供应商修改铰接细节，工程部门必须评审其对手动轮椅装配的影响，并在生产前批准更新的检验要求。

examples.en: This home care bed has adjustable sections.
examples.zh: 这款居家护理床有可调节床面分区。

examples.en: May I demonstrate the home care bed controls?
examples.zh: 我可以演示居家护理床的控制器吗？

examples.en: Our home care bed quotation identifies the selected motors and included accessories.
examples.zh: 居家护理床报价单注明所选电机及所含配件。

examples.en: Please confirm the home care bed dimensions before arranging the showroom sample delivery.
examples.zh: 安排展厅样品交付前，请确认居家护理床尺寸。

examples.en: If the home care bed will be supplied with your private label, we should confirm artwork, instructions, packaging details, and approval responsibilities before scheduling production.
examples.zh: 若居家护理床采用贵方自有品牌，应先确认设计稿、说明书、包装细节和批准责任，再安排生产。

examples.en: This nursing care bed has side rails.
examples.zh: 这款护理床配有护栏。

examples.en: Which nursing care bed configuration interests your buyer?
examples.zh: 贵买方对哪种护理床配置感兴趣？

examples.en: We can compare nursing care bed accessories after reviewing your purchasing requirements.
examples.zh: 评审采购要求后，我们可比较护理床配件。

examples.en: The nursing care bed sample must match the approved drawing and component list.
examples.zh: 护理床样品必须与批准图纸及零件清单一致。

examples.en: Before revising the nursing care bed quotation, please identify the required adjustments and accessories so we can compare a clearly defined configuration against your budget.
examples.zh: 修改护理床报价前，请确认所需调节功能和配件，以便我们按照预算比较明确定义的配置。

examples.en: This care bed offers powered backrest adjustment.
examples.zh: 这款护理床提供电动背部调节。

examples.en: Please demonstrate the hospital bed backrest adjustment.
examples.zh: 请演示病床的背部调节。

examples.en: We inspect backrest adjustment according to the approved care bed functional checklist.
examples.zh: 我们按批准的护理床功能检查表检验背部调节。

examples.en: Your email should describe when the care bed backrest adjustment issue occurs.
examples.zh: 您的邮件应描述护理床背部调节问题何时出现。

examples.en: If the requested backrest adjustment changes the care bed mechanism, engineering must review the proposed configuration and update the approved documentation before confirming production feasibility.
examples.zh: 若所需背部调节涉及护理床机构变更，工程部门必须评审拟定配置并更新批准文件，再确认生产可行性。

examples.en: Please check the care bed knee break.
examples.zh: 请检查护理床膝部屈曲调节。

examples.en: The hospital bed specification describes its knee break.
examples.zh: 病床规格说明了膝部屈曲调节。

examples.en: Our engineer uses the care bed drawing to explain the knee break arrangement.
examples.zh: 工程师利用护理床图纸解释膝部屈曲调节结构。

examples.en: Please identify the care bed model when asking about a knee break adjustment concern.
examples.zh: 询问膝部屈曲调节问题时，请注明护理床型号。

examples.en: Before approving a different knee break arrangement for the hospital bed, we should review the mechanism, specified movement limits, and related checks against the revised drawing.
examples.zh: 批准病床改用其他膝部屈曲调节结构前，应根据修订图纸评审机构、规定运动限制及相关检查。

examples.en: This hospital bed has a folding side rail.
examples.zh: 这款病床配有可折叠护栏。

examples.en: Please check the care bed side rail latch.
examples.zh: 请检查护理床护栏锁扣。

examples.en: The side rail sample must match the approved hospital bed mounting dimensions.
examples.zh: 护栏样品必须符合批准的病床安装尺寸。

examples.en: Please photograph the side rail label and affected care bed before requesting service.
examples.zh: 申请服务前，请拍摄护栏标签及受影响的护理床。

examples.en: If your buyer requests a new side rail design for the hospital bed, engineering must review the proposed interfaces and relevant safety requirements before approving the sample.
examples.zh: 若买方要求病床采用新护栏设计，工程部门必须评审拟用接口和相关安全要求，再批准样品。

examples.en: This care bed uses a wired hand control.
examples.zh: 这款护理床使用有线手控器。

examples.en: Please identify the hospital bed hand control.
examples.zh: 请确认病床的手控器。

examples.en: Our assembly team checks hand control connections against the approved care bed wiring diagram.
examples.zh: 装配团队按批准的护理床接线图检查手控器连接。

examples.en: The quotation states which hand control functions are included with the nursing care bed.
examples.zh: 报价单注明护理床手控器包含哪些功能。

examples.en: Before supplying a replacement hand control for the hospital bed, we need the model and connector details so engineering can confirm compatibility with the installed control system.
examples.zh: 提供病床替换手控器前，需要型号及连接器细节，以便工程部门确认与已安装控制系统的兼容性。

examples.en: This hospital bed has adjustable bed sections.
examples.zh: 这款病床有可调节床面分区。

examples.en: Which hospital bed accessories does your buyer require?
examples.zh: 贵买方需要哪些病床配件？

examples.en: Please review the hospital bed drawing before approving the headboard color sample.
examples.zh: 批准床头板颜色样品前，请评审病床图纸。

examples.en: Our hospital bed production update separates assembly progress from final shipment release.
examples.zh: 病床生产进度更新区分了装配进度与最终出货放行。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order includes several configurations, we should identify each version in the purchase order and agree separate inspection criteria where necessary.
examples.zh: 若病床订单包含多种配置，应在采购订单中逐一标明各版本，并在必要时约定不同检验准则。

examples.en: This electric hospital bed uses powered adjustments.
examples.zh: 这款电动病床采用电动调节。

examples.en: Please review the electric hospital bed controls.
examples.zh: 请查看电动病床控制器。

examples.en: The electric hospital bed quotation lists the selected control system and accessories.
examples.zh: 电动病床报价单列明所选控制系统及配件。

examples.en: Please send the electric hospital bed wiring revision before the supplier builds its sample.
examples.zh: 供应商制作样品前，请发送电动病床接线版本。

examples.en: Before accepting an alternative control system for the electric hospital bed, engineering must assess the proposed components together and confirm the required verification activities.
examples.zh: 接受电动病床替代控制系统前，工程部门必须整体评估拟用零件，并确认所需验证活动。

examples.en: The hospital bed platform has separate sections.
examples.zh: 病床床面平台分为多个区段。

examples.en: Please inspect this care bed platform surface.
examples.zh: 请检查这款护理床床面平台表面。

examples.en: Our inspector compares bed platform dimensions with the approved hospital bed drawing.
examples.zh: 检验员按批准的病床图纸比较床面平台尺寸。

examples.en: The buyer requested bed platform material information for the nursing care bed tender.
examples.zh: 买方为护理床招标要求提供床面平台材料资料。

examples.en: If the bed platform design changes on the hospital bed, we must review the revised interfaces and update the controlled drawing before releasing the change to production.
examples.zh: 若病床床面平台设计变更，必须评审修改后的接口，并更新受控图纸，再将变更下发生产。

examples.en: This hospital bed has a removable headboard.
examples.zh: 这款病床配有可拆卸床头板。

examples.en: Please confirm the care bed headboard color.
examples.zh: 请确认护理床床头板颜色。

examples.en: The headboard attachment details must match the approved hospital bed assembly drawing.
examples.zh: 床头板连接细节必须符合批准的病床装配图。

examples.en: Please email the headboard artwork before we prepare your private-label care bed sample.
examples.zh: 制作自有品牌护理床样品前，请通过邮件发送床头板设计稿。

examples.en: If your distributor requests a different headboard for the hospital bed, we should assess the mounting interface and confirm the revised packaging before approving production.
examples.zh: 若经销商要求病床改配其他床头板，应先评估安装接口并确认修改后的包装，再批准生产。

examples.en: This hospital bed includes a matching footboard.
examples.zh: 这款病床配有相配的床尾板。

examples.en: Please inspect the nursing care bed footboard.
examples.zh: 请检查护理床床尾板。

examples.en: Our sample review checks footboard finish against the approved hospital bed color reference.
examples.zh: 样品评审按批准的病床颜色基准检查床尾板表面效果。

examples.en: The quotation identifies whether a custom footboard is included with the care bed.
examples.zh: 报价单注明护理床是否包含定制床尾板。

examples.en: Before accepting a revised footboard design for the hospital bed, please confirm the drawing revision and mounting details so purchasing and production use the same specification.
examples.zh: 接受修订的病床床尾板设计前，请确认图纸版次及安装细节，确保采购和生产采用相同规格。

examples.en: This hospital bed uses a central braking system.
examples.zh: 这款病床采用中控制动系统。

examples.en: Please demonstrate the hospital bed central braking system.
examples.zh: 请演示病床的中控制动系统。

examples.en: Our inspection checklist covers the central braking system on the specified hospital bed.
examples.zh: 检验表涵盖指定病床的中控制动系统。

examples.en: Please confirm caster compatibility before changing the hospital bed central braking system components.
examples.zh: 变更病床中控制动系统零件前，请确认脚轮兼容性。

examples.en: If the central braking system differs between hospital bed versions, the quotation and service documents must identify the correct configuration before customers order replacement components.
examples.zh: 若不同病床版本的中控制动系统不同，报价和维修文件必须明确正确配置，再由客户订购替换零件。

examples.en: This hospital bed includes an IV pole.
examples.zh: 这款病床配有输液架。

examples.en: Please check the hospital bed IV pole socket.
examples.zh: 请检查病床输液架插座。

examples.en: The quotation lists the IV pole separately from other hospital bed accessories.
examples.zh: 报价单将输液架与其他病床配件分开列出。

examples.en: We need the IV pole mounting dimensions before confirming compatibility with the care bed.
examples.zh: 确认与护理床兼容前，需要输液架安装尺寸。

examples.en: If your hospital bed tender specifies an IV pole, please provide the detailed requirements so we can confirm the accessory configuration and quote the correct package.
examples.zh: 若病床招标要求配备输液架，请提供具体要求，以便确认配件配置并准确报价。

examples.en: The care bed label states its safe working load.
examples.zh: 护理床标签标明安全工作载荷。

examples.en: Please verify this patient lift's safe working load.
examples.zh: 请核实这款移位机的安全工作载荷。

examples.en: Our hospital bed specification explains what is included in the safe working load.
examples.zh: 病床规格说明了安全工作载荷包含的项目。

examples.en: Please use the documented safe working load when preparing the patient lift sales sheet.
examples.zh: 制作移位机销售资料时，请采用文件载明的安全工作载荷。

examples.en: When a customer asks about the hospital bed safe working load, clarify its defined scope and use the approved documentation rather than inferring a rating from appearance.
examples.zh: 客户询问病床安全工作载荷时，应明确其定义范围，采用批准文件，不能从外观推断额定值。

examples.en: These axillary crutches have adjustable lower sections.
examples.zh: 这款腋拐下部可调节。

examples.en: Which axillary crutches size does your customer need?
examples.zh: 贵客户需要哪种尺寸的腋拐？

examples.en: Please compare the axillary crutches sample with the approved grip and tip specifications.
examples.zh: 请按批准的握把和脚垫规格比较腋拐样品。

examples.en: Our inspection record identifies the axillary crutches batch and checked adjustment positions.
examples.zh: 检验记录注明腋拐批次及已检调节档位。

examples.en: If your distributor requests different packaging for the axillary crutches, we should confirm the pair count, labeling, and carton arrangement before revising the commercial offer.
examples.zh: 若经销商要求腋拐采用不同包装，应先确认每包对数、标签和装箱方式，再修改商务报价。

examples.en: These forearm crutches have adjustable cuff positions.
examples.zh: 这款肘拐的前臂托位置可调。

examples.en: Please inspect the forearm crutches sample today.
examples.zh: 请今天检查肘拐样品。

examples.en: The forearm crutches quotation identifies the selected cuff and grip configurations.
examples.zh: 肘拐报价单注明所选前臂托和握把配置。

examples.en: Please email your forearm crutches sizing requirements before we arrange the exhibition samples.
examples.zh: 安排展会样品前，请通过邮件发送肘拐尺寸要求。

examples.en: Before approving a different cuff for the forearm crutches, engineering should assess the attachment and material details, then document the sample review and agreed inspection requirements.
examples.zh: 批准肘拐改用其他前臂托前，工程部门应评估连接和材料细节，并记录样品评审及约定检验要求。

examples.en: This walking cane has a rubber tip.
examples.zh: 这款手杖配有橡胶脚垫。

examples.en: Which walking cane handle style interests you?
examples.zh: 您对哪种手杖手柄款式感兴趣？

examples.en: Please confirm the walking cane adjustment range before approving the product specification.
examples.zh: 批准产品规格前，请确认手杖调节范围。

examples.en: Our quotation separates walking cane unit prices from custom packaging charges.
examples.zh: 报价单区分了手杖单价和定制包装费用。

examples.en: If your customer reports a walking cane tip issue, please provide batch details and photographs so we can assess the affected components before recommending a service response.
examples.zh: 若客户反馈手杖脚垫问题，请提供批次细节和照片，以便我们评估受影响零件，再建议售后处理方案。

examples.en: This forearm cuff fits the specified crutch.
examples.zh: 这款前臂托匹配指定拐杖。

examples.en: Please check the crutch forearm cuff opening.
examples.zh: 请检查拐杖前臂托开口。

examples.en: We compare forearm cuff dimensions with the approved drawing for the forearm crutches.
examples.zh: 我们按批准的肘拐图纸比较前臂托尺寸。

examples.en: The supplier must submit a forearm cuff sample before changing the crutch tooling.
examples.zh: 供应商修改拐杖模具前必须提交前臂托样品。

examples.en: If the forearm cuff material changes on the crutches, we need engineering approval and updated inspection criteria before the revised components can enter regular production.
examples.zh: 若拐杖前臂托材料变更，需要工程批准并更新检验准则后，修改后的零件才能投入常规生产。

examples.en: Please inspect the walking cane rubber tip.
examples.zh: 请检查手杖橡胶脚垫。

examples.en: This rubber tip matches the crutch specification.
examples.zh: 这款橡胶脚垫符合拐杖规格。

examples.en: Our inspector checks rubber tip dimensions against the approved drawing for the crutches.
examples.zh: 检验员按批准的拐杖图纸检查橡胶脚垫尺寸。

examples.en: Please identify the rubber tip batch when submitting a walking cane service request.
examples.zh: 提交手杖售后申请时，请注明橡胶脚垫批次。

examples.en: Before ordering a replacement rubber tip for the walking cane, confirm the interface dimensions and approved material specification rather than assuming every similar-looking part is compatible.
examples.zh: 订购手杖替换橡胶脚垫前，应确认接口尺寸和批准的材料规格，不能假定所有外观相似零件均兼容。

examples.en: Please check the crutch adjustment pin engagement.
examples.zh: 请检查拐杖调节销是否啮合到位。

examples.en: This walker adjustment pin matches the drawing.
examples.zh: 这款助行架调节销符合图纸。

examples.en: Our assembly checklist requires inspection of the crutch adjustment pin at specified positions.
examples.zh: 装配检查表要求在规定档位检查拐杖调节销。

examples.en: Please send adjustment pin photographs when reporting a height-setting issue on the walker.
examples.zh: 反馈助行架高度设定问题时，请发送调节销照片。

examples.en: If the adjustment pin design changes on the crutches, engineering must review the hole interface and approve the revised sample before the supplier starts production.
examples.zh: 若拐杖调节销设计发生变化，工程部门必须评审孔位接口并批准修订样品，然后供应商才能开始生产。

examples.en: We offer height-adjustable walkers and walking canes.
examples.zh: 我们提供高度可调助行架和手杖。

examples.en: Is this nursing care bed height-adjustable too?
examples.zh: 这款护理床的高度也可调吗？

examples.en: The height-adjustable crutch sample should match the positions shown in the approved drawing.
examples.zh: 高度可调拐杖样品应符合批准图纸所示档位。

examples.en: Please confirm the height-adjustable walker configuration before comparing quotations from different suppliers.
examples.zh: 比较不同供应商报价前，请确认高度可调助行架配置。

examples.en: If your buyer requests a height-adjustable hospital bed, we should define the required adjustment functions and operating limits before selecting the configuration and preparing the offer.
examples.zh: 若买方需要高度可调病床，应先明确调节功能要求和使用限制，再选择配置并准备报价。

examples.en: Please confirm the manual wheelchair specification first.
examples.zh: 请先确认手动轮椅规格。

examples.en: This patient lift matches the agreed specification.
examples.zh: 这台移位机符合约定规格。

examples.en: The care bed specification must identify the selected motors and included accessories clearly.
examples.zh: 护理床规格必须明确所选电机及所含配件。

examples.en: We will review your walker specification before confirming whether customization is feasible.
examples.zh: 确认定制可行性前，我们会评审您的助行器规格。

examples.en: Before issuing the power wheelchair purchase order, please approve the final specification so the quotation, production instructions, and inspection criteria refer to the same configuration.
examples.zh: 签发电动轮椅采购订单前，请批准最终规格，确保报价、生产指令和检验准则对应同一配置。

examples.en: Please check this walking cane's rated load capacity.
examples.zh: 请检查这款手杖的额定承载能力。

examples.en: The wheelchair specification states its load capacity.
examples.zh: 轮椅规格说明其承载能力。

examples.en: We need documented load capacity information before preparing the walker sales brochure.
examples.zh: 制作助行器销售册前，需要有文件依据的承载资料。

examples.en: Please distinguish hospital bed load capacity terminology from the defined safe working load.
examples.zh: 请区分病床承载能力用语与明确界定的安全工作载荷。

examples.en: When comparing load capacity claims for manual wheelchairs, ask how each rating is defined and supported rather than assuming identical numbers represent identical test conditions.
examples.zh: 比较手动轮椅承载声明时，应询问各额定值的定义和依据，不能假定相同数字代表相同测试条件。

examples.en: The wheelchair net weight excludes its carton.
examples.zh: 轮椅净重不包含外箱。

examples.en: Please confirm the walker sample net weight.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器样品净重。

examples.en: Our quotation states whether wheelchair net weight includes the selected battery and accessories.
examples.zh: 报价单注明轮椅净重是否包含所选电池及配件。

examples.en: The packing team records patient lift net weight separately from the packaged shipment weight.
examples.zh: 包装团队将移位机净重与包装后货物重量分别记录。

examples.en: Before comparing power wheelchair net weight figures, we should align the battery and accessory configurations so the customer receives an accurate comparison between equivalent product packages.
examples.zh: 比较电动轮椅净重数据前，应统一电池及配件配置，让客户准确比较同等产品方案。

examples.en: Please record the hospital bed gross weight.
examples.zh: 请记录病床毛重。

examples.en: This packing list shows the wheelchair gross weight.
examples.zh: 这份装箱单列明轮椅毛重。

examples.en: The care bed gross weight includes the specified carton and protective packaging materials.
examples.zh: 护理床毛重包括规定的外箱及防护包装材料。

examples.en: Please verify patient lift gross weight before submitting booking details to the freight forwarder.
examples.zh: 向货代提交订舱资料前，请核实移位机毛重。

examples.en: If the wheelchair packaging changes after quotation, we should recalculate the gross weight and notify the forwarder before confirming the shipment booking and final packing list.
examples.zh: 若报价后轮椅包装变更，应重新计算毛重，并在确认订舱及最终装箱单前通知货代。

examples.en: Please check the hospital bed dimensions carefully.
examples.zh: 请仔细核对病床尺寸。

examples.en: The drawing shows the walker frame dimensions.
examples.zh: 图纸标明助行架车架尺寸。

examples.en: We need the patient lift base dimensions to review access around your existing beds.
examples.zh: 需要移位机底座尺寸，以评估在现有床具周边的通行条件。

examples.en: Please include units when sending wheelchair dimensions to our quotation team by email.
examples.zh: 邮件向报价团队发送轮椅尺寸时，请注明单位。

examples.en: Before accepting your hospital bed tender, we should confirm whether the required dimensions refer to the bed platform, overall footprint, or packaging, because these measurements are different.
examples.zh: 接受病床招标要求前，应确认所需尺寸是床面平台、整体占地还是包装尺寸，因为这些测量值不同。

examples.en: Please confirm the manual wheelchair folded dimensions.
examples.zh: 请确认手动轮椅折叠尺寸。

examples.en: The walker brochure lists its folded dimensions.
examples.zh: 助行器宣传册列明折叠尺寸。

examples.en: Our packing review compares wheelchair folded dimensions with the proposed carton internal dimensions.
examples.zh: 包装评审将轮椅折叠尺寸与拟用外箱内尺寸比较。

examples.en: Please state which accessories remain attached when measuring the rollator folded dimensions.
examples.zh: 测量带轮助行器折叠尺寸时，请说明保留了哪些配件。

examples.en: If you compare folded dimensions across manual wheelchair models, confirm that the same measurement method and accessory arrangement were used before deciding which version suits your storage space.
examples.zh: 比较不同手动轮椅型号的折叠尺寸时，应确认测量方法及配件状态一致，再判断哪款适合贵方存储空间。

examples.en: Please confirm the power wheelchair battery capacity.
examples.zh: 请确认电动轮椅电池容量。

examples.en: The patient lift label lists its battery capacity.
examples.zh: 移位机标签列明电池容量。

examples.en: Our power wheelchair quotation states battery capacity together with the nominal battery voltage.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅报价单将电池容量与标称电压一并列出。

examples.en: Please check the documented battery capacity before comparing wheelchair driving range claims.
examples.zh: 比较轮椅续航声明前，请核对文件中的电池容量。

examples.en: If your buyer requests a different battery capacity for the power wheelchair, we must review compatibility and transport documentation before confirming the revised configuration and price.
examples.zh: 若买方要求电动轮椅采用不同电池容量，必须先评审兼容性及运输文件，再确认修改配置和价格。

examples.en: Please confirm the patient lift charging time.
examples.zh: 请确认移位机充电时间。

examples.en: The wheelchair manual explains its charging time conditions.
examples.zh: 轮椅说明书说明了充电时间适用条件。

examples.en: We quote power wheelchair charging time using the specified battery and compatible charger.
examples.zh: 我们按指定电池及兼容充电器说明电动轮椅充电时间。

examples.en: Please distinguish wheelchair charging time from driving range in the translated product leaflet.
examples.zh: 翻译产品说明页时，请区分轮椅充电时间与续航里程。

examples.en: When a customer asks about the power wheelchair charging time, explain the documented starting conditions and charger configuration rather than promising the same duration for every charging session.
examples.zh: 客户询问电动轮椅充电时间时，应解释记录的初始条件和充电器配置，避免承诺每次充电时间相同。

examples.en: Please send the hospital bed carton dimensions.
examples.zh: 请发送病床外箱尺寸。

examples.en: The walker packing list includes carton dimensions.
examples.zh: 助行器装箱单包含外箱尺寸。

examples.en: We need wheelchair carton dimensions before estimating the shipment volume for your forwarder.
examples.zh: 向货代估算货物体积前，需要轮椅外箱尺寸。

examples.en: Please confirm whether the quoted patient lift carton dimensions include external pallet packaging.
examples.zh: 请确认移位机所报外箱尺寸是否包含外部托盘包装。

examples.en: If custom protection changes the nursing care bed carton dimensions, we should revise the packing plan and freight estimate before confirming the customer's final shipping arrangement.
examples.zh: 若定制防护改变护理床外箱尺寸，应更新包装方案及运费估算，再确认客户最终运输安排。

zh: 原始设备制造/贴牌生产

examples.en: We can discuss OEM packaging for walkers.
examples.zh: 我们可以讨论助行器OEM包装。

examples.en: Does your wheelchair order require OEM labeling?
examples.zh: 您的轮椅订单需要OEM标签吗？

examples.en: Our OEM discussion covers care bed branding, approved artwork, and packaging requirements.
examples.zh: OEM讨论涵盖护理床品牌、批准设计稿和包装要求。

examples.en: Please confirm OEM label responsibilities before approving the patient lift production sample.
examples.zh: 批准移位机生产样品前，请确认OEM标签责任。

examples.en: For an OEM manual wheelchair order, we should agree on the approved specification, labeling responsibilities, minimum quantity, and sample approval process before production is scheduled.
examples.zh: 对于手动轮椅OEM订单，应先约定批准规格、标签责任、最低数量及样品批准流程，再安排生产。

examples.en: Would you consider ODM options for care beds?
examples.zh: 您会考虑护理床ODM方案吗？

examples.en: Please explain your walker ODM design requirements.
examples.zh: 请说明您的助行器ODM设计要求。

examples.en: Our ODM review separates existing wheelchair design options from requested engineering changes.
examples.zh: ODM评审区分现有轮椅设计选项与要求的工程变更。

examples.en: The ODM proposal for the hospital bed should define development and approval responsibilities.
examples.zh: 病床ODM方案应明确开发及批准责任。

examples.en: Before accepting an ODM patient lift project, both parties should agree on design scope, documentation responsibilities, validation activities, and commercial terms through the authorized review process.
examples.zh: 接受移位机ODM项目前，双方应通过授权评审流程约定设计范围、文件责任、确认活动和商务条款。

examples.en: Please confirm the MOQ for these crutches.
examples.zh: 请确认这款拐杖的最低订购量。

examples.en: Does custom walker packaging change the MOQ?
examples.zh: 定制助行器包装会改变最低订购量吗？

examples.en: The wheelchair quotation states the MOQ for each selected color and configuration.
examples.zh: 轮椅报价单列明各所选颜色及配置的最低订购量。

examples.en: We can review the care bed MOQ after confirming your annual purchasing forecast.
examples.zh: 确认年度采购预测后，我们可以评估护理床最低订购量。

examples.en: If your distributor requests a lower MOQ for the patient lift, we should review available configurations and production planning before confirming whether revised commercial terms are feasible.
examples.zh: 若经销商要求降低移位机最低订购量，应先评估可用配置及生产安排，再确认修改商务条款是否可行。

examples.en: Your private label can appear on the walker.
examples.zh: 您的自有品牌可用于助行器。

examples.en: Please approve the wheelchair private label artwork.
examples.zh: 请批准轮椅自有品牌设计稿。

examples.en: The patient lift private label proposal must identify the required text and placement.
examples.zh: 移位机自有品牌方案必须明确所需文字及位置。

examples.en: We need written approval before printing private label cartons for the care beds.
examples.zh: 印刷护理床自有品牌外箱前，需要书面批准。

examples.en: Before accepting a private label hospital bed order, we should confirm the approved artwork and documentation responsibilities so production does not apply unreviewed claims or incorrect labeling.
examples.zh: 接受自有品牌病床订单前，应确认批准设计稿及文件责任，避免生产采用未经评审的声明或错误标签。

examples.en: What customization do you need for these walkers?
examples.zh: 您需要对这款助行器做哪些定制？

examples.en: Wheelchair customization may affect the final quotation.
examples.zh: 轮椅定制可能影响最终报价。

examples.en: Please describe the requested care bed customization before we assess the engineering work.
examples.zh: 评估工程工作前，请说明护理床定制要求。

examples.en: Our patient lift customization review includes drawings, samples, and the proposed delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 移位机定制评审包括图纸、样品及拟定交期。

examples.en: If the hospital bed customization affects a controlled component, engineering must assess the proposed change and agree the verification work before sales confirms cost and lead time.
examples.zh: 若病床定制涉及受控零件，工程部门必须评估变更并约定验证工作，之后销售才能确认费用及交期。

examples.en: Please review this manual wheelchair sample today.
examples.zh: 请今天评审这款手动轮椅样品。

examples.en: May we send a walker sample first?
examples.zh: 我们可以先寄一件助行器样品吗？

examples.en: The patient lift sample should match the configuration identified in the quotation.
examples.zh: 移位机样品应与报价中注明的配置一致。

examples.en: Please email your care bed sample comments with photographs and marked drawing references.
examples.zh: 请通过邮件发送护理床样品意见，并附照片及标注图纸位置。

examples.en: Before approving the hospital bed sample for production, please check it against the agreed specification and identify any requested changes in a written review record.
examples.zh: 批准病床样品投入生产前，请按约定规格核对，并在书面评审记录中注明所有修改要求。

examples.en: What is the lead time for these walkers?
examples.zh: 这款助行器的交付周期是多久？

examples.en: Please confirm the patient lift lead time.
examples.zh: 请确认移位机交付周期。

examples.en: Our care bed lead time estimate starts after the agreed specifications are approved.
examples.zh: 护理床交付周期估算从约定规格获批后起算。

examples.en: The wheelchair lead time quotation should distinguish production completion from international transit.
examples.zh: 轮椅交期报价应区分生产完工和国际运输时间。

examples.en: If you change the hospital bed configuration after order approval, we must review material availability and production impact before confirming whether the original lead time remains achievable.
examples.zh: 若订单批准后修改病床配置，必须先评审物料可用性及生产影响，再确认原交付周期是否仍可实现。

examples.en: Please review our quotation for manual wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请查阅我们的手动轮椅报价单。

examples.en: Does this patient lift quotation include a sling?
examples.zh: 这份移位机报价包含吊带吗？

examples.en: The care bed quotation identifies the configuration, included accessories, and agreed delivery terms.
examples.zh: 护理床报价单注明配置、所含配件及约定交付条款。

examples.en: Please compare wheelchair quotation details before deciding which supplier offers the lower overall cost.
examples.zh: 判断哪家供应商总体费用更低前，请比较轮椅报价细节。

examples.en: If your buyer requests a revised quotation for the hospital beds, we should confirm the changed quantities and specifications so the new offer clearly replaces the previous version.
examples.zh: 若买方要求修改病床报价，应确认变更数量和规格，使新报价明确替代旧版本。

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair pro forma invoice.
examples.zh: 请核对轮椅形式发票。

examples.en: The care bed pro forma invoice needs approval.
examples.zh: 护理床形式发票需要批准。

examples.en: Our patient lift pro forma invoice shows the configuration and agreed payment schedule.
examples.zh: 移位机形式发票列明配置及约定付款安排。

examples.en: Please email corrections before approving the pro forma invoice for your walker order.
examples.zh: 批准助行器订单形式发票前，请通过邮件发送更正内容。

examples.en: Before arranging the hospital bed deposit, please confirm that the pro forma invoice matches the approved quotation, including quantities, configuration, delivery terms, and the named payment recipient.
examples.zh: 安排病床预付款前，请确认形式发票与批准报价一致，包括数量、配置、交付条款及列明的收款方。

examples.en: Please check the walker CE marking documents.
examples.zh: 请核对助行器CE标志相关文件。

examples.en: Does this wheelchair version require CE marking?
examples.zh: 这个轮椅版本是否需要CE标志？

examples.en: We will review the applicable CE marking documentation for the specified hospital bed.
examples.zh: 我们将评审指定病床适用的CE标志文件。

examples.en: Please avoid describing CE marking as a universal patient lift quality certificate.
examples.zh: 请勿将CE标志描述为通用的移位机质量证书。

examples.en: Before making a CE marking statement in the care bed brochure, confirm the applicable requirements and supporting documentation for the exact model and intended market.
examples.zh: 在护理床宣传册声明CE标志前，请确认具体型号和目标市场的适用要求及支持文件。

examples.en: Please request the hospital bed EU declaration of conformity.
examples.zh: 请索取病床欧盟符合性声明。

examples.en: This wheelchair EU declaration of conformity needs review.
examples.zh: 这份轮椅欧盟符合性声明需要评审。

examples.en: The EU declaration of conformity should identify the relevant patient lift model clearly.
examples.zh: 欧盟符合性声明应明确注明相关移位机型号。

examples.en: Please check the walker EU declaration of conformity against the supplied configuration documents.
examples.zh: 请根据所供配置文件核对助行器欧盟符合性声明。

examples.en: Before sharing the EU declaration of conformity with a care bed buyer, confirm that its product identification and stated scope correspond to the model being offered.
examples.zh: 向护理床买方提供欧盟符合性声明前，请确认产品标识及声明范围与所报型号对应。

zh: 医疗器械质量管理体系标准

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair factory's ISO 13485 scope.
examples.zh: 请核对轮椅工厂ISO 13485范围。

examples.en: ISO 13485 concerns a medical device quality system.
examples.zh: ISO 13485涉及医疗器械质量体系。

examples.en: Our care bed supplier review checks the validity and scope of ISO 13485 documentation.
examples.zh: 护理床供应商评审核查ISO 13485文件的有效性和范围。

examples.en: Please distinguish ISO 13485 certification from model-specific approval when discussing patient lifts.
examples.zh: 讨论移位机时，请区分ISO 13485认证与具体型号批准。

examples.en: When a hospital bed buyer requests ISO 13485 evidence, provide the relevant current documentation and explain its quality system scope without implying automatic product approval.
examples.zh: 病床买方要求ISO 13485证明时，应提供相关现行文件并说明质量体系范围，不暗示产品自动获批。

examples.en: Please send the patient lift test report.
examples.zh: 请发送移位机检测报告。

examples.en: Does this wheelchair test report identify the model?
examples.zh: 这份轮椅检测报告注明型号了吗？

examples.en: The hospital bed test report should state the tested configuration and relevant conditions.
examples.zh: 病床检测报告应说明受测配置及相关条件。

examples.en: Please check the care bed test report revision before forwarding it to your customer.
examples.zh: 转发客户前，请核对护理床检测报告版次。

examples.en: If the power wheelchair battery configuration differs from the tested version, engineering must assess the test report applicability before sales uses its results in a proposal.
examples.zh: 若电动轮椅电池配置与受测版本不同，销售采用报告结果报价前，工程部门必须评估检测报告适用性。

examples.en: Please read the patient lift instructions for use.
examples.zh: 请阅读移位机使用说明书。

examples.en: The hospital bed carton includes its IFU.
examples.zh: 病床外箱内附有使用说明书。

examples.en: Our care bed instructions for use must match the supplied configuration and language requirements.
examples.zh: 护理床使用说明书必须匹配所供配置及语言要求。

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair IFU revision before approving the translated customer leaflet.
examples.zh: 批准客户用翻译说明页前，请确认轮椅说明书版次。

examples.en: Before supplying private-label walkers, we should agree who reviews the instructions for use and ensure that the approved version accompanies the correctly identified product configuration.
examples.zh: 供应自有品牌助行器前，应约定使用说明书审核方，并确保批准版本随对应产品配置提供。

examples.en: This batch code supports traceability for crutches.
examples.zh: 这个批次代码有助于拐杖追溯。

examples.en: Please retain the wheelchair labels for traceability.
examples.zh: 请保留轮椅标签以便追溯。

examples.en: Our patient lift records link component batches with finished unit identification for traceability.
examples.zh: 移位机记录将零件批次与成品标识关联，以便追溯。

examples.en: The hospital bed complaint review requires traceability information from production and inspection records.
examples.zh: 病床投诉评审需要生产及检验记录中的追溯资料。

examples.en: If a walker component concern affects multiple shipments, complete traceability records help us identify the potentially affected batches and define the scope of further investigation.
examples.zh: 若助行器零件问题涉及多批出货，完整追溯记录有助于识别可能受影响批次，并确定进一步调查范围。

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair supplier's FDA establishment registration.
examples.zh: 请核查轮椅供应商的FDA企业注册。

examples.en: FDA establishment registration does not approve a wheelchair.
examples.zh: FDA企业注册并不批准某款轮椅。

examples.en: The hospital bed buyer requested current FDA establishment registration information for the supplier.
examples.zh: 病床买方要求供应商提供当前FDA企业注册资料。

examples.en: Please distinguish patient lift product status from FDA establishment registration during distributor discussions.
examples.zh: 与经销商沟通时，请区分移位机产品状态与FDA企业注册。

examples.en: Before responding to the care bed buyer, verify the applicable FDA establishment registration information and avoid presenting establishment registration as product certification, clearance, or approval.
examples.zh: 回复护理床买方前，请核实适用的FDA企业注册资料，勿将企业注册表述为产品认证、许可或批准。

examples.en: Please verify the wheelchair device listing information.
examples.zh: 请核实轮椅器械列名资料。

examples.en: Device listing alone does not establish patient lift approval.
examples.zh: 单凭器械列名不能证明移位机获批。

examples.en: Our hospital bed regulatory review checks whether the device listing matches the product description.
examples.zh: 病床法规评审核查器械列名是否符合产品描述。

examples.en: Please send device listing questions to the responsible reviewer before answering the wheelchair distributor.
examples.zh: 回复轮椅经销商前，请将器械列名问题交给责任审核人员。

examples.en: When the care bed buyer asks about device listing, confirm the applicable records and explain their scope without implying that listing alone determines the product's marketing authorization.
examples.zh: 护理床买方询问器械列名时，应核实适用记录并解释范围，不暗示单凭列名即可确定产品上市授权。

examples.en: Please clarify which wheelchair clearance you mean.
examples.zh: 请说明您指的是哪类轮椅许可。

examples.en: The patient lift clearance documents need review.
examples.zh: 移位机许可文件需要评审。

examples.en: Our regulatory reviewer will check the applicable clearance requirements for the specified hospital bed.
examples.zh: 法规审核人员将核查指定病床适用的许可要求。

examples.en: Please avoid treating supplier registration as evidence of clearance for the power wheelchair.
examples.zh: 请勿把供应商注册当作电动轮椅许可的证据。

examples.en: Before stating that a patient lift has the required clearance, confirm the exact product identification, jurisdiction, and supporting authorization documents with the responsible regulatory reviewer.
examples.zh: 声称移位机具备所需许可前，请与责任法规审核人员确认准确产品标识、司法辖区及支持授权文件。

examples.en: The walker artwork still needs customer approval.
examples.zh: 助行器设计稿仍需客户批准。

examples.en: Please confirm the care bed sample approval.
examples.zh: 请确认护理床样品批准情况。

examples.en: We need written approval before changing the manual wheelchair upholstery specification for production.
examples.zh: 更改量产手动轮椅座垫规格前，需要书面批准。

examples.en: The hospital bed approval record should identify the drawing revision and responsible reviewer.
examples.zh: 病床批准记录应注明图纸版次及责任审核人。

examples.en: If a customer requests a change after patient lift sample approval, we must assess the technical and scheduling impact before accepting the revised requirements in writing.
examples.zh: 若客户在移位机样品批准后提出变更，必须评估技术及排期影响，再书面接受修订要求。

examples.en: Please identify the applicable requirements for these walkers.
examples.zh: 请明确这批助行器的适用要求。

examples.en: The wheelchair review must address applicable requirements.
examples.zh: 轮椅评审必须涵盖适用要求。

examples.en: Our hospital bed documentation review considers the applicable requirements of the intended market.
examples.zh: 病床文件评审考虑目标市场的适用要求。

examples.en: Please confirm applicable requirements before requesting translated labels for the patient lift shipment.
examples.zh: 要求翻译移位机出货标签前，请确认适用要求。

examples.en: Before offering a new power wheelchair configuration overseas, the responsible reviewer should determine the applicable requirements and confirm what evidence is needed for the intended market.
examples.zh: 向海外提供新电动轮椅配置前，责任审核人员应确定适用要求，并确认目标市场所需证据。

examples.en: Please request the care bed regulatory documentation.
examples.zh: 请索取护理床监管文件。

examples.en: The wheelchair regulatory documentation identifies its intended market.
examples.zh: 轮椅监管文件明确其目标市场。

examples.en: We will check the patient lift regulatory documentation before making any market-access statement.
examples.zh: 作出任何市场准入声明前，我们将核对移位机监管文件。

examples.en: Please list the hospital bed regulatory documentation required by your purchasing team in writing.
examples.zh: 请书面列明贵采购团队所需病床监管文件。

examples.en: If the supplied walker configuration changes, the responsible reviewer must assess whether the existing regulatory documentation remains applicable before sales confirms the revised order.
examples.zh: 若所供助行器配置发生变化，责任审核人员必须评估现有监管文件是否仍适用，之后销售才能确认修订订单。

examples.en: What warranty applies to this patient lift?
examples.zh: 这款移位机适用什么保修条款？

examples.en: Please read the wheelchair warranty terms carefully.
examples.zh: 请仔细阅读轮椅保修条款。

examples.en: The care bed quotation refers to the agreed written warranty rather than verbal assumptions.
examples.zh: 护理床报价依据约定书面保修条款，而非口头推测。

examples.en: We need the hospital bed serial number before checking the relevant warranty records.
examples.zh: 核查相关保修记录前，需要病床序列号。

examples.en: If your distributor requests a different warranty for the power wheelchair, we should review the scope, exclusions, service process, and commercial impact before confirming any change.
examples.zh: 若经销商要求电动轮椅采用不同保修条款，应先评审范围、除外责任、服务流程和商务影响，再确认变更。

examples.en: Please confirm the care bed warranty coverage.
examples.zh: 请确认护理床保修范围。

examples.en: Does this wheelchair warranty coverage include its battery?
examples.zh: 这款轮椅保修范围包含电池吗？

examples.en: Our patient lift offer explains warranty coverage for the listed components and accessories.
examples.zh: 移位机报价说明了所列零件及配件的保修范围。

examples.en: Please compare warranty coverage before concluding that another hospital bed offer costs less.
examples.zh: 认定另一份病床报价更低前，请比较保修范围。

examples.en: When a manual wheelchair complaint arrives, we should assess the reported facts against the agreed warranty coverage before promising replacement parts or assigning responsibility for costs.
examples.zh: 收到手动轮椅投诉后，应先按照约定保修范围评估事实，再承诺更换零件或分配费用责任。

examples.en: Which spare parts do your wheelchairs require?
examples.zh: 贵方轮椅需要哪些备件？

examples.en: Please list the patient lift spare parts.
examples.zh: 请列出移位机备件。

examples.en: The care bed spare parts quotation should identify part numbers and compatible models.
examples.zh: 护理床备件报价应注明零件号及兼容型号。

examples.en: We can discuss a walker spare parts package after reviewing your service requirements.
examples.zh: 评审售后要求后，我们可以讨论助行器备件包。

examples.en: Before shipping hospital bed spare parts, please confirm the affected model and component identification so we can check compatibility and provide the appropriate approved service information.
examples.zh: 发运病床备件前，请确认受影响型号和零件标识，以便核查兼容性并提供相应批准的维修资料。

examples.en: Please follow the approved wheelchair troubleshooting guide.
examples.zh: 请遵循批准的轮椅故障排查指南。

examples.en: Our care bed troubleshooting starts with model identification.
examples.zh: 护理床故障排查从确认型号开始。

examples.en: Please send patient lift photographs so technical support can plan the troubleshooting review.
examples.zh: 请发送移位机照片，以便技术支持安排故障排查评审。

examples.en: The hospital bed troubleshooting record should describe the symptom and when it occurs.
examples.zh: 病床故障排查记录应描述症状及发生时间。

examples.en: If the reported power wheelchair issue cannot be resolved through the approved troubleshooting process, the service team should escalate the case for a documented technical assessment.
examples.zh: 若无法按批准的故障排查流程解决电动轮椅问题，服务团队应升级处理，开展有记录的技术评估。

examples.en: Please send the patient lift serial number.
examples.zh: 请提供移位机序列号。

examples.en: The hospital bed label shows its serial number.
examples.zh: 病床标签标有序列号。

examples.en: Our service team uses the wheelchair serial number to find the relevant configuration records.
examples.zh: 服务团队利用轮椅序列号查找相关配置记录。

examples.en: Please include the care bed serial number in your complaint email and photographs.
examples.zh: 请在投诉邮件及照片中提供护理床序列号。

examples.en: If several power wheelchairs show a similar symptom, provide each serial number separately so we can compare production records and assess whether the cases share a common batch.
examples.zh: 若多台电动轮椅出现类似症状，请分别提供各序列号，以便比较生产记录并评估是否属于同一批次。

examples.en: Please confirm the deposit for this walker order.
examples.zh: 请确认这笔助行器订单的预付款。

examples.en: The patient lift deposit is still pending.
examples.zh: 移位机预付款仍未到账。

examples.en: Our care bed schedule depends on deposit receipt and the agreed specification approval.
examples.zh: 护理床排期取决于预付款到账及约定规格批准。

examples.en: Please use the approved payment details when arranging the wheelchair order deposit.
examples.zh: 安排轮椅订单预付款时，请采用批准的付款资料。

examples.en: Before promising the hospital bed production start date, we must confirm that the deposit and required approvals have been received under the agreed commercial terms.
examples.zh: 承诺病床开工日期前，必须确认已按约定商务条款收到预付款及所需批准。

examples.en: Please confirm the outstanding balance for these wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请确认这批轮椅的未付尾款。

examples.en: The care bed balance is awaiting payment.
examples.zh: 护理床尾款尚待支付。

examples.en: We will review the patient lift balance against the agreed payment schedule before dispatch.
examples.zh: 发货前，我们将按约定付款安排核查移位机尾款。

examples.en: Please email the wheelchair payment reference when you arrange the remaining balance.
examples.zh: 安排轮椅尾款时，请通过邮件发送付款参考信息。

examples.en: If the buyer requests shipment before paying the hospital bed balance, sales must obtain the required commercial authorization rather than treating the exception as automatically approved.
examples.zh: 若买方要求在支付病床尾款前发货，销售必须取得所需商务授权，不能视为例外已自动获批。

examples.en: Please review the patient lift payment terms.
examples.zh: 请评审移位机付款条件。

examples.en: Our walker quotation states the proposed payment terms.
examples.zh: 助行器报价单列明拟定付款条件。

examples.en: The hospital bed order confirmation should reflect the payment terms accepted by both parties.
examples.zh: 病床订单确认书应体现双方接受的付款条件。

examples.en: We can review wheelchair payment terms together with order quantity and delivery arrangements.
examples.zh: 我们可结合订单数量及交付安排评估轮椅付款条件。

examples.en: Before accepting revised payment terms for the care bed order, the authorized commercial team should assess the proposed schedule and record its approval in the contract documents.
examples.zh: 接受护理床订单修订付款条件前，授权商务团队应评估拟定付款安排，并在合同文件中记录批准。

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair production lead time.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅生产周期。

examples.en: Does the walker production lead time include inspection?
examples.zh: 助行器生产周期包含检验吗？

examples.en: Our patient lift production lead time estimate begins after specifications and materials are confirmed.
examples.zh: 移位机生产周期估算从规格及物料确认后开始。

examples.en: Please separate care bed production lead time from vessel transit time in your email.
examples.zh: 请在邮件中区分护理床生产周期与海运时间。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order requires a new component, we must review procurement and verification activities before confirming whether the previously discussed production lead time remains realistic.
examples.zh: 若病床订单需要新零件，必须先评审采购及验证活动，再确认此前讨论的生产周期是否仍合理。

examples.en: Please update the hospital bed production schedule.
examples.zh: 请更新病床生产排期。

examples.en: The walker production schedule needs another review.
examples.zh: 助行器生产排期需要再次评审。

examples.en: Our wheelchair production schedule identifies component arrival, assembly, inspection, and planned packing dates.
examples.zh: 轮椅生产排期列明零件到货、装配、检验及计划包装日期。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift material availability before promising a firm production schedule.
examples.zh: 承诺确定的移位机生产排期前，请确认物料可用性。

examples.en: If the care bed customer changes the motor specification, planning should assess the effect on the production schedule and issue a controlled update after the required approvals.
examples.zh: 若护理床客户修改电机规格，计划部门应评估对生产排期的影响，并在取得所需批准后发布受控更新。

examples.en: Please confirm the walker scheduled completion date.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器计划完工日期。

examples.en: The hospital bed scheduled completion date has changed.
examples.zh: 病床计划完工日期已变更。

examples.en: Our update explains whether the patient lift scheduled completion date includes final inspection.
examples.zh: 我们的更新说明移位机计划完工日期是否包括最终检验。

examples.en: Please compare the wheelchair scheduled completion date with the forwarder's latest booking deadline.
examples.zh: 请将轮椅计划完工日期与货代最新订舱截止日期比较。

examples.en: If a supplier delay affects the care bed scheduled completion date, we should review the recovery options and communicate a revised estimate without presenting an unapproved date as confirmed.
examples.zh: 若供应商延迟影响护理床计划完工日，应评估赶工方案并告知修改估计，不将未批准日期表述为已确认。

examples.en: What is your requested delivery date for walkers?
examples.zh: 您要求助行器何时交付？

examples.en: Please clarify the hospital bed requested delivery date.
examples.zh: 请明确病床要求交付日期。

examples.en: We need to know whether the wheelchair requested delivery date means dispatch or arrival.
examples.zh: 需要明确轮椅要求交付日期指发货还是抵达。

examples.en: Our planner will assess the patient lift requested delivery date against current material availability.
examples.zh: 计划员将结合当前物料可用性评估移位机要求交付日期。

examples.en: Before accepting the requested delivery date for the nursing care beds, we should confirm the delivery definition and review production, inspection, and transport assumptions with the buyer.
examples.zh: 接受护理床要求交付日期前，应与买方确认交付定义，并评审生产、检验及运输假设条件。

examples.en: Has the confirmed dispatch date for these wheelchairs changed?
examples.zh: 这批轮椅已确认的发货日期有变化吗？

examples.en: The walker confirmed dispatch date needs written confirmation.
examples.zh: 助行器已确认发货日期需要书面确认。

examples.en: Our patient lift update distinguishes the confirmed dispatch date from the vessel's estimated departure.
examples.zh: 移位机更新区分已确认发货日期与船舶预计离港时间。

examples.en: Please notify the buyer if anything threatens the hospital bed confirmed dispatch date.
examples.zh: 如有情况影响病床已确认发货日期，请通知买方。

examples.en: If a final inspection concern threatens the care bed confirmed dispatch date, we must assess disposition and release requirements before agreeing to a revised shipping arrangement.
examples.zh: 若最终检验问题影响护理床已确认发货日期，必须先评估处置及放行要求，再同意修改运输安排。

examples.en: Please review the patient lift order confirmation.
examples.zh: 请评审移位机订单确认书。

examples.en: The walker order confirmation includes packaging details.
examples.zh: 助行器订单确认书包含包装细节。

examples.en: Our hospital bed order confirmation identifies the approved configuration and commercial terms clearly.
examples.zh: 病床订单确认书明确标注批准配置及商务条款。

examples.en: Please report any wheelchair order confirmation discrepancies before purchasing releases the component orders.
examples.zh: 采购下达零件订单前，请反馈轮椅订单确认书的差异。

examples.en: Before scheduling the care bed batch, both parties should check the order confirmation against the final quotation and resolve any differences in quantity, specifications, payment, or delivery.
examples.zh: 安排护理床批次前，双方应按最终报价核对订单确认书，并解决数量、规格、付款或交付方面的差异。

examples.en: Please send the purchase order for these crutches.
examples.zh: 请发送这批拐杖的采购订单。

examples.en: The hospital bed PO needs a revision.
examples.zh: 病床采购订单需要修订。

examples.en: Your wheelchair purchase order should identify the agreed specification and quotation reference.
examples.zh: 轮椅采购订单应注明约定规格及报价编号。

examples.en: We will check the patient lift PO before confirming the production schedule in writing.
examples.zh: 书面确认生产排期前，我们将核查移位机采购订单。

examples.en: If the care bed purchase order differs from the approved quotation, we should resolve the discrepancies and obtain a revised PO before procurement commits to the affected components.
examples.zh: 若护理床采购订单与批准报价不同，应先解决差异并取得修订订单，再由采购承诺受影响零件的采购。

examples.en: Can you review this rush order for walkers?
examples.zh: 您能评估这笔助行器加急订单吗？

examples.en: The wheelchair rush order needs planning approval.
examples.zh: 轮椅加急订单需要计划批准。

examples.en: We will assess patient lift material availability before accepting the proposed rush order.
examples.zh: 接受拟定加急订单前，我们将评估移位机物料可用性。

examples.en: Please confirm whether the hospital bed rush order allows standard packaging and configuration.
examples.zh: 请确认病床加急订单是否接受标准包装及配置。

examples.en: If we accept a rush order for the care beds, the recovery arrangement must preserve the agreed inspection and release requirements rather than bypassing them to save time.
examples.zh: 若接受护理床加急订单，赶工安排必须保留约定的检验和放行要求，不能为节省时间而跳过。

zh: 已接受但尚待补供的订单或数量

examples.en: The wheelchair footrests remain on backorder today.
examples.zh: 轮椅脚托今天仍待补供。

examples.en: Please confirm the walker backorder quantity first.
examples.zh: 请先确认助行器待补供数量。

examples.en: Our care bed update lists the backorder separately from the quantities ready for inspection.
examples.zh: 护理床更新将待补供量与可验货数量分开列出。

examples.en: Please agree a patient lift backorder schedule before confirming any proposed partial shipment.
examples.zh: 确认拟定部分装运前，请先约定移位机补供排期。

examples.en: If the manual wheelchair order includes a backorder, we should state the affected quantities and proposed completion dates clearly so the buyer can review the delivery plan.
examples.zh: 若手动轮椅订单包含待补供部分，应明确受影响数量及拟定完成日期，让买方评审交付计划。

examples.en: Please identify the walker frame raw material.
examples.zh: 请确认助行架车架原材料。

examples.en: The wheelchair raw material is awaiting incoming inspection.
examples.zh: 轮椅原材料正等待来料检验。

examples.en: We need the approved raw material specification before purchasing hospital bed frame tubes.
examples.zh: 采购病床车架管材前，需要批准的原材料规范。

examples.en: Please retain patient lift raw material batch records for the planned traceability review.
examples.zh: 请保留移位机原材料批次记录，以便计划中的追溯评审。

examples.en: If a supplier proposes a different raw material for the crutches, engineering must assess the specification and required checks before the change is approved for production.
examples.zh: 若供应商建议拐杖改用其他原材料，工程部门必须评估规范及所需检查，再批准投入生产。

examples.en: Please identify this hospital bed component first.
examples.zh: 请先确认这个病床零件。

examples.en: The wheelchair component label shows its batch.
examples.zh: 轮椅零件标签标明其批次。

examples.en: Our patient lift component list identifies approved suppliers and applicable drawing revisions.
examples.zh: 移位机零件清单注明批准供应商及适用图纸版次。

examples.en: Please review the care bed component sample before authorizing the supplier change.
examples.zh: 授权供应商变更前，请评审护理床零件样品。

examples.en: If the walker component differs from the approved sample, production should segregate the affected stock and request a documented disposition before using it in an assembly.
examples.zh: 若助行器零件与批准样品不同，生产应隔离受影响库存，并在装配使用前申请书面处置决定。

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair bill of materials.
examples.zh: 请核对轮椅物料清单。

examples.en: The care bed BOM needs a revision.
examples.zh: 护理床物料清单需要修订。

examples.en: Our patient lift bill of materials identifies the components required for each approved configuration.
examples.zh: 移位机物料清单注明各批准配置所需的零件。

examples.en: Please compare the hospital bed BOM with the quotation before releasing purchasing requirements.
examples.zh: 下达采购需求前，请将病床物料清单与报价比较。

examples.en: If the wheelchair configuration changes after approval, engineering must update the bill of materials so purchasing and assembly do not continue using the superseded component list.
examples.zh: 若轮椅配置在批准后变更，工程部门必须更新物料清单，避免采购和装配继续使用失效零件清单。

examples.en: Please check material availability for these walkers.
examples.zh: 请检查这批助行器的物料可用性。

examples.en: Wheelchair material availability affects our production estimate.
examples.zh: 轮椅物料可用性影响生产估算。

examples.en: Our planner reviews care bed material availability before offering a firm completion date.
examples.zh: 计划员在提供确定完工日期前评审核理床物料可用性。

examples.en: Please include patient lift material availability in the weekly production update to sales.
examples.zh: 请在给销售的每周生产更新中列明移位机物料可用情况。

examples.en: If material availability changes for the hospital bed order, planning must assess the impact on assembly and inspection before confirming a revised delivery estimate to the customer.
examples.zh: 若病床订单物料可用情况变化，计划部门必须先评估对装配和检验的影响，再向客户确认修改交期估计。

examples.en: The walker order has a material shortage.
examples.zh: 这笔助行器订单存在缺料。

examples.en: Please identify the wheelchair material shortage quantity.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅缺料数量。

examples.en: Our care bed production update explains which approved components caused the material shortage.
examples.zh: 护理床生产更新说明哪些批准零件造成缺料。

examples.en: We will review patient lift alternatives without accepting unapproved substitutions during a material shortage.
examples.zh: 缺料期间，我们会评估移位机替代方案，但不会接受未批准替代件。

examples.en: If the hospital bed material shortage threatens the agreed schedule, purchasing and planning should review recovery options and communicate a realistic revised estimate after internal approval.
examples.zh: 若病床缺料影响约定排期，采购及计划部门应评估补救方案，并在内部批准后告知合理的修改估计。

zh: 库存，范围取决于统计口径

examples.en: Please check inventory of patient lift batteries.
examples.zh: 请检查移位机电池库存。

examples.en: The walker inventory report needs updating today.
examples.zh: 助行器库存报告今天需要更新。

examples.en: Our hospital bed inventory figures distinguish released components from stock awaiting quality review.
examples.zh: 病床库存数据区分已放行零件与待质量评审库存。

examples.en: Please reconcile wheelchair inventory before accepting an urgent spare parts delivery request.
examples.zh: 接受紧急备件交付要求前，请核对轮椅库存。

examples.en: If the care bed inventory includes several component revisions, the warehouse must identify their status clearly so production selects only parts approved for the scheduled configuration.
examples.zh: 若护理床库存包含多个零件版次，仓库必须明确标示状态，确保生产仅选用排定配置获批的零件。

examples.en: What is our stock on hand for crutches?
examples.zh: 我们的拐杖现有库存是多少？

examples.en: Please verify wheelchair caster stock on hand.
examples.zh: 请核实轮椅脚轮现有库存。

examples.en: The patient lift stock on hand report should identify quantities already allocated to orders.
examples.zh: 移位机现有库存报告应注明已分配订单数量。

examples.en: We need care bed motor stock on hand before reviewing the proposed assembly sequence.
examples.zh: 评审拟定装配顺序前，需要护理床电机现有库存数据。

examples.en: Before promising an immediate walker shipment, confirm that the stock on hand is released, correctly configured, and not already allocated to another customer's confirmed order.
examples.zh: 承诺立即发运助行器前，请确认现有库存已放行、配置正确，且尚未分配给其他客户的已确认订单。

examples.en: Please review safety stock for wheelchair casters.
examples.zh: 请评估轮椅脚轮安全库存。

examples.en: Our crutch tip safety stock needs replenishment.
examples.zh: 拐杖脚垫安全库存需要补充。

examples.en: Purchasing reviews patient lift battery safety stock against demand and supplier lead times.
examples.zh: 采购根据需求及供应商交期评估移位机电池安全库存。

examples.en: Please distinguish care bed motor safety stock from quantities reserved for confirmed orders.
examples.zh: 请区分护理床电机安全库存与已确认订单预留数量。

examples.en: If walker demand changes significantly, planning should review the safety stock assumptions and agree a revised replenishment approach rather than treating the previous stock target as permanent.
examples.zh: 若助行器需求显著变化，计划部门应评估安全库存假设并约定新的补货方案，不把原库存目标视为永久不变。

examples.en: Please count the wheelchair work in progress.
examples.zh: 请清点轮椅在制品。

examples.en: The walker WIP report shows assembly status.
examples.zh: 助行器在制品报告显示装配状态。

examples.en: Our care bed work in progress update separates fabricated frames from assembled units.
examples.zh: 护理床在制品更新区分已加工车架与已装配设备。

examples.en: Please include patient lift WIP quantities when reviewing the remaining production workload.
examples.zh: 评估剩余生产工作量时，请计入移位机在制数量。

examples.en: If the hospital bed WIP includes units awaiting corrective work, the progress report should identify them separately so sales does not confuse unfinished work with releasable stock.
examples.zh: 若病床在制品中包含待纠正加工设备，进度报告应单独注明，避免销售将未完成工作误当作可放行库存。

examples.en: These hospital beds are recorded as finished goods.
examples.zh: 这批病床已记为产成品。

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair finished goods identification.
examples.zh: 请检查轮椅产成品标识。

examples.en: Our care bed finished goods report distinguishes production completion from authorized shipment release.
examples.zh: 护理床产成品报告区分生产完工与授权出货放行。

examples.en: The walker finished goods area should keep different order configurations clearly identified.
examples.zh: 助行器产成品区域应清晰区分不同订单配置。

examples.en: Before arranging the patient lift collection, confirm that the finished goods have completed the required review and that the identified units are authorized for shipment.
examples.zh: 安排移位机提货前，请确认产成品已完成所需审核，且已识别的设备获得出货授权。

examples.en: Please identify this production batch of walkers.
examples.zh: 请确认这批助行器生产批次。

examples.en: The wheelchair batch is awaiting final inspection.
examples.zh: 这批轮椅正等待最终检验。

examples.en: Our patient lift production batch record links assembly activities with the relevant component lots.
examples.zh: 移位机生产批次记录关联装配活动及相关零件批次。

examples.en: Please state the affected care bed batch when reporting a recurring coating concern.
examples.zh: 反馈重复涂层问题时，请注明受影响的护理床批次。

examples.en: If inspection identifies a concern within a hospital bed production batch, quality staff should assess the affected scope and document the disposition before any shipment release decision.
examples.zh: 若检验发现病床生产批次存在问题，质量人员应评估影响范围，并在决定出货放行前记录处置决定。

examples.en: Please record the walker tube lot number.
examples.zh: 请记录助行架管材批号。

examples.en: The wheelchair component label shows its lot number.
examples.zh: 轮椅零件标签标明批号。

examples.en: We use the patient lift battery lot number to locate the incoming inspection record.
examples.zh: 我们用移位机电池批号查找来料检验记录。

examples.en: Please include the hospital bed coating lot number in the quality complaint email.
examples.zh: 请在质量投诉邮件中注明病床涂料批号。

examples.en: If several care bed parts share the same lot number, quality staff can compare their records to determine whether the reported issue requires a broader batch investigation.
examples.zh: 若多件护理床零件具有相同批号，质量人员可比较记录，以判断所反馈问题是否需要扩大批次调查。

examples.en: The care bed assembly line needs components.
examples.zh: 护理床装配线需要零件。

examples.en: Please visit the manual wheelchair assembly line.
examples.zh: 请参观手动轮椅装配线。
