examples.en: Our patient lift assembly line uses the work instructions approved for the scheduled configuration.
examples.zh: 移位机装配线使用适用于排定配置的批准作业指导书。

examples.en: Please confirm walker component readiness before adding another order to the assembly line.
examples.zh: 将另一订单安排进装配线前，请确认助行器零件齐备。

examples.en: If the hospital bed assembly line changes to a different model, supervisors must verify the required documents and fixtures before authorizing the first units for regular production.
examples.zh: 若病床装配线切换型号，主管必须核实所需文件和工装，再授权首批设备进入常规生产。

examples.en: Please inspect the wheelchair brake assembly workstation.
examples.zh: 请检查轮椅制动器装配工位。

examples.en: This workstation is assigned to walker assembly.
examples.zh: 这个工位用于助行器装配。

examples.en: The hospital bed workstation should display the current drawing and approved assembly instructions.
examples.zh: 病床工位应展示现行图纸及批准装配说明。

examples.en: Our patient lift workstation review checks tool identification and component revision control.
examples.zh: 移位机工位评审检查工具标识及零件版本控制。

examples.en: Before introducing a new care bed configuration at the workstation, the supervisor should confirm operator training and ensure the correct parts and instructions are available.
examples.zh: 在工位引入新的护理床配置前，主管应确认操作培训，并确保正确零件和作业说明均已到位。

examples.en: Please review production capacity for manual wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请评估手动轮椅生产能力。

examples.en: Our walker production capacity depends on scheduling.
examples.zh: 助行器产能取决于排期。

examples.en: We need hospital bed production capacity data before accepting the proposed monthly order volume.
examples.zh: 接受拟定月度订单量前，需要病床产能数据。

examples.en: Please distinguish total production capacity from capacity already committed to other care bed orders.
examples.zh: 请区分总产能与已承诺其他护理床订单的产能。

examples.en: If the distributor proposes a larger patient lift forecast, planning must review production capacity, component supply, and inspection resources before confirming achievable delivery volumes.
examples.zh: 若经销商提出更大的移位机预测量，计划部门必须评估产能、零件供应及检验资源，再确认可实现交付量。

examples.en: Please review capacity allocation for hospital beds.
examples.zh: 请评审病床产能分配。

examples.en: Wheelchair capacity allocation needs an updated plan.
examples.zh: 轮椅产能分配需要更新计划。

examples.en: Our planner checks walker capacity allocation before inserting an additional urgent order.
examples.zh: 计划员安排额外急单前，会核对助行器产能分配。

examples.en: Please explain how the revised care bed capacity allocation affects existing order commitments.
examples.zh: 请说明修改的护理床产能分配如何影响现有订单承诺。

examples.en: If sales requests different patient lift capacity allocation, planning should compare order priorities and resource constraints before obtaining approval for any change to the committed production schedule.
examples.zh: 若销售要求调整移位机产能分配，计划部门应比较订单优先级及资源限制，再取得承诺生产排期变更的批准。

examples.en: Wheelchair frame welding is the current bottleneck.
examples.zh: 轮椅车架焊接是当前瓶颈。

examples.en: Please identify the hospital bed assembly bottleneck.
examples.zh: 请找出病床装配瓶颈。

examples.en: Our walker production review uses recorded cycle times to investigate the suspected bottleneck.
examples.zh: 助行器生产评审利用记录的节拍调查疑似瓶颈。

examples.en: We will review the care bed bottleneck before committing to an earlier completion date.
examples.zh: 承诺提前完工前，我们会评估护理床瓶颈环节。

examples.en: If patient lift testing becomes a bottleneck, the recovery plan should assess qualified resources and workflow improvements while preserving the agreed test coverage and release requirements.
examples.zh: 若移位机测试成为瓶颈，赶工方案应评估合格资源和流程改进，同时保留约定测试范围及放行要求。

examples.en: Please review line balancing for walker assembly.
examples.zh: 请评估助行器装配线平衡。

examples.en: Wheelchair line balancing may improve workflow consistency.
examples.zh: 轮椅产线平衡可能改善流程稳定性。

examples.en: Our care bed line balancing review compares workloads across the defined assembly workstations.
examples.zh: 护理床产线平衡评审比较各规定装配工位的工作负荷。

examples.en: Please record cycle times before proposing line balancing changes for the patient lift line.
examples.zh: 提出移位机产线平衡调整前，请记录各工序节拍。

examples.en: If line balancing changes the hospital bed assembly sequence, the proposed workflow must be reviewed so required checks remain at appropriate stages and responsibilities are clearly assigned.
examples.zh: 若产线平衡改变病床装配顺序，必须评审拟定流程，确保所需检查仍处于适当阶段且责任明确。

examples.en: The wheelchair line needs a model changeover.
examples.zh: 轮椅产线需要换型。

examples.en: Please prepare the walker changeover checklist first.
examples.zh: 请先准备助行器换型检查表。

examples.en: Our hospital bed changeover includes checking fixtures, component revisions, and approved work instructions.
examples.zh: 病床换型包括检查夹具、零件版次及批准作业指导书。

examples.en: Please allow patient lift changeover time when estimating completion of the following order.
examples.zh: 估算下一订单完成时间时，请计入移位机换型时间。

examples.en: Before authorizing the care bed line after changeover, the supervisor should confirm the correct setup and obtain the required first-piece inspection results for the scheduled configuration.
examples.zh: 换型后授权护理床产线生产前，主管应确认设置正确，并取得排定配置所需的首件检验结果。

examples.en: Please record downtime on the walker line.
examples.zh: 请记录助行器产线停线时间。

examples.en: The wheelchair downtime report identifies the affected station.
examples.zh: 轮椅停线报告注明受影响工位。

examples.en: Our care bed production update explains how recorded downtime affects the remaining assembly plan.
examples.zh: 护理床生产更新说明已记录停线如何影响后续装配计划。

examples.en: Please distinguish planned hospital bed maintenance from unexpected downtime in the daily report.
examples.zh: 请在日报中区分计划病床设备维护与非预期停线。

examples.en: If patient lift line downtime threatens the agreed completion date, planning must review the recovery options and obtain approval before communicating a revised commitment to the buyer.
examples.zh: 若移位机产线停线影响约定完工日，计划部门必须先评估补救方案并获批准，再向买方作出修改承诺。

examples.en: Please expedite the care bed motor delivery.
examples.zh: 请加快护理床电机交付。

examples.en: Can you expedite the walker sample review?
examples.zh: 您能加快助行器样品评审吗？

examples.en: We can ask purchasing to expedite approved components for the hospital bed order.
examples.zh: 我们可要求采购催办病床订单的批准零件。

examples.en: Please confirm extra freight costs before asking the supplier to expedite wheelchair parts.
examples.zh: 要求供应商加急轮椅零件前，请确认额外运费。

examples.en: If you ask us to expedite the patient lift order, we will review material and production options without bypassing the agreed inspection steps or final release requirements.
examples.zh: 若要求我们加急移位机订单，我们会评估物料和生产方案，但不跳过约定检验步骤或最终放行要求。

examples.en: Please prioritize the hospital bed sample review.
examples.zh: 请优先安排病床样品评审。

examples.en: Can purchasing prioritize these approved wheelchair components?
examples.zh: 采购能优先处理这些批准的轮椅零件吗？

examples.en: Our planner will review whether to prioritize the walker order within existing commitments.
examples.zh: 计划员将评估能否在现有承诺内优先安排助行器订单。

examples.en: Please explain the customer deadline before requesting approval to prioritize the care bed batch.
examples.zh: 申请优先安排护理床批次前，请说明客户截止时间。

examples.en: If we prioritize the patient lift trial order, planning should document the authorized sequence and confirm that the change does not create unreviewed delays for other committed orders.
examples.zh: 若优先安排移位机试单，计划部门应记录获授权的顺序，并确认变更不会给其他已承诺订单造成未经评审的延误。

examples.en: The wheelchair team proposed an overtime shift.
examples.zh: 轮椅团队提出安排加班班次。

examples.en: Please review the walker overtime shift plan.
examples.zh: 请评审助行器加班班次计划。

examples.en: Our care bed overtime shift proposal includes supervision and the required inspection resources.
examples.zh: 护理床加班班次方案包含主管及所需检验资源安排。

examples.en: An overtime shift cannot replace the required checks on the patient lift assembly line.
examples.zh: 加班班次不能替代移位机装配线所需检查。

examples.en: Before approving an overtime shift for the hospital bed order, management should review staffing, inspection support, and realistic output rather than assuming all lost production can be recovered immediately.
examples.zh: 批准病床订单加班前，管理层应评估人员、检验支持及合理产量，不能假定全部损失产量能立即补回。

zh: 恢复原计划或追回进度的方案

examples.en: Please send the walker order recovery plan.
examples.zh: 请发送助行器订单赶工方案。

examples.en: The wheelchair recovery plan needs planning approval.
examples.zh: 轮椅赶工方案需要计划批准。

examples.en: Our care bed recovery plan identifies revised activities, responsibilities, and achievable completion milestones.
examples.zh: 护理床赶工方案列明调整活动、责任及可实现的完成节点。

examples.en: Please review the patient lift recovery plan before promising a new dispatch date.
examples.zh: 承诺新的发货日期前，请评审移位机赶工方案。

examples.en: If the hospital bed recovery plan relies on an alternative component supplier, engineering and quality must approve the proposed parts before purchasing treats that option as confirmed.
examples.zh: 若病床赶工方案依赖替代零件供应商，工程和质量部门必须批准拟用零件后，采购才能将该方案视为已确认。

examples.en: Please approve the revised schedule for walkers.
examples.zh: 请批准助行器调整后的排期。

examples.en: The hospital bed revised schedule includes inspection.
examples.zh: 病床修改排期包括检验。

examples.en: Our wheelchair revised schedule identifies which dates are estimates and which are confirmed commitments.
examples.zh: 轮椅修改排期区分估计日期与已确认承诺日期。

examples.en: Please email the patient lift revised schedule after reviewing the supplier's latest component dates.
examples.zh: 评审供应商最新零件日期后，请通过邮件发送移位机修改排期。

examples.en: Before accepting the revised schedule for the care beds, both parties should check the production milestones and shipping assumptions so the update does not create conflicting expectations.
examples.zh: 接受护理床修改排期前，双方应核查生产节点及运输假设，避免更新造成相互矛盾的期望。

examples.en: Would a partial shipment help your wheelchair order?
examples.zh: 部分装运是否有助于贵轮椅订单？

examples.en: Please approve the walker partial shipment quantities.
examples.zh: 请批准助行器部分装运数量。

examples.en: Our care bed partial shipment proposal identifies available units and the remaining balance.
examples.zh: 护理床部分装运方案注明可供数量及剩余数量。

examples.en: Please confirm additional freight costs before agreeing to a partial shipment of patient lifts.
examples.zh: 同意移位机部分装运前，请确认额外运费。

examples.en: If you approve a partial shipment of hospital beds, we should record the split quantities, remaining completion estimate, documentation requirements, and agreed responsibility for any additional transport costs.
examples.zh: 若批准病床部分装运，应记录拆分数量、剩余部分预计完工时间、文件要求及额外运输费用的约定责任。

examples.en: Please review the care bed shipment split.
examples.zh: 请评审核理床装运拆分方案。

examples.en: The wheelchair shipment split needs buyer approval.
examples.zh: 轮椅装运拆分方案需要买方批准。

examples.en: Our patient lift shipment split lists each dispatch quantity and the associated packing documents.
examples.zh: 移位机装运拆分方案列明各次发货数量及对应包装文件。

examples.en: Please compare freight options before confirming the proposed shipment split for your walkers.
examples.zh: 确认拟定助行器装运拆分方案前，请比较运费方案。

examples.en: If the hospital bed shipment split changes after booking, logistics must coordinate revised documents and collection arrangements so the buyer and forwarder receive consistent quantities and dates.
examples.zh: 若病床订舱后变更装运拆分方案，物流必须协调修改文件和提货安排，确保买方及货代收到一致数量和日期。

examples.en: These manual wheelchairs are ready for inspection.
examples.zh: 这批手动轮椅已具备验货条件。

examples.en: Are the patient lifts ready for inspection?
examples.zh: 这批移位机可以验货了吗？

examples.en: Our care bed update states which quantities are ready for inspection under the agreed conditions.
examples.zh: 护理床更新说明按约定条件哪些数量已具备验货条件。

examples.en: Please confirm that the walker samples and documents are ready for inspection before booking.
examples.zh: 预约前，请确认助行器样品及文件已具备验货条件。

examples.en: Before telling the buyer that the hospital beds are ready for inspection, we should verify the agreed inspection stage, available quantities, required documents, and access arrangements.
examples.zh: 告知买方病床已具备验货条件前，应核实约定检验阶段、可检数量、所需文件及进入现场安排。

zh: 货物备妥日期，须约定“备妥”的条件

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair cargo ready date.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅货物备妥日期。

examples.en: The care bed CRD is still estimated.
examples.zh: 护理床货妥日期目前仍为估计。

examples.en: Our patient lift cargo ready date depends on completion of the agreed release activities.
examples.zh: 移位机货妥日期取决于约定放行活动的完成。

examples.en: Please define cargo ready date conditions before arranging the hospital bed forwarder collection.
examples.zh: 安排病床货代提货前，请明确货妥日期的判定条件。

examples.en: If the walker cargo ready date changes, we should notify the buyer and forwarder promptly and clarify whether inspection, documentation, or collection readiness caused the revision.
examples.zh: 若助行器货妥日期变化，应及时通知买方及货代，并说明修订源于检验、文件还是提货准备情况。

examples.en: The walker component delivery has been delayed.
examples.zh: 助行器零件交货已延迟。

examples.en: Please explain the delay in wheelchair assembly.
examples.zh: 请说明轮椅装配延迟的原因。

examples.en: Our care bed delay update identifies the affected activity and the current recovery estimate.
examples.zh: 护理床延期更新注明受影响活动及当前补救估计。

examples.en: Please avoid promising a new patient lift date until the delay assessment is complete.
examples.zh: 延期评估完成前，请勿承诺新的移位机日期。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order is delayed, we should explain the confirmed cause, review realistic recovery options, and obtain approval before making a revised delivery commitment.
examples.zh: 若病床订单延迟，应说明已确认原因、评估合理补救方案，并在获得批准后再作修改交付承诺。

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair shipment ETD today.
examples.zh: 请今天核查轮椅货物预计离港时间。

examples.en: The hospital bed vessel ETD has changed.
examples.zh: 病床所订船舶预计离港时间已变化。

examples.en: Our patient lift shipping update separates the vessel ETD from the factory dispatch date.
examples.zh: 移位机运输更新区分船舶预计离港时间与工厂发货日。

examples.en: Please confirm the estimated time of departure with the forwarder handling the walker shipment.
examples.zh: 请向负责助行器货物的货代确认预计离港时间。

examples.en: If the care bed vessel ETD changes after booking, logistics should obtain the latest carrier information and inform the buyer without presenting an estimate as a guaranteed departure.
examples.zh: 若护理床船舶订舱后预计离港时间变化，物流应取得承运人最新信息并通知买方，不把估计视为保证离港日期。

examples.en: Please confirm the hospital bed shipment ETA.
examples.zh: 请确认病床货物预计抵达时间。

examples.en: The wheelchair vessel ETA is an estimate.
examples.zh: 轮椅所订船舶抵达时间是估计值。

examples.en: Our care bed shipping email states the latest estimated time of arrival from the forwarder.
examples.zh: 护理床运输邮件列明货代提供的最新预计抵达时间。

examples.en: Please distinguish the patient lift vessel ETA from delivery to the customer's warehouse.
examples.zh: 请区分移位机船舶预计到港时间与送达客户仓库的时间。

examples.en: When communicating the walker shipment ETA, explain that customs clearance and inland delivery may require additional time, rather than promising warehouse receipt on the vessel's arrival date.
examples.zh: 说明助行器货物预计到港时间时，应解释清关及内陆配送可能另需时间，不承诺船舶到港当日即仓库收货。

examples.en: The wheelchair needs order review and specification confirmation.
examples.zh: 轮椅需要订单评审与规格确认。

examples.en: Please finish order review and specification confirmation for walkers.
examples.zh: 请完成助行器订单评审与规格确认。

examples.en: Our care bed order review and specification confirmation identify unresolved drawing and accessory questions.
examples.zh: 护理床订单评审与规格确认识别未解决的图纸及配件问题。

examples.en: Please record patient lift order review and specification confirmation before releasing purchasing requirements.
examples.zh: 下达采购需求前，请记录移位机订单评审与规格确认。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer changes the configuration, repeat the affected order review and specification confirmation activities so production does not rely on superseded commercial or technical requirements.
examples.zh: 若病床买方修改配置，应重新开展受影响的订单评审与规格确认，避免生产依赖失效的商务或技术要求。

examples.en: Please review material planning and purchasing for wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请评估轮椅物料计划与采购。

examples.en: The walker order needs material planning and purchasing.
examples.zh: 助行器订单需要物料计划与采购。

examples.en: Our hospital bed material planning and purchasing process follows the approved component list.
examples.zh: 病床物料计划与采购流程遵循批准的零件清单。

examples.en: Please include patient lift supplier lead times in material planning and purchasing discussions.
examples.zh: 讨论物料计划与采购时，请计入移位机供应商交期。

examples.en: Before confirming the care bed production schedule, material planning and purchasing should review component availability and approved alternatives so unresolved supply risks are communicated to the planner.
examples.zh: 确认护理床生产排期前，物料计划与采购应评估零件可用性及批准替代方案，并向计划员传达未解决供应风险。

examples.en: Please complete incoming inspection and material release for walkers.
examples.zh: 请完成助行器来料检验及物料放行。

examples.en: Wheelchair tubes await incoming inspection and material release.
examples.zh: 轮椅管材正等待来料检验及物料放行。

examples.en: Our patient lift records identify who authorized incoming inspection and material release activities.
examples.zh: 移位机记录注明来料检验及物料放行活动的授权人。

examples.en: Please keep hospital bed components segregated until incoming inspection and material release are complete.
examples.zh: 来料检验及物料放行完成前，请隔离存放病床零件。

examples.en: If the care bed supplier changes a component revision, incoming inspection and material release must reference the approved update rather than accepting parts solely because their delivery is urgent.
examples.zh: 若护理床供应商变更零件版次，来料检验及物料放行必须引用批准更新，不能仅因交货紧急就接受零件。

examples.en: Wheelchair frames need fabrication and surface treatment.
examples.zh: 轮椅车架需要加工及表面处理。

examples.en: Please review walker fabrication and surface treatment.
examples.zh: 请评估助行器加工及表面处理。

examples.en: Our hospital bed fabrication and surface treatment records identify the approved process requirements.
examples.zh: 病床加工及表面处理记录注明批准的工艺要求。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift drawing revisions before arranging fabrication and surface treatment activities.
examples.zh: 安排加工及表面处理前，请确认移位机图纸版次。

examples.en: If fabrication and surface treatment reveal a recurring defect on care bed frames, engineering and quality should investigate the cause before approving changes to the controlled process.
examples.zh: 若护理床车架加工及表面处理发现重复缺陷，工程和质量部门应先调查原因，再批准受控工艺变更。

examples.en: Please review wheelchair assembly and in-process checks.
examples.zh: 请评估轮椅装配及过程检查。

examples.en: The care beds need assembly and in-process checks.
examples.zh: 这批护理床需要装配及过程检查。

examples.en: Our patient lift assembly and in-process checks follow the approved work instructions and inspection plan.
examples.zh: 移位机装配及过程检查遵循批准的作业指导书和检验计划。

examples.en: Please record walker assembly and in-process checks before moving units to final inspection.
examples.zh: 助行器转入最终检验前，请记录装配及过程检查。

examples.en: If a hospital bed component changes during production, supervisors must update the affected assembly and in-process checks so operators and inspectors apply the same approved requirements.
examples.zh: 若病床零件在生产期间变更，主管必须更新受影响的装配及过程检查，确保操作员与检验员采用相同批准要求。

examples.en: The walkers await final inspection and packing.
examples.zh: 这批助行器正等待最终检验及包装。

examples.en: Please schedule hospital bed final inspection and packing.
examples.zh: 请安排病床最终检验及包装。

examples.en: Our wheelchair final inspection and packing records identify the checked units and approved labels.
examples.zh: 轮椅最终检验及包装记录注明受检设备和批准标签。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed accessories before starting final inspection and packing for the order.
examples.zh: 开始订单最终检验及包装前，请确认护理床配件。

examples.en: If the buyer revises the patient lift packaging requirements, the final inspection and packing plan must be reviewed so the correct accessories and documents accompany each unit.
examples.zh: 若买方修改移位机包装要求，必须评审最终检验及包装计划，确保每台设备随附正确配件和文件。

examples.en: The wheelchairs await final review and shipment release.
examples.zh: 这批轮椅正等待最终审核及出货放行。

examples.en: Please complete walker final review and shipment release.
examples.zh: 请完成助行器最终审核及出货放行。

examples.en: Our hospital bed final review and shipment release require the specified records and authorizations.
examples.zh: 病床最终审核及出货放行需要规定记录和授权。

examples.en: Please distinguish care bed packing completion from final review and shipment release approval.
examples.zh: 请区分护理床包装完成与最终审核及出货放行批准。

examples.en: If an open patient lift issue remains unresolved, the responsible team must assess its disposition during final review and shipment release rather than assuming packing completion permits dispatch.
examples.zh: 若移位机仍有未解决问题，责任团队必须在最终审核及出货放行中评估处置，不能认为包装完成即可发货。

examples.en: Please arrange dispatch and shipment follow-up for walkers.
examples.zh: 请安排助行器发运及物流跟进。

examples.en: The wheelchair order needs dispatch and shipment follow-up.
examples.zh: 轮椅订单需要发运及物流跟进。

examples.en: Our care bed dispatch and shipment follow-up email includes the approved collection details.
examples.zh: 护理床发运及物流跟进邮件包含批准的提货资料。

examples.en: Please identify the logistics contact responsible for hospital bed dispatch and shipment follow-up.
examples.zh: 请明确负责病床发运及物流跟进的物流联系人。

examples.en: If the patient lift carrier changes its schedule, the team handling dispatch and shipment follow-up should obtain updated information and communicate the effect on the buyer's shipping plan.
examples.zh: 若移位机承运人改变运输排期，负责发运及物流跟进的团队应取得最新资料，并告知对买方运输计划的影响。

examples.en: Please review quality control for walker assembly.
examples.zh: 请评估助行器装配质量控制。

examples.en: The hospital bed QC checklist needs updating.
examples.zh: 病床质量控制表需要更新。

examples.en: Our patient lift quality control activities include the checks specified in the approved inspection plan.
examples.zh: 移位机质量控制活动包括批准检验计划规定的检查。

examples.en: Please send wheelchair quality control records when the customer requests evidence of inspection.
examples.zh: 客户要求检验证据时，请发送轮椅质量控制记录。

examples.en: If quality control identifies a recurring care bed defect, the responsible team should review the affected scope and investigate its cause before approving corrective measures and shipment disposition.
examples.zh: 若质量控制发现护理床重复缺陷，责任团队应评估影响范围并调查原因，再批准纠正措施及出货处置决定。

examples.en: Please explain the walker quality assurance process.
examples.zh: 请解释助行器质量保证流程。

examples.en: The wheelchair QA review includes document control.
examples.zh: 轮椅质量保证评审涵盖文件控制。

examples.en: Our hospital bed quality assurance review checks whether responsibilities and records follow the defined system.
examples.zh: 病床质量保证评审核查责任及记录是否遵循规定体系。

examples.en: Please distinguish patient lift quality assurance activities from individual finished-product inspection results.
examples.zh: 请区分移位机质量保证活动与单台成品检验结果。

examples.en: When the care bed buyer asks about quality assurance, explain the documented system and relevant evidence rather than suggesting that a system review guarantees every unit is defect-free.
examples.zh: 护理床买方询问质量保证时，应解释文件规定体系及相关证据，不能暗示体系评审保证每台产品均无缺陷。

examples.en: Please arrange QC inspection for these wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请安排这批轮椅质量检验。

examples.en: The walker QC inspection report is ready.
examples.zh: 助行器质量检验报告已备妥。

examples.en: Our patient lift QC inspection checklist refers to the approved product specification and drawing.
examples.zh: 移位机质量检验表依据批准的产品规格和图纸。

examples.en: Please confirm the hospital bed QC inspection scope before booking the third-party inspector.
examples.zh: 预约第三方检验员前，请确认病床质量检验范围。

examples.en: If the care bed QC inspection finds a nonconformity, quality staff must document the result and required disposition before the affected units can receive shipment release authorization.
examples.zh: 若护理床质量检验发现不符合，质量人员必须记录结果及所需处置，然后受影响设备才能获得出货放行授权。

examples.en: Please review incoming quality control for wheelchair parts.
examples.zh: 请评估轮椅零件来料质量控制。

examples.en: The care bed motors are awaiting IQC.
examples.zh: 护理床电机正等待来料质量控制。

examples.en: Our patient lift incoming quality control records identify the checked batch and acceptance criteria.
examples.zh: 移位机来料质量控制记录注明受检批次及验收准则。

examples.en: Please keep walker components on hold until the required IQC review is complete.
examples.zh: 所需来料质量控制审核完成前，请暂停放行助行器零件。

examples.en: If incoming quality control finds a dimensional concern in hospital bed components, the affected stock should remain identified and segregated until the authorized review determines its disposition.
examples.zh: 若来料质量控制发现病床零件尺寸问题，受影响库存应保持标识和隔离，直至授权评审确定处置方式。

examples.en: IPQC checks wheelchair frames during production.
examples.zh: 制程质检在生产过程中检查轮椅车架。

examples.en: Does IPQC cover the hospital bed assembly line?
examples.zh: 制程质检是否覆盖病床装配线？

examples.en: Our IPQC records show when each patient lift assembly passed the required process checks.
examples.zh: 我们的制程质检记录注明了每台移位机组件通过规定过程检查的时间。

examples.en: Please email the IPQC findings before we discuss changes to the walker production schedule.
examples.zh: 讨论助行器生产排期变更前，请通过邮件发送制程质检结果。

examples.en: If IPQC identifies repeated alignment problems on wheelchair frames, we should review the fixture and approved process before allowing the affected batch to proceed.
examples.zh: 如果制程质检发现轮椅车架反复出现对位问题，应先评审夹具和批准的工艺，再允许受影响批次继续流转。

zh: 最终质量控制／最终检验

examples.en: The walkers are ready for final inspection.
examples.zh: 这批助行器已具备最终检验条件。

examples.en: FQC checks the completed manual wheelchairs before release.
examples.zh: 最终质检在放行前检查已完成的手动轮椅。

examples.en: Please confirm whether final inspection includes the care bed packaging and identification labels.
examples.zh: 请确认最终检验是否包括护理床包装及标识标签。

examples.en: We can discuss the patient lift shipment after FQC results and release documents are reviewed.
examples.zh: 审核最终质检结果和放行文件后，我们可以讨论移位机发运安排。

examples.en: Although hospital bed assembly is complete, shipment cannot be confirmed until final inspection findings have been reviewed and the required release decision is documented.
examples.zh: 虽然病床装配已完成，但只有最终检验结果经过审核、所需放行决定完成记录后，才能确认发运。

examples.en: PSI is scheduled for the wheelchair shipment.
examples.zh: 这批轮椅货物已安排出货前检验。

examples.en: Does PSI include the crutch cartons and labels?
examples.zh: 出货前检验是否包含拐杖外箱和标签？

examples.en: Please share the PSI checklist so our team can prepare the patient lifts for inspection.
examples.zh: 请提供出货前检验检查表，方便团队准备移位机验货。

examples.en: The quotation should state who pays for PSI on the hospital bed order.
examples.zh: 报价应说明病床订单的出货前检验费用由谁承担。

examples.en: If the buyer requests PSI after the wheelchair packing date has changed, we should reconfirm inspector availability and the shipment booking before promising dispatch.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅包装日期变化后买方要求出货前检验，应重新确认验货员时间和订舱安排，再承诺发货。

examples.en: We welcome third-party inspection of the patient lifts.
examples.zh: 我们欢迎对移位机进行第三方验货。

examples.en: Who will arrange third-party inspection for these walkers?
examples.zh: 谁来安排这批助行器的第三方验货？

examples.en: Please confirm the scope of third-party inspection before booking the hospital bed factory visit.
examples.zh: 安排病床工厂验货访问前，请确认第三方验货范围。

examples.en: Third-party inspection fees should be listed separately in the manual wheelchair commercial agreement.
examples.zh: 手动轮椅商务协议中应单独列明第三方验货费用。

examples.en: Although third-party inspection provides an independent assessment of the selected wheelchairs, the agreed sampling scope and acceptance criteria must be understood before interpreting its conclusions.
examples.zh: 虽然第三方验货可对选定轮椅提供独立评估，但解读结论前必须理解约定的抽样范围和验收准则。

examples.en: Please send the inspection plan for these crutches.
examples.zh: 请发送这批拐杖的检验计划。

examples.en: The wheelchair inspection plan needs your written approval.
examples.zh: 轮椅检验计划需要您的书面批准。

examples.en: Our inspection plan identifies the care bed checks required at each agreed production stage.
examples.zh: 我们的检验计划列明了护理床各约定生产阶段所需的检查。

examples.en: We revised the inspection plan after the customer changed the patient lift sling specification.
examples.zh: 客户修改移位机吊带规格后，我们修订了检验计划。

examples.en: Before accepting a shortened hospital bed delivery schedule, we should review the inspection plan to ensure that required checks and release reviews remain properly scheduled.
examples.zh: 接受缩短的病床交付排期前，应评审检验计划，确保所需检查和放行审核仍得到妥善安排。

examples.en: The inspector needs a wheelchair inspection checklist.
examples.zh: 验货员需要一份轮椅检验检查表。

examples.en: Add walker label checks to the inspection checklist.
examples.zh: 请在检验检查表中加入助行器标签检查。

examples.en: Please mark each care bed finding against the corresponding item on the inspection checklist.
examples.zh: 请将护理床的每项发现标注到检验检查表的对应项目中。

examples.en: An agreed inspection checklist helps both parties discuss the patient lift findings more clearly.
examples.zh: 商定的检验检查表有助于双方更清晰地讨论移位机检验结果。

examples.en: If a manual wheelchair requirement is missing from the inspection checklist, please raise it before inspection rather than assume that the inspector will include it.
examples.zh: 如果检验检查表缺少某项手动轮椅要求，请在验货前提出，不要假设验货员会自行纳入。

examples.en: We need a sampling plan for the walkers.
examples.zh: 我们需要助行器抽样方案。

examples.en: Has the wheelchair sampling plan been agreed yet?
examples.zh: 轮椅抽样方案是否已商定？

examples.en: The sampling plan should identify the hospital bed lot and the checks being sampled.
examples.zh: 抽样方案应明确病床批次及需要抽样的检查项目。

examples.en: Please explain the sampling plan in your email about the patient lift inspection proposal.
examples.zh: 请在有关移位机检验建议的邮件中说明抽样方案。

examples.en: Because different wheelchair checks may require different arrangements, the sampling plan should be agreed with the relevant parties before inspection begins and results are evaluated.
examples.zh: 由于轮椅的不同检查可能需要不同安排，应在开始验货及评估结果前与相关方商定抽样方案。

examples.en: Please confirm the acceptance criteria for these wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请确认这批轮椅的验收准则。

examples.en: The walker samples must meet the acceptance criteria.
examples.zh: 助行器样品必须满足验收准则。

examples.en: We cannot assess the care bed coating complaint without reviewing the agreed acceptance criteria.
examples.zh: 未评审约定验收准则前，我们无法评估护理床涂层投诉。

examples.en: The patient lift quotation references the specification that defines the applicable acceptance criteria.
examples.zh: 移位机报价引用了界定适用验收准则的规格文件。

examples.en: If the customer proposes new acceptance criteria for hospital beds after production starts, we should assess the technical and commercial impact before agreeing to the change.
examples.zh: 如果客户在生产开始后为病床提出新的验收准则，应先评估技术和商务影响，再同意变更。

examples.en: What tolerance applies to the wheelchair seat width?
examples.zh: 轮椅座宽适用什么公差？

examples.en: The crutch tube drawing shows the required tolerance.
examples.zh: 拐杖管材图纸标明了所需公差。

examples.en: Please check whether the measured walker frame dimension falls within the specified tolerance.
examples.zh: 请检查实测助行器车架尺寸是否处于规定公差内。

examples.en: A tighter tolerance for the patient lift base may affect tooling and inspection requirements.
examples.zh: 移位机底座采用更严的公差可能影响工装和检验要求。

examples.en: Before quoting a tighter tolerance for hospital bed components, our engineering team should confirm that the proposed process and measurement method can support the requirement.
examples.zh: 为病床零部件的更严公差报价前，工程团队应确认拟用工艺和测量方法能够支持该要求。

examples.en: Seat width is a critical dimension for this wheelchair.
examples.zh: 座宽是这款轮椅的一项关键尺寸。

examples.en: Which critical dimension should we check on the walker?
examples.zh: 我们应检查助行器的哪项关键尺寸？

examples.en: The drawing marks the patient lift mounting position as a critical dimension requiring recorded checks.
examples.zh: 图纸将移位机安装位置标为需要记录检查的关键尺寸。

examples.en: Please include the hospital bed critical dimension results in the report sent to the buyer.
examples.zh: 请在发给买方的报告中列入病床关键尺寸结果。

examples.en: If a wheelchair critical dimension does not meet the approved drawing, the affected parts should be assessed through the documented nonconformity process before any release decision.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅某项关键尺寸不符合批准图纸，应通过文件规定的不符合处理流程评估受影响零件，再作放行决定。

examples.en: Use a calibrated measuring instrument for wheelchair dimensions.
examples.zh: 请用经校准的测量仪器测量轮椅尺寸。

examples.en: Is this calibrated measuring instrument suitable for crutch tubes?
examples.zh: 这台经校准的测量仪器适合测量拐杖管材吗？

examples.en: Please identify the calibrated measuring instrument used for the patient lift dimensional inspection.
examples.zh: 请注明移位机尺寸检验所用的经校准测量仪器。

examples.en: The hospital bed inspection report should link each relevant result to a calibrated measuring instrument.
examples.zh: 病床检验报告应将相关结果关联至经校准的测量仪器。

examples.en: When a buyer questions a walker measurement, we should review the calibrated measuring instrument, its applicable range, and the recorded method before repeating the check.
examples.zh: 买方质疑助行器测量结果时，应先审核经校准测量仪器、其适用量程及记录方法，再重复检查。

zh: 表面质量；表面处理效果

examples.en: Please inspect the surface finish of this wheelchair frame.
examples.zh: 请检查这副轮椅车架的表面质量。

examples.en: The care bed surface finish sample needs approval.
examples.zh: 护理床表面效果样品需要确认。

examples.en: We can compare the walker surface finish with the approved reference sample during your visit.
examples.zh: 您来访时，我们可以将助行器表面效果与批准参考样品进行比较。

examples.en: Please send clear photographs of the hospital bed surface finish under the agreed viewing conditions.
examples.zh: 请按约定观察条件发送病床表面质量的清晰照片。

examples.en: Before we accept a cosmetic complaint about the patient lift surface finish, both parties should compare the evidence with the agreed appearance requirements and reference sample.
examples.zh: 受理移位机表面外观投诉前，双方应将证据与约定外观要求及参考样品进行比对。

examples.en: Weld inspection is required for these wheelchair frames.
examples.zh: 这些轮椅车架需要进行焊缝检验。

examples.en: When will the patient lift weld inspection begin?
examples.zh: 移位机焊缝检验何时开始？

examples.en: Please confirm the weld inspection method specified for the hospital bed frame in this order.
examples.zh: 请确认该订单病床车架规定的焊缝检验方法。

examples.en: Our email summarizes the walker weld inspection findings without making conclusions beyond the available evidence.
examples.zh: 我们的邮件概述助行器焊缝检验结果，不作超出已有证据的结论。

examples.en: If weld inspection raises concerns about a patient lift frame, qualified personnel should assess the findings against the applicable requirements before deciding the next steps.
examples.zh: 如果焊缝检验发现移位机车架存在疑点，应由合格人员按适用要求评估结果，再决定后续步骤。

examples.en: Please measure the coating thickness on this wheelchair frame.
examples.zh: 请测量这副轮椅车架的涂层厚度。

examples.en: The hospital bed drawing specifies the coating thickness.
examples.zh: 病床图纸规定了涂层厚度。

examples.en: The coating thickness results should identify the checked locations on the patient lift frame.
examples.zh: 涂层厚度结果应注明移位机车架上的检查位置。

examples.en: We need coating thickness evidence before discussing the buyer's proposed change to the walker finish.
examples.zh: 讨论买方提出的助行器表面处理变更前，我们需要涂层厚度证据。

examples.en: If hospital bed coating thickness varies outside the approved requirements, the affected batch should be assessed and any proposed correction documented before the shipment is released.
examples.zh: 如果病床涂层厚度偏离批准要求，应评估受影响批次，并记录拟议纠正措施，再放行出货。

zh: 不合格品；不符合规定要求的产品

examples.en: Keep nonconforming product separate from the finished walkers.
examples.zh: 请将不合格品与助行器成品分开。

examples.en: This wheelchair is recorded as a nonconforming product.
examples.zh: 这台轮椅被记录为不合格品。

examples.en: Please identify the patient lift nonconforming product clearly while the authorized team reviews its disposition.
examples.zh: 授权团队评审处置时，请清晰标识移位机不合格品。

examples.en: The hospital bed report should distinguish nonconforming product quantities from the total quantity inspected.
examples.zh: 病床报告应将不合格品数量与总检验数量区分开。

examples.en: When a customer reports nonconforming product in a wheelchair shipment, we should confirm the affected units and evidence before agreeing a remedy or cost allocation.
examples.zh: 客户报告轮椅货物中有不合格品时，应先确认受影响产品和证据，再商定补救及费用分担。

examples.en: Please record this nonconformity on the wheelchair report.
examples.zh: 请在轮椅报告上记录这项不符合。

examples.en: Does the walker label show the same nonconformity?
examples.zh: 助行器标签是否存在相同的不符合？

examples.en: Each care bed nonconformity should reference the requirement that was not met during inspection.
examples.zh: 每项护理床不符合都应引用检验中未满足的要求。

examples.en: We will acknowledge the patient lift nonconformity and confirm when the investigation update is due.
examples.zh: 我们会确认收到移位机不符合报告，并确认调查进展的反馈时间。

examples.en: If the same nonconformity appears across several hospital bed batches, the review should examine whether the existing corrective action addressed the underlying cause effectively.
examples.zh: 如果数批病床均出现同一不符合，评审应检查现有纠正措施是否有效处理了根本原因。

zh: 缺陷件；含至少一项所考察缺陷的单位产品

examples.en: This manual wheelchair is a defective unit.
examples.zh: 这台手动轮椅是一个缺陷件。

examples.en: Please mark each defective unit in the crutch batch.
examples.zh: 请标记这批拐杖中的每个缺陷件。

examples.en: The report should state how a defective unit is defined for the walker inspection.
examples.zh: 报告应说明助行器检验中如何定义缺陷件。

examples.en: We need photographs and identification details for each defective unit reported in the patient lift delivery.
examples.zh: 我们需要移位机交货中所报每个缺陷件的照片和识别信息。

examples.en: Although a hospital bed may contain several reported defects, it should count as one defective unit when calculating the defective unit rate under the agreed definition.
examples.zh: 虽然一张病床可能有数项所报缺陷，但按约定定义计算缺陷件率时，该病床应计为一个缺陷件。

zh: 缺陷发生率，须说明统计口径

examples.en: Please define the defect rate for this wheelchair report.
examples.zh: 请界定这份轮椅报告的缺陷率口径。

examples.en: What defect rate did the walker inspection record?
examples.zh: 助行器检验记录的缺陷率是多少？

examples.en: The care bed defect rate summary must state its numerator, denominator, and inspection scope.
examples.zh: 护理床缺陷率汇总必须说明分子、分母及检验范围。

examples.en: We cannot compare the patient lift defect rate with another supplier's figure without matching definitions.
examples.zh: 未统一定义前，我们无法把移位机缺陷率与另一供应商的数据进行比较。

examples.en: Before using a lower defect rate in wheelchair price negotiations, please verify that both reports apply the same counting method, sample basis, and defect categories.
examples.zh: 在轮椅价格谈判中引用更低缺陷率前，请确认两份报告使用相同计数方法、样本基础及缺陷分类。

examples.en: The report lists the wheelchair defective unit rate.
examples.zh: 报告列出了轮椅缺陷件率。

examples.en: Please calculate the defective unit rate for these crutches.
examples.zh: 请计算这批拐杖的缺陷件率。

examples.en: Our walker defective unit rate counts affected units rather than the total number of individual defects.
examples.zh: 我们的助行器缺陷件率统计受影响件数，而非单项缺陷总数。

examples.en: Please include the inspected hospital bed quantity when reporting the defective unit rate to the customer.
examples.zh: 向客户报告缺陷件率时，请列入病床检验数量。

examples.en: If several faults occur on one patient lift, count that lift once in the defective unit rate calculation and describe the separate faults elsewhere in the report.
examples.zh: 如果一台移位机出现数项故障，在缺陷件率计算中应只计该移位机一次，其他位置另述各项故障。

examples.en: Please record the lot number of these walker tubes.
examples.zh: 请记录这批助行器管材的批号。

examples.en: The wheelchair carton shows the production batch number.
examples.zh: 轮椅外箱标有生产批号。

examples.en: We can trace the patient lift component records using the lot number on the label.
examples.zh: 我们可以利用标签上的批号追溯移位机零部件记录。

examples.en: Please quote the hospital bed batch number in every email about this inspection concern.
examples.zh: 有关本次检验疑点的每封邮件都请注明病床批号。

examples.en: When a complaint involves several wheelchair deliveries, matching the lot number to the affected units helps the team define the investigation scope before proposing action.
examples.zh: 投诉涉及数次轮椅交货时，将批号与受影响产品对应起来，有助于团队先界定调查范围，再提出措施。

examples.en: We received a customer complaint about the wheelchair brakes.
examples.zh: 我们收到一项有关轮椅制动器的客户投诉。

examples.en: Please acknowledge the customer complaint about these care beds.
examples.zh: 请确认收到这批护理床的客户投诉。

examples.en: The customer complaint file should include the patient lift model and affected serial numbers.
examples.zh: 客户投诉档案应包括移位机型号及受影响产品的序列号。

examples.en: Our response to the walker customer complaint will explain the evidence needed and proposed review timetable.
examples.zh: 我们对助行器客户投诉的回复会说明所需证据及拟议评审时间表。

examples.en: Although we understand the urgency of the hospital bed customer complaint, any replacement or shipment decision must follow the documented assessment and agreed commercial terms.
examples.zh: 虽然我们理解病床客户投诉的紧迫性，但任何换货或发运决定均须遵循文件规定的评估及约定商务条款。

zh: 临时遏制措施，控制问题影响范围

examples.en: Containment action is needed for the affected wheelchair batch.
examples.zh: 受影响轮椅批次需要采取临时遏制措施。

examples.en: Please describe the containment action for these walker frames.
examples.zh: 请说明针对这些助行器车架的临时遏制措施。

examples.en: The containment action should identify which patient lifts are held pending the authorized technical assessment.
examples.zh: 临时遏制措施应明确哪些移位机需暂停流转以待授权技术评估。

examples.en: We will update the hospital bed customer after the containment action and affected scope are confirmed.
examples.zh: 确认临时遏制措施及影响范围后，我们会向病床客户反馈。

examples.en: If the suspected issue could affect other manual wheelchair lots, the containment action should cover the assessed scope while investigation continues and authorized personnel determine disposition.
examples.zh: 如果疑似问题可能影响其他手动轮椅批次，调查继续期间，临时遏制措施应覆盖经评估的范围，并由授权人员确定处置。

examples.en: Segregation keeps these wheelchair parts away from released stock.
examples.zh: 隔离能使这些轮椅零件与已放行库存分开。

examples.en: Where is the segregation area for rejected crutches?
examples.zh: 不合格拐杖的隔离区域在哪里？

examples.en: Please record the hospital bed quantities moved into segregation while their inspection status is reviewed.
examples.zh: 审核检验状态期间，请记录转入隔离的病床数量。

examples.en: Clear segregation labels help the patient lift warehouse team avoid mixing products with different release statuses.
examples.zh: 清晰的隔离标签有助于移位机仓储团队避免混放不同放行状态的产品。

examples.en: Because similar walker components may look identical, physical segregation and clear status identification should follow the approved controls until the responsible team authorizes the next step.
examples.zh: 由于相似助行器零件外观可能一致，责任团队授权后续步骤前，应按批准的控制要求实施实体隔离并清晰标识状态。

zh: 纠正，消除已发现的不符合

examples.en: The wheelchair label needs a documented correction.
examples.zh: 轮椅标签需要按记录进行纠正。

examples.en: Has the correction for these walker labels been completed?
examples.zh: 这批助行器标签的纠正是否已完成？

examples.en: A correction addresses the identified care bed nonconformity but does not by itself establish its root cause.
examples.zh: 纠正用于处理已发现的护理床不符合，本身并不能确定根本原因。

examples.en: Please email the patient lift correction record together with the related re-inspection results.
examples.zh: 请将移位机纠正记录与相关复检结果一并通过邮件发送。

examples.en: If the wheelchair label error keeps recurring after correction, the team should investigate its cause and assess whether a separate corrective action is needed to prevent recurrence.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅标签错误在纠正后反复出现，团队应调查其原因，并评估是否需要另行采取纠正措施以防再次发生。

zh: 返工，按规定恢复符合要求

examples.en: These wheelchair frames require approved rework before inspection.
examples.zh: 这些轮椅车架检验前需要按批准要求返工。

examples.en: Can the walker rework be completed this week?
examples.zh: 助行器返工能否在本周完成？

examples.en: Please confirm the authorized rework instructions before changing the affected patient lift components.
examples.zh: 更改受影响移位机零部件前，请确认经授权的返工作业要求。

examples.en: The hospital bed delivery estimate will be reviewed after rework and the required verification are planned.
examples.zh: 安排返工及所需验证后，我们会重新评审病床预计交付时间。

examples.en: When rework is proposed for nonconforming manual wheelchair parts, the responsible team should assess the method, document approval, and specify the checks required before release.
examples.zh: 对手动轮椅不合格零件提出返工方案时，责任团队应评估方法、记录批准，并规定放行前所需的检查。

examples.en: Root cause analysis is underway for the wheelchair issue.
examples.zh: 这项轮椅问题正在进行根本原因分析。

examples.en: Please share the walker root cause analysis findings.
examples.zh: 请提供助行器根本原因分析结果。

examples.en: The patient lift root cause analysis should distinguish confirmed evidence from assumptions that still need testing.
examples.zh: 移位机根本原因分析应区分已确认的证据与仍需验证的假设。

examples.en: We will discuss the hospital bed recovery schedule after the root cause analysis supports an action plan.
examples.zh: 根本原因分析为行动方案提供依据后，我们会讨论病床进度恢复排期。

examples.en: Although the photographs show a wheelchair surface defect, root cause analysis requires supporting process and inspection evidence before we can attribute the issue to a specific cause.
examples.zh: 虽然照片显示轮椅存在表面缺陷，但将问题归因于某一具体原因前，根本原因分析仍需要相关工艺及检验证据。

zh: 纠正措施，针对原因防止再次发生

examples.en: A corrective action is required for the recurring wheelchair issue.
examples.zh: 反复出现的轮椅问题需要采取纠正措施。

examples.en: Who owns the corrective action for these walker parts?
examples.zh: 这批助行器零件的纠正措施由谁负责？

examples.en: The care bed corrective action should address the confirmed cause and include an effectiveness review.
examples.zh: 护理床纠正措施应针对已确认原因，并包括有效性评审。

examples.en: Please send the patient lift corrective action plan before we discuss release of the next batch.
examples.zh: 讨论下一批次放行前，请发送移位机纠正措施计划。

examples.en: If a manual wheelchair problem returns after the corrective action is implemented, we should review the original cause assessment and effectiveness evidence before closing the complaint.
examples.zh: 如果手动轮椅问题在实施纠正措施后再次出现，应先复核原原因评估及有效性证据，再关闭投诉。

zh: 预防措施，针对潜在问题的原因

examples.en: Preventive action addresses potential problems in walker production.
examples.zh: 预防措施针对助行器生产中的潜在问题。

examples.en: Please review the preventive action for wheelchair packing.
examples.zh: 请评审轮椅包装的预防措施。

examples.en: The patient lift team proposed a preventive action after identifying a potential documentation mix-up.
examples.zh: 移位机团队发现可能发生文件混淆后，提出了一项预防措施。

examples.en: Our hospital bed process review records the rationale and responsibilities for the proposed preventive action.
examples.zh: 我们的病床工艺评审记录了拟议预防措施的理由和责任分工。

examples.en: Before describing a wheelchair change as preventive action, we should confirm that it addresses an identified potential cause rather than only correcting a defect already found.
examples.zh: 将轮椅某项变更描述为预防措施前，应确认其针对已识别的潜在原因，而非仅纠正已发现的缺陷。

examples.en: Effectiveness verification is pending for the wheelchair corrective action.
examples.zh: 轮椅纠正措施尚待有效性验证。

examples.en: When will the walker effectiveness verification be reviewed?
examples.zh: 助行器有效性验证何时评审？

examples.en: The care bed report should explain how effectiveness verification will determine whether the action worked.
examples.zh: 护理床报告应说明有效性验证将如何判断措施是否奏效。

examples.en: Please include patient lift follow-up inspection evidence in the effectiveness verification package sent to the customer.
examples.zh: 发给客户的有效性验证资料中，请列入移位机后续检验证据。

examples.en: Although the wheelchair process change has been implemented, we should not close the corrective action until the agreed effectiveness verification provides adequate evidence of the intended result.
examples.zh: 虽然轮椅工艺变更已实施，但约定的有效性验证提供充分证据证明预期结果前，不应关闭纠正措施。

examples.en: The wheelchair parts are awaiting an authorized disposition.
examples.zh: 这批轮椅零件正等待经授权的处置决定。

examples.en: Who can approve disposition of these rejected walkers?
examples.zh: 谁可以批准这批不合格助行器的处置？

examples.en: Please record the disposition of each affected patient lift against its inspection reference number.
examples.zh: 请按检验编号记录每台受影响移位机的处置决定。

examples.en: The hospital bed customer needs a clear disposition proposal before discussing the associated delivery changes.
examples.zh: 讨论相关交付变更前，病床客户需要清晰的处置建议。

examples.en: If rework is not supported by the technical assessment of a wheelchair frame, the authorized team must determine another appropriate disposition and document the basis for that decision.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅车架技术评估不支持返工，授权团队必须确定其他适当处置，并记录该决定的依据。

examples.en: Re-inspection is required after the wheelchair label correction.
examples.zh: 轮椅标签纠正后需要复检。

examples.en: Are these crutches ready for re-inspection today?
examples.zh: 这批拐杖今天是否已具备复检条件？

examples.en: The patient lift re-inspection record should identify the corrected issue and the checks performed.
examples.zh: 移位机复检记录应注明已纠正问题及所执行的检查。

examples.en: We can revise the hospital bed dispatch estimate once re-inspection and release reviews are complete.
examples.zh: 完成复检及放行审核后，我们可以修订病床预计发货时间。

examples.en: Before accepting the reworked walker batch, please review the re-inspection results against the original requirements and confirm that the authorized disposition conditions have been satisfied.
examples.zh: 接受返工助行器批次前，请按原要求审核复检结果，并确认经授权处置所附的条件均已满足。

zh: 不符合报告；不合格报告

examples.en: Please open an NCR for this wheelchair finding.
examples.zh: 请为这项轮椅检验发现开具不符合报告。

examples.en: The walker NCR needs the affected lot number.
examples.zh: 助行器不符合报告需要填写受影响批号。

examples.en: Our nonconformity report links the care bed finding to the applicable drawing and inspection evidence.
examples.zh: 我们的不符合报告将护理床检验发现关联至适用图纸及检验证据。

examples.en: Please reference the patient lift NCR number in emails about the investigation and proposed response.
examples.zh: 有关调查及拟议回复的邮件中，请引用移位机不符合报告编号。

examples.en: If one wheelchair NCR covers several related findings, the report should clearly identify each requirement, affected quantity, and disposition so that no unresolved issue is overlooked.
examples.zh: 如果一份轮椅不符合报告涵盖数项相关发现，报告应清楚注明每项要求、受影响数量及处置，避免遗漏未解决问题。

word: certificate of compliance / certificate of conformity (CoC / COC)
zh: 符合性证明；名称、签发方和证明范围须核实

examples.en: Please provide the CoC for this wheelchair batch.
examples.zh: 请提供这批轮椅的符合性证明。

examples.en: Who issues the certificate of conformity for these walkers?
examples.zh: 这批助行器的符合性证明由谁签发？

examples.en: The patient lift CoC should identify its issuer, covered products, and the requirements it references.
examples.zh: 移位机符合性证明应注明签发方、覆盖产品及所引用的要求。

examples.en: We must check the certificate of compliance scope before attaching it to the hospital bed quotation.
examples.zh: 将符合性证明附在病床报价中前，必须检查其覆盖范围。

examples.en: Because CoC can refer to different documents, please confirm the required issuer and scope for the wheelchair order rather than assume every certificate provides equivalent evidence.
examples.zh: 由于CoC可能指不同文件，请确认轮椅订单所需签发方及范围，不要假定所有证明文件提供等同证据。

zh: 欧盟符合性声明，特定适用法规下的声明文件

examples.en: Please review the EU DoC for this wheelchair model.
examples.zh: 请审核这款轮椅的欧盟符合性声明。

examples.en: Does the EU DoC identify the hospital bed model?
examples.zh: 欧盟符合性声明是否注明病床型号？

examples.en: The EU declaration of conformity should be checked against the patient lift configuration being offered.
examples.zh: 应将欧盟符合性声明与所报价的移位机配置进行核对。

examples.en: Please confirm which walker documentation is required before requesting an EU declaration of conformity from our team.
examples.zh: 向团队索取欧盟符合性声明前，请确认所需的助行器文件。

examples.en: If the hospital bed configuration changes, the responsible regulatory team should assess whether the EU DoC and supporting documentation remain applicable before the revised product is offered.
examples.zh: 如果病床配置改变，责任法规团队应评估欧盟符合性声明及支持文件是否仍适用，再对外提供修订产品。

examples.en: Please send the inspection report for these manual wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请发送这批手动轮椅的检验报告。

examples.en: The walker inspection report includes the checked quantities.
examples.zh: 助行器检验报告包括已检数量。

examples.en: Our care bed inspection report lists the findings, acceptance basis, and unresolved items separately.
examples.zh: 我们的护理床检验报告分别列明检验结果、验收依据及未解决项目。

examples.en: Could you review the patient lift inspection report before we arrange the follow-up call?
examples.zh: 我们安排后续通话前，您能否审核移位机检验报告？

examples.en: Although the hospital bed inspection report records acceptable sample results, the final shipment decision must still follow the agreed release process and any documented outstanding conditions.
examples.zh: 虽然病床检验报告记录了合格样本结果，但最终出货决定仍须遵循约定放行流程及任何记录在案的未完成条件。

examples.en: We need a material certificate for the wheelchair tubing.
examples.zh: 我们需要轮椅管材的材料证明文件。

examples.en: Does this material certificate cover the walker tube batch?
examples.zh: 这份材料证明是否覆盖该批助行器管材？

examples.en: Please match the patient lift material certificate to the material identification in the purchasing records.
examples.zh: 请将移位机材料证明与采购记录中的材料标识相匹配。

examples.en: The hospital bed quotation can list a material certificate separately if the buyer requires that document.
examples.zh: 如果买方要求该文件，病床报价可单独列明材料证明。

examples.en: Before using a supplier's material certificate as evidence for a wheelchair order, we should verify the covered batch, stated material requirements, and the document's traceability to the supplied parts.
examples.zh: 将供应商材料证明作为轮椅订单证据前，应核实覆盖批次、所述材料要求及文件与所供零件之间的追溯关联。

examples.en: Please check the wheelchair gauge calibration certificate.
examples.zh: 请检查轮椅量具的校准证书。

examples.en: Is the calibration certificate available for this crutch gauge?
examples.zh: 这件拐杖量具的校准证书是否可提供？

examples.en: The calibration certificate should match the instrument used for the patient lift measurement recorded here.
examples.zh: 校准证书应与此处记录的移位机测量所用仪器相匹配。

examples.en: Please send the hospital bed measuring instrument list with the relevant calibration certificate references.
examples.zh: 请将病床测量仪器清单与相关校准证书编号一并发送。

examples.en: If the calibration certificate does not cover the range needed for a walker measurement, the inspection team should determine whether a different suitable instrument is required.
examples.zh: 如果校准证书未覆盖助行器测量所需量程，检验团队应判断是否需要使用其他合适仪器。

examples.en: Keep the traceability record for each patient lift.
examples.zh: 请保留每台移位机的追溯记录。

examples.en: Can this traceability record identify the wheelchair batch?
examples.zh: 这份追溯记录能否识别轮椅批次？

examples.en: The hospital bed traceability record links the finished product to the relevant component and inspection information.
examples.zh: 病床追溯记录将成品关联至相关零部件及检验信息。

examples.en: Please attach the walker traceability record when responding to the buyer's question about this shipment.
examples.zh: 回复买方对本次装运的疑问时，请附上助行器追溯记录。

examples.en: When a wheelchair component issue is reported after delivery, a complete traceability record helps the team assess which products and related batches may need further review.
examples.zh: 交货后报告轮椅零部件问题时，完整追溯记录有助于团队评估哪些产品及关联批次可能需要进一步审核。

examples.en: The walker assembly instruction is a controlled document.
examples.zh: 助行器装配作业指导书是一份受控文件。

examples.en: Please use the current wheelchair controlled document version.
examples.zh: 请使用现行版轮椅受控文件。

examples.en: The patient lift inspection procedure must be retrieved through the approved controlled document system.
examples.zh: 移位机检验程序必须通过批准的受控文件系统获取。

examples.en: We can email the hospital bed controlled document after confirming the revision and authorized distribution scope.
examples.zh: 确认版次及授权分发范围后，我们可以通过邮件发送病床受控文件。

examples.en: If a customer marks changes on a wheelchair controlled document, those comments should enter the formal review process rather than become unapproved instructions on the production line.
examples.zh: 如果客户在轮椅受控文件上标注变更，应将这些意见纳入正式评审流程，不应直接成为产线上未经批准的指令。

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair drawing revision number.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅图纸修订版本号。

examples.en: The care bed label shows the revision number.
examples.zh: 护理床标签上标有修订版本号。

examples.en: Our patient lift quotation references the revision number of the specification used for costing.
examples.zh: 我们的移位机报价引用了成本核算所用规格的修订版本号。

examples.en: Please include the walker revision number in your email so we discuss the same design.
examples.zh: 请在邮件中注明助行器修订版本号，确保双方讨论的是同一设计。

examples.en: Before replacing a hospital bed component, please verify that the proposed part and installation instructions match the applicable revision number and approved configuration records.
examples.zh: 更换病床零部件前，请核实拟用零件及安装说明与适用修订版本号和批准配置记录相匹配。

examples.en: These wheelchairs are awaiting written release authorization.
examples.zh: 这批轮椅正等待书面放行授权。

examples.en: Who provides release authorization for the hospital beds?
examples.zh: 病床由谁提供放行授权？

examples.en: The patient lift shipment date can be confirmed after the required release authorization is recorded.
examples.zh: 记录所需放行授权后，才能确认移位机发运日期。

examples.en: Please check whether release authorization covers the corrected walker units as well as the original batch.
examples.zh: 请检查放行授权是否同时覆盖已纠正助行器产品及原批次。

examples.en: Even when the customer requests urgent dispatch of manual wheelchairs, the warehouse should not treat commercial pressure as a substitute for the required release authorization.
examples.zh: 即使客户要求紧急发运手动轮椅，仓库也不应将商务压力视为所需放行授权的替代。

examples.en: Please check certificate validity for this wheelchair offer.
examples.zh: 请核查这份轮椅报价所附证书的有效性。

examples.en: Certificate validity must be confirmed for these hospital beds.
examples.zh: 必须确认这些病床相关证书的有效性。

examples.en: We need to review certificate validity and product scope before sending the patient lift documents.
examples.zh: 发送移位机文件前，我们需要审核证书有效性及产品范围。

examples.en: Your email asks about certificate validity, so please identify the walker document you want checked.
examples.zh: 您的邮件询问证书有效性，请指明需要核查的助行器文件。

examples.en: If a certificate has been revised or withdrawn, the responsible team must assess certificate validity for the wheelchair transaction before relying on an older copy.
examples.zh: 如果证书已修订或撤回，责任团队必须先评估该轮椅交易所用证书的有效性，再依赖旧版文件。

examples.en: Please confirm the document scope for this patient lift.
examples.zh: 请确认该移位机相关文件的覆盖范围。

examples.en: Does the document scope include these wheelchair configurations?
examples.zh: 文件范围是否包括这些轮椅配置？

examples.en: The hospital bed document scope should match the model, configuration, and requirements being discussed.
examples.zh: 病床文件的覆盖范围应与所讨论型号、配置及要求相匹配。

examples.en: We will clarify the walker document scope before attaching the file to our quotation email.
examples.zh: 将文件附在报价邮件中前，我们会澄清助行器文件的覆盖范围。

examples.en: Although two care bed models look similar, the document scope must be checked separately rather than assuming that evidence for one model automatically applies to the other.
examples.zh: 虽然两款护理床外观相似，但必须分别检查文件范围，不应假设一个型号的证据自动适用于另一个型号。

examples.en: Welding joins the tubes in this wheelchair frame.
examples.zh: 焊接将这副轮椅车架的管件连接起来。

examples.en: The patient lift welding area is ready for review.
examples.zh: 移位机焊接区域已具备评审条件。

examples.en: Please confirm the approved welding requirements before discussing changes to the hospital bed frame design.
examples.zh: 讨论病床车架设计变更前，请确认批准的焊接要求。

examples.en: We can explain the walker welding process during the exhibition without promising unverified production capacity.
examples.zh: 展会期间，我们可以介绍助行器焊接工艺，不承诺未经核实的生产能力。

examples.en: If the customer proposes a different wheelchair frame material, engineering should review the welding process and related qualification requirements before the revised design is quoted.
examples.zh: 如果客户提出更换轮椅车架材料，工程团队应先评审焊接工艺及相关资格要求，再为修订设计报价。

examples.en: Please inspect the weld seam on this wheelchair frame.
examples.zh: 请检查这副轮椅车架的焊缝。

examples.en: The patient lift photograph shows the reported weld seam.
examples.zh: 移位机照片显示了所报告的焊缝。

examples.en: Each hospital bed weld seam finding should be compared with the applicable drawing and inspection criteria.
examples.zh: 每项病床焊缝检验发现都应与适用图纸及检验准则进行比对。

examples.en: Please identify the walker weld seam location in your email so our engineer can review it.
examples.zh: 请在邮件中标明助行器焊缝位置，以便工程师审核。

examples.en: Because a photograph may not provide enough information about a patient lift weld seam, the technical team should specify any further evidence needed before reaching a conclusion.
examples.zh: 由于照片可能不足以说明移位机焊缝情况，技术团队应先明确还需哪些证据，再作结论。

examples.en: Tube bending shapes the walker frame before assembly.
examples.zh: 弯管加工在装配前形成助行器车架形状。

examples.en: The wheelchair tube bending sample needs dimensional checks.
examples.zh: 轮椅弯管样品需要进行尺寸检查。

examples.en: Please confirm the hospital bed tube bending requirements against the current engineering drawing before production.
examples.zh: 生产前，请按现行工程图纸确认病床弯管加工要求。

examples.en: A change in the patient lift tube bending geometry may affect fit and the quotation.
examples.zh: 移位机弯管几何形状的变更可能影响配合及报价。

examples.en: If tube bending causes repeated dimensional variation on walker parts, engineering should review the approved process and tooling before proposing a corrective action to the customer.
examples.zh: 如果弯管加工导致助行器零件反复出现尺寸波动，工程团队应先评审批准的工艺和工装，再向客户提出纠正措施。

examples.en: Laser cutting prepares the wheelchair bracket blanks.
examples.zh: 激光切割用于制备轮椅支架坯件。

examples.en: Can you review the hospital bed laser cutting sample?
examples.zh: 您能否评审病床激光切割样品？

examples.en: The patient lift laser cutting program should correspond to the approved drawing revision used for production.
examples.zh: 移位机激光切割程序应与生产所用批准图纸版次对应。

examples.en: Please confirm whether the walker quotation includes laser cutting and the specified edge finishing work.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器报价是否包括激光切割及规定的边缘修整工作。

examples.en: Before changing the material thickness for a wheelchair bracket, the team should assess laser cutting, subsequent forming, and inspection requirements rather than adjusting the quotation alone.
examples.zh: 更改轮椅支架材料厚度前，团队应评估激光切割、后续成形及检验要求，不应仅调整报价。

examples.en: CNC machining finishes this patient lift mounting part.
examples.zh: 数控加工用于精加工该移位机安装零件。

examples.en: The wheelchair CNC machining sample is ready for review.
examples.zh: 轮椅数控加工样品已具备评审条件。

examples.en: Please compare the care bed CNC machining results with the tolerances on the approved drawing.
examples.zh: 请将护理床数控加工结果与批准图纸上的公差进行比较。

examples.en: We need the final hospital bed drawing before confirming the CNC machining quotation and lead time.
examples.zh: 确认数控加工报价及交期前，我们需要最终版病床图纸。

examples.en: If a tighter wheelchair tolerance requires additional CNC machining operations, we should explain the technical basis and obtain agreement on cost and schedule before proceeding.
examples.zh: 如果更严的轮椅公差需要额外数控加工工序，应先解释技术依据，并就费用及排期取得一致，再继续执行。

examples.en: Drilling creates the mounting holes in this walker bracket.
examples.zh: 钻孔用于加工该助行器支架的安装孔。

examples.en: The wheelchair drilling sample needs a position check.
examples.zh: 轮椅钻孔样品需要进行位置检查。

examples.en: Please confirm the drilling locations for the hospital bed bracket against the approved drawing.
examples.zh: 请按批准图纸确认病床支架的钻孔位置。

examples.en: We will review the patient lift drilling schedule after the revised hole dimensions are approved.
examples.zh: 修订孔尺寸获批后，我们将评审移位机钻孔排期。

examples.en: If the customer changes the wheelchair mounting pattern, drilling instructions and inspection requirements must be reviewed together before the revised parts enter production.
examples.zh: 如果客户修改轮椅安装孔位，必须一并评审钻孔指令和检验要求，再将修订零件投入生产。

examples.en: Deburring removes unwanted edges from these wheelchair parts.
examples.zh: 去毛刺用于清除这些轮椅零件的多余毛边。

examples.en: Please check the walker tubes after deburring is complete.
examples.zh: 去毛刺完成后，请检查助行器管材。

examples.en: The patient lift drawing should identify any specific edge requirements that apply after deburring.
examples.zh: 移位机图纸应注明去毛刺后适用的任何特定边缘要求。

examples.en: Our hospital bed quotation includes the deburring work described in the agreed manufacturing specification.
examples.zh: 我们的病床报价包括商定制造规范所述的去毛刺工作。

examples.en: When a buyer reports a sharp edge on a wheelchair component, the review should examine the specified deburring process and relevant inspection records before assigning a cause.
examples.zh: 买方报告轮椅零部件存在锐边时，应先检查规定的去毛刺工艺及相关检验记录，再判断原因。

examples.en: Injection molding forms the housing for this wheelchair controller.
examples.zh: 注塑用于成形该轮椅控制器外壳。

examples.en: The walker injection molding samples need appearance approval.
examples.zh: 助行器注塑样品需要确认外观。

examples.en: Please check the patient lift hand control housing against the approved injection molding sample.
examples.zh: 请将移位机手控器外壳与批准的注塑样品进行核对。

examples.en: A material change may affect injection molding costs for the hospital bed control enclosure.
examples.zh: 材料变更可能影响病床控制盒外壳的注塑成本。

examples.en: Before we quote a new wheelchair controller housing, the supplier should assess injection molding feasibility, tooling requirements, and the agreed dimensional and appearance criteria.
examples.zh: 为新的轮椅控制器外壳报价前，供应商应评估注塑可行性、模具要求，以及商定的尺寸和外观准则。

examples.en: The wheelchair housing needs a proposed mold modification.
examples.zh: 轮椅外壳需要提出修模方案。

examples.en: Please quote the walker handle mold modification separately.
examples.zh: 请单独报价助行器握把的修模费用。

examples.en: We need an approved drawing before authorizing mold modification for the patient lift control housing.
examples.zh: 授权移位机控制器外壳修模前，我们需要批准的图纸。

examples.en: The care bed schedule may change if mold modification requires new samples and additional review.
examples.zh: 如果修模需要新样品及额外评审，护理床排期可能发生变化。

examples.en: Although the buyer requests a small wheelchair housing change, mold modification should not begin until its technical impact, cost, sample approval, and ownership arrangements are agreed.
examples.zh: 虽然买方仅要求小幅修改轮椅外壳，但必须先就技术影响、费用、样品批准及所有权安排达成一致，再开始修模。

examples.en: Powder coating covers this manual wheelchair frame.
examples.zh: 这副手动轮椅车架采用粉末喷涂。

examples.en: Please compare the walker powder coating color samples.
examples.zh: 请比较助行器粉末喷涂的色板样品。

examples.en: The hospital bed powder coating requirements should match the approved finish specification and reference sample.
examples.zh: 病床粉末喷涂要求应与批准的表面处理规范及参考样品一致。

examples.en: We will confirm the patient lift powder coating quotation after the color and inspection requirements are finalized.
examples.zh: 确定颜色及检验要求后，我们会确认移位机粉末喷涂报价。

examples.en: If the customer requests a new wheelchair color, we should assess powder coating preparation, sample approval, and production changeover before confirming the revised delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 如果客户要求新的轮椅颜色，应先评估粉末喷涂准备、样品批准及生产换型，再确认修订后的交付排期。

examples.en: Surface pretreatment prepares these hospital bed parts for coating.
examples.zh: 表面预处理为这些病床零件的涂装作准备。

examples.en: Please review the wheelchair surface pretreatment work instructions.
examples.zh: 请评审轮椅表面预处理作业指导书。

examples.en: The patient lift coating process should specify the applicable surface pretreatment and its required controls.
examples.zh: 移位机涂装工艺应规定适用的表面预处理及所需控制。

examples.en: Please include the walker surface pretreatment records in the coating complaint investigation package.
examples.zh: 请在涂层投诉调查资料中列入助行器表面预处理记录。

examples.en: If a care bed coating issue is reported, the technical review should consider surface pretreatment alongside material, coating, and process records rather than assume a single cause.
examples.zh: 如果报告护理床涂层问题，技术评审应同时考虑表面预处理、材料、涂层及工艺记录，不应假定仅有一个原因。

examples.en: Please record the curing conditions for the wheelchair coating.
examples.zh: 请记录轮椅涂层的固化条件。

examples.en: The hospital bed curing conditions need engineering review.
examples.zh: 病床固化条件需要工程评审。

examples.en: The specified curing conditions for patient lift coating should be followed and recorded as required.
examples.zh: 应按规定遵循并记录移位机涂层的固化条件。

examples.en: We need the walker curing conditions before assessing whether the revised coating process is acceptable.
examples.zh: 评估修订涂装工艺是否可接受前，我们需要助行器固化条件。

examples.en: When coating materials change for a wheelchair frame, the responsible team should review the required curing conditions and verification evidence before approving the revised production process.
examples.zh: 轮椅车架涂层材料改变时，责任团队应先审核所需固化条件及验证证据，再批准修订生产工艺。

examples.en: Please send the engineering drawing for this patient lift.
examples.zh: 请发送这款移位机的工程图纸。

examples.en: The wheelchair engineering drawing shows the mounting positions.
examples.zh: 轮椅工程图纸标明了安装位置。

examples.en: We will prepare the walker sample according to the approved engineering drawing and specification.
examples.zh: 我们将按批准的工程图纸及规格制作助行器样品。

examples.en: The hospital bed quotation needs an engineering drawing with clear dimensions and revision identification.
examples.zh: 病床报价需要一份尺寸清晰、修订标识明确的工程图纸。

examples.en: If a customer sketch differs from the wheelchair engineering drawing, please resolve the discrepancy through the agreed review process before confirming production or commercial terms.
examples.zh: 如果客户草图与轮椅工程图纸不同，请先通过约定评审流程解决差异，再确认生产或商务条款。

examples.en: Please confirm the current wheelchair drawing revision.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅图纸的现行修订版次。

examples.en: The care bed drawing revision changed after our meeting.
examples.zh: 会议后，护理床图纸修订版次发生了变化。

examples.en: Our patient lift sample report references the drawing revision used when the sample was produced.
examples.zh: 我们的移位机样品报告注明了制作样品时使用的图纸修订版次。

examples.en: Please include the walker drawing revision when requesting a revised price from the supplier.
examples.zh: 向供应商索取修订报价时，请注明助行器图纸修订版次。

examples.en: Before accepting hospital bed components made to an earlier drawing revision, the responsible team should assess the differences and document whether the parts remain acceptable.
examples.zh: 接受按较早图纸版次制造的病床零部件前，责任团队应评估差异，并记录这些零件是否仍可接受。

examples.en: Use the controlled drawing for these wheelchair brackets.
examples.zh: 这些轮椅支架应使用受控图纸。

examples.en: Where can we access the walker controlled drawing?
examples.zh: 我们在哪里可以获取助行器受控图纸？

examples.en: The patient lift assembly team should confirm the controlled drawing revision before starting this batch.
examples.zh: 开始该批次前，移位机装配团队应确认受控图纸版次。

examples.en: Please replace the unapproved hospital bed sketch with the applicable controlled drawing in the inspection package.
examples.zh: 请将检验资料中未经批准的病床草图替换为适用受控图纸。

examples.en: If a supplier receives conflicting wheelchair dimensions, work should be clarified against the controlled drawing through authorized communication rather than decided from informal messages alone.
examples.zh: 如果供应商收到相互矛盾的轮椅尺寸，应通过授权沟通对照受控图纸澄清工作，不应仅凭非正式消息自行决定。

examples.en: This datum defines the wheelchair bracket reference position.
examples.zh: 这个基准定义了轮椅支架的参考位置。

examples.en: Please identify the datum on the walker drawing.
examples.zh: 请指出助行器图纸上的基准。

examples.en: The hospital bed inspection method should use the datum specified on the approved drawing.
examples.zh: 病床检验方法应采用批准图纸规定的基准。

examples.en: We cannot compare patient lift measurements reliably until both teams confirm the same datum.
examples.zh: 双方团队确认使用同一基准前，我们无法可靠地比较移位机测量结果。

examples.en: If a wheelchair dimension is measured from a different datum, the reported result may not be comparable, so please agree the measurement basis before reviewing conformity.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅尺寸从不同基准测量，所报结果可能无法比较，因此请先商定测量依据，再评审符合性。

examples.en: Please check the dimensional tolerance for this wheelchair part.
examples.zh: 请检查这件轮椅零件的尺寸公差。

examples.en: The walker drawing specifies the required dimensional tolerance.
examples.zh: 助行器图纸规定了所需尺寸公差。

examples.en: A patient lift measurement must be assessed against the dimensional tolerance on the applicable drawing.
examples.zh: 移位机测量结果必须按适用图纸上的尺寸公差进行评估。

examples.en: Please explain how the hospital bed dimensional tolerance change affects tooling, inspection, and quotation.
examples.zh: 请说明病床尺寸公差变更对工装、检验及报价的影响。

examples.en: Before agreeing a tighter dimensional tolerance for wheelchair components, we should confirm process capability and measurement suitability under the proposed manufacturing and inspection arrangements.
examples.zh: 同意收紧轮椅零部件尺寸公差前，应确认拟议制造及检验安排下的工艺能力和测量适用性。

examples.en: The wheelchair drawing includes a geometric tolerance requirement.
examples.zh: 轮椅图纸包含一项几何公差要求。

examples.en: Please clarify this hospital bed geometric tolerance symbol.
examples.zh: 请澄清病床图纸上的这个几何公差符号。

examples.en: The patient lift supplier needs the complete geometric tolerance callout before planning the inspection method.
examples.zh: 移位机供应商需要完整的几何公差标注，才能规划检验方法。

examples.en: We will review the walker quotation once the geometric tolerance and datum requirements are confirmed.
examples.zh: 确认几何公差及基准要求后，我们会评审助行器报价。

examples.en: If a new geometric tolerance is proposed for a wheelchair mounting feature, engineering should assess its functional need and inspection implications before the drawing is released.
examples.zh: 如果针对轮椅安装结构提出新的几何公差，工程团队应先评估其功能必要性和检验影响，再发布图纸。

examples.en: The BOM lists the parts for this care bed.
examples.zh: 物料清单列出了这款护理床的零件。

examples.en: Please update the wheelchair BOM after the design change.
examples.zh: 设计变更后，请更新轮椅物料清单。

examples.en: The approved bill of materials should match the patient lift configuration specified in the order.
examples.zh: 批准的物料清单应与订单规定的移位机配置一致。

examples.en: We need the current walker BOM before confirming component purchasing costs and production availability.
examples.zh: 确认零部件采购成本及生产备料情况前，我们需要现行助行器物料清单。

examples.en: If a hospital bed component is substituted, the bill of materials and associated approval records must be reviewed so that purchasing and assembly use the same authorized configuration.
examples.zh: 如果替换病床零部件，必须评审物料清单及相关批准记录，确保采购与装配采用同一授权配置。

examples.en: Please confirm the material specification for this wheelchair tube.
examples.zh: 请确认这根轮椅管材的材料规范。

examples.en: The crutch drawing references an approved material specification.
examples.zh: 拐杖图纸引用了一份批准的材料规范。

examples.en: The patient lift supplier must review the material specification before proposing an alternative material.
examples.zh: 提出替代材料前，移位机供应商必须评审材料规范。

examples.en: Please include the hospital bed material specification when requesting a quotation from the component supplier.
examples.zh: 向零部件供应商询价时，请附上病床材料规范。

examples.en: Although a substitute walker material may reduce purchasing cost, its compliance with the material specification and any resulting design impact must be assessed before approval.
examples.zh: 虽然助行器替代材料可能降低采购成本，但获批前必须评估其对材料规范的符合性及由此造成的设计影响。

examples.en: Please submit a change request for the wheelchair label.
examples.zh: 请提交轮椅标签变更申请。

examples.en: The care bed change request is awaiting review.
examples.zh: 护理床变更申请正等待评审。

examples.en: Your patient lift change request should explain the proposed revision and the reason for it.
examples.zh: 您的移位机变更申请应说明拟议修订及其原因。

examples.en: We will review the walker price after the change request impact on materials and tooling is assessed.
examples.zh: 评估变更申请对材料及工装的影响后，我们会评审助行器价格。

examples.en: If a change request affects hospital beds already in production, the review should identify the affected quantities and agree how the approved change will be introduced.
examples.zh: 如果变更申请影响已在生产的病床，评审应识别受影响数量，并商定批准变更的导入方式。

zh: 工程变更指令；工程变更单

examples.en: The ECO authorizes the wheelchair drawing change.
examples.zh: 工程变更指令授权了轮椅图纸变更。

examples.en: Please confirm the care bed ECO effective date.
examples.zh: 请确认护理床工程变更指令的生效日期。

examples.en: The patient lift engineering change order should identify the affected drawings, parts, and implementation conditions.
examples.zh: 移位机工程变更指令应注明受影响图纸、零件及实施条件。

examples.en: We need the approved walker ECO before updating the purchasing and assembly instructions.
examples.zh: 更新采购及装配指令前，我们需要批准的助行器工程变更指令。

examples.en: When an engineering change order affects a hospital bed shipment, the team should document which units use the old configuration and which use the approved revision.
examples.zh: 工程变更指令影响病床出货时，团队应记录哪些产品采用旧配置，哪些采用批准的修订配置。

zh: 装配工装；装配定位工具

examples.en: The assembly jig positions the wheelchair frame parts.
examples.zh: 装配工装用于定位轮椅车架零件。

examples.en: Please check the walker assembly jig before production.
examples.zh: 生产前，请检查助行器装配工装。

examples.en: Our patient lift assembly jig proposal aims to improve repeatable positioning within the approved process.
examples.zh: 我们的移位机装配工装方案旨在批准工艺内提高重复定位的一致性。

examples.en: Please quote the hospital bed assembly jig separately from the recurring unit production price.
examples.zh: 请将病床装配工装费用与每件产品的持续生产价格分开报价。

examples.en: If a revised wheelchair assembly jig changes how parts are positioned, engineering should review the resulting dimensions and document the required verification before routine production.
examples.zh: 如果修订轮椅装配工装改变了零件定位方式，工程团队应先评审相关尺寸并记录所需验证，再进行常规生产。

examples.en: This fixture holds the walker tubes during welding.
examples.zh: 这套夹具在焊接时固定助行器管材。

examples.en: The wheelchair fixture needs a maintenance review today.
examples.zh: 轮椅夹具今天需要进行维护评审。

examples.en: Please verify that the patient lift fixture matches the approved part configuration before use.
examples.zh: 使用前，请核实移位机夹具与批准零件配置相匹配。

examples.en: A hospital bed fixture repair may affect the production schedule, so we will confirm the revised plan.
examples.zh: 病床夹具维修可能影响生产排期，因此我们会确认修订计划。

examples.en: If inspection suggests that a wheelchair fixture contributes to repeated positioning errors, the technical team should assess its condition and confirm any correction before production resumes.
examples.zh: 如果检验显示轮椅夹具可能导致反复定位错误，技术团队应先评估其状态并确认所需纠正，再恢复生产。

examples.en: This error-proofing feature helps identify the correct wheelchair bracket.
examples.zh: 这个防错结构有助于识别正确的轮椅支架。

examples.en: Can we review the walker error-proofing feature together?
examples.zh: 我们能否一起评审助行器防错结构？

examples.en: The patient lift error-proofing feature should be evaluated against the specific assembly mistake it addresses.
examples.zh: 应针对防错结构所处理的具体装配错误评估移位机防错结构。

examples.en: Please describe the hospital bed error-proofing feature in the process improvement proposal sent by email.
examples.zh: 请在邮件发送的工艺改进方案中说明病床防错结构。

examples.en: Although an error-proofing feature may reduce the likelihood of a wheelchair assembly mistake, its effectiveness should be verified rather than presented as a guarantee that errors cannot occur.
examples.zh: 虽然防错结构可能降低轮椅装配错误发生的可能性，但应验证其有效性，不应宣称能够保证不发生错误。

zh: 扭矩规范；规定扭矩要求

examples.en: Please check the torque specification for this wheelchair fastener.
examples.zh: 请检查这个轮椅紧固件的扭矩规范。

examples.en: The care bed assembly instruction lists the torque specification.
examples.zh: 护理床装配作业指导书列出了扭矩规范。

examples.en: The patient lift operator should use the approved torque specification and the required recorded checks.
examples.zh: 移位机操作人员应采用批准的扭矩规范并执行所需记录检查。

examples.en: We need the hospital bed torque specification before reviewing the supplier's proposed assembly method.
examples.zh: 评审供应商拟议装配方法前，我们需要病床扭矩规范。

examples.en: If a different fastener is proposed for a wheelchair joint, engineering should assess whether the torque specification and related verification remain appropriate before approving the substitution.
examples.zh: 如果建议对轮椅连接处采用不同紧固件，工程团队应先评估扭矩规范及相关验证是否仍适当，再批准替换。

examples.en: Please identify the fastener used on this walker.
examples.zh: 请确认这款助行器使用的紧固件。

examples.en: The wheelchair fastener must match the approved parts list.
examples.zh: 轮椅紧固件必须与批准零件清单一致。

examples.en: The patient lift quotation should specify whether the required fastener set is included with replacement parts.
examples.zh: 移位机报价应说明备件是否包含所需紧固件组。

examples.en: Please send the hospital bed fastener drawing reference when asking the supplier to review an alternative.
examples.zh: 要求供应商评审替代方案时，请发送病床紧固件图纸编号。

examples.en: Before accepting a substitute fastener for a wheelchair assembly, the responsible team should review its specification, compatibility, and any changes required in the approved assembly instructions.
examples.zh: 接受轮椅组件的替代紧固件前，责任团队应审核其规格、兼容性及批准装配说明所需的任何变更。

examples.en: Please check thread engagement on this wheelchair connection.
examples.zh: 请检查这处轮椅连接的螺纹啮合情况。

examples.en: The hospital bed drawing states the thread engagement requirement.
examples.zh: 病床图纸注明了螺纹啮合要求。

examples.en: The patient lift assembly check should assess thread engagement against the approved design and instructions.
examples.zh: 移位机装配检查应按批准设计及作业要求评估螺纹啮合。

examples.en: We need the walker joint drawing before discussing whether the proposed thread engagement is acceptable.
examples.zh: 讨论拟议螺纹啮合是否可接受前，我们需要助行器连接处图纸。

examples.en: If the wheelchair fastener length changes, engineering should review thread engagement and possible interference rather than assume that the existing assembly approval still applies.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅紧固件长度改变，工程团队应评审螺纹啮合及可能干涉，不应假设现有装配批准仍然适用。

examples.en: Please check the alignment of the wheelchair brackets.
examples.zh: 请检查轮椅支架的对位情况。

examples.en: The patient lift alignment check is still pending.
examples.zh: 移位机对位检查仍未完成。

examples.en: Our hospital bed inspection record includes the alignment results for the identified mounting features.
examples.zh: 我们的病床检验记录包括已标明安装结构的对位结果。

examples.en: Please send photographs showing the walker alignment concern before we arrange a technical review.
examples.zh: 安排技术评审前，请发送显示助行器对位疑点的照片。

examples.en: If wheelchair assembly requires unusual force to achieve alignment, the team should assess the dimensional and fixture evidence under the approved process before deciding how to proceed.
examples.zh: 如果轮椅装配需施加异常力量才能对位，团队应按批准流程评估尺寸和夹具证据，再决定如何继续。

examples.en: The wheelchair footrest shows possible interference with the frame.
examples.zh: 轮椅脚托可能与车架发生干涉。

examples.en: Please check for interference around the care bed linkage.
examples.zh: 请检查护理床连杆机构周围是否存在干涉。

examples.en: The patient lift fit check should identify any interference before the prototype review is closed.
examples.zh: 移位机试装检查应在样机评审关闭前识别任何干涉。

examples.en: We need the revised walker drawing to assess whether the proposed bracket creates interference.
examples.zh: 我们需要修订后的助行器图纸，以评估拟议支架是否造成干涉。
