examples.en: Please identify the wheelchair anti-tip wheel configuration.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅防后倾小轮配置。

examples.en: This manual wheelchair includes an anti-tip wheel.
examples.zh: 这款手动轮椅配有防后倾小轮。

examples.en: Our power wheelchair offer lists the anti-tip wheel arrangement specified for that version.
examples.zh: 电动轮椅报价列明该版本规定的防后倾小轮配置。

examples.en: Please explain anti-tip wheel use according to the wheelchair instructions supplied with the model.
examples.zh: 请按该型号随附轮椅说明书解释防后倾小轮使用。

examples.en: Before describing the anti-tip wheel as a safety feature, confirm its documented purpose and limits, and avoid promising that the wheelchair cannot tip in any situation.
examples.zh: 介绍防后倾小轮安全功能前，应确认文件载明用途及限制，避免承诺轮椅在任何情况均不会倾翻。

zh: 腿托；与脚托功能范围有别

examples.en: This wheelchair includes an adjustable leg rest.
examples.zh: 这款轮椅配有可调腿托。

examples.en: Please confirm the requested wheelchair leg rest.
examples.zh: 请确认所需轮椅腿托。

examples.en: The quotation distinguishes the wheelchair leg rest assembly from its separate footplate components.
examples.zh: 报价区分轮椅腿托组件及其独立脚踏板零件。

examples.en: Please check leg rest mounting details before approving the manual wheelchair sample.
examples.zh: 批准手动轮椅样品前，请检查腿托安装细节。

examples.en: If the buyer requests a different leg rest for the power wheelchair, clarify the support and adjustment requirements before determining whether the proposed accessory is compatible.
examples.zh: 若买方要求电动轮椅采用其他腿托，应先明确支撑及调节要求，再判断拟用配件是否兼容。

examples.en: Please review the wheelchair calf support sample.
examples.zh: 请评审轮椅小腿支撑件样品。

examples.en: This leg rest includes a calf support.
examples.zh: 这款轮椅腿托含小腿支撑件。

examples.en: Our manual wheelchair sample review identifies the calf support material and attachment arrangement.
examples.zh: 手动轮椅样品评审注明小腿支撑件材料及连接方式。

examples.en: The buyer requested calf support dimensions before confirming the power wheelchair accessory package.
examples.zh: 买方确认电动轮椅配件包前，要求提供小腿支撑件尺寸。

examples.en: Before substituting a calf support on the wheelchair, engineering should assess its interface with the leg rest and approve the relevant documentation for the revised assembly.
examples.zh: 替换轮椅小腿支撑件前，工程部门应评估与腿托的接口，并批准修改组件的相关文件。

examples.en: Is the wheelchair seat cushion included here?
examples.zh: 此处包含轮椅座垫吗？

examples.en: Please confirm the manual wheelchair seat cushion.
examples.zh: 请确认手动轮椅座垫。

examples.en: Our quotation states the seat cushion separately from the wheelchair seat upholstery.
examples.zh: 报价将座垫与轮椅座面软包分列。

examples.en: Please provide seat cushion dimensions before requesting a revised power wheelchair package price.
examples.zh: 要求修改电动轮椅整套报价前，请提供座垫尺寸。

examples.en: If the buyer requests a different seat cushion for the wheelchair, confirm the intended product and approved specifications rather than assuming every cushion offers the same support characteristics.
examples.zh: 若买方要求轮椅更换座垫，应确认具体产品和批准规格，不能假定所有座垫支撑特性相同。

zh: 轮椅座背面料或软包部分

examples.en: Please confirm the manual wheelchair upholstery color.
examples.zh: 请确认手动轮椅软包颜色。

examples.en: The wheelchair upholstery sample needs customer approval.
examples.zh: 轮椅软包样品需要客户批准。

examples.en: Our inspector compares upholstery stitching and finish with the approved manual wheelchair sample.
examples.zh: 检验员按批准样品比较手动轮椅软包缝制及表面效果。

examples.en: Please email upholstery material requirements before we prepare the revised wheelchair quotation.
examples.zh: 准备修改轮椅报价前，请邮件发送软包材料要求。

examples.en: Before changing the upholstery supplier for the manual wheelchair, we should review the proposed material and workmanship requirements and obtain approval for the new sample.
examples.zh: 更换手动轮椅软包供应商前，应评审拟用材料及工艺要求，并取得新样品批准。

examples.en: Please check the rollator brake lever movement.
examples.zh: 请检查带轮助行器制动手柄动作。

examples.en: This wheelchair brake lever matches the drawing.
examples.zh: 这款轮椅制动手柄符合图纸。

examples.en: Our rollator inspection records identify the brake lever operation checked against the specification.
examples.zh: 带轮助行器检验记录注明按规格检查的制动手柄操作。

examples.en: Please identify the brake lever part number before requesting replacement wheelchair components.
examples.zh: 要求轮椅替换零件前，请确认制动手柄零件号。

examples.en: If a customer reports a brake lever issue on the rollator, the service team should assess the complete specified brake arrangement before recommending any component replacement.
examples.zh: 客户反馈带轮助行器制动手柄问题时，服务团队应评估整套规定制动配置，再建议更换零件。

examples.en: Please inspect the walker locking pin engagement.
examples.zh: 请检查助行架锁止销啮合情况。

examples.en: The wheelchair locking pin needs component identification.
examples.zh: 轮椅锁止销需要确认零件标识。

examples.en: Our crutch assembly drawing shows the locking pin position and specified engagement details.
examples.zh: 拐杖装配图标明锁止销位置及规定啮合细节。

examples.en: Please send locking pin photographs with the walker batch information in your email.
examples.zh: 请在邮件中发送锁止销照片和助行器批次信息。

examples.en: Before approving a replacement locking pin for the folding wheelchair, engineering must confirm the interface dimensions and required checks so a visually similar part is not accepted without review.
examples.zh: 批准折叠轮椅替换锁止销前，工程部门必须确认接口尺寸及所需检查，避免未经评审接受外观相似件。

examples.en: Which crutch height setting does the sample use?
examples.zh: 拐杖样品采用哪个高度档位？

examples.en: Please check the walker height setting markings.
examples.zh: 请检查助行架高度档位标记。

examples.en: Our inspection checklist identifies the crutch height setting positions that require verification.
examples.zh: 检验表明确需要验证的拐杖高度档位。

examples.en: Please describe the walker height setting issue using the product's documented adjustment procedure.
examples.zh: 请结合文件规定调节程序描述助行架高度档位问题。

examples.en: If the customer requests a new height setting on the walking cane, engineering should review the adjustment range and drawing before approving any additional hole position.
examples.zh: 若客户要求手杖增加高度档位，工程部门应先评审调节范围和图纸，再批准增加孔位。

examples.en: Please confirm the rollator handle height range.
examples.zh: 请确认带轮助行器握把高度范围。

examples.en: The walker label explains its handle height settings.
examples.zh: 助行架标签说明握把高度档位。

examples.en: Our sample review checks handle height against the approved drawing for the walking frame.
examples.zh: 样品评审按批准的助行架图纸检查握把高度。

examples.en: Please send handle height requirements before requesting a custom quotation for the crutches.
examples.zh: 要求定制拐杖报价前，请发送握把高度要求。

examples.en: When comparing handle height figures for different rollators, check the measurement points and available adjustment positions so the purchasing decision uses genuinely comparable product information.
examples.zh: 比较不同带轮助行器握把高度时，应核对测量点和可调档位，确保采购决定采用真正可比的产品资料。

examples.en: This crutch has a textured grip surface.
examples.zh: 这款拐杖握把表面带有纹理。

examples.en: Please review the walker grip surface sample.
examples.zh: 请评审助行架握把表面样品。

examples.en: The buyer requested a different grip surface finish for the walking cane sample.
examples.zh: 买方要求手杖样品采用不同握把表面效果。

examples.en: Our rollator component inspection compares the grip surface with the approved material sample.
examples.zh: 带轮助行器零件检验将握把表面与批准材料样品比较。

examples.en: Before accepting a revised grip surface on the crutches, engineering and quality should review the proposed material and finish requirements and record approval of the updated sample.
examples.zh: 接受拐杖修改后的握把表面前，工程与质量部门应评审材料及表面要求，并记录更新样品的批准。

examples.en: Please demonstrate the nursing bed controls today.
examples.zh: 请今天演示护理床控制器。

examples.en: The nursing bed quotation includes its accessories.
examples.zh: 护理床报价包含其配件。

examples.en: Our nursing bed sample review checks the motor configuration against the approved component list.
examples.zh: 护理床样品评审按批准零件清单检查电机配置。

examples.en: Please confirm nursing bed packaging requirements before arranging collection of the exhibition sample.
examples.zh: 安排展会样品提货前，请确认护理床包装要求。

examples.en: If the buyer uses nursing bed instead of care bed, clarify the exact adjustment functions and accessories before assuming the alternative wording specifies a different configuration.
examples.zh: 若买方使用nursing bed而非care bed，应明确调节功能及配件，不能假定不同措辞意味着不同配置。

examples.en: Which care bed version does your customer prefer?
examples.zh: 贵客户喜欢哪种护理床版本？

examples.en: Please check the care bed order details.
examples.zh: 请核对护理床订单细节。

examples.en: Our care bed quotation identifies the control system rather than promising unspecified functions.
examples.zh: 护理床报价明确控制系统，不承诺未明确功能。

examples.en: The distributor requested care bed sample photographs before agreeing to the inspection visit.
examples.zh: 经销商同意验货访问前要求提供护理床样品照片。

examples.en: Before confirming a care bed order, we should review its intended configuration, included accessories, and approved specifications so the commercial documents describe the exact product being supplied.
examples.zh: 确认护理床订单前，应评审配置、所含配件及批准规格，确保商务文件描述实际供应产品。

examples.en: Which medical bed category does your buyer need?
examples.zh: 贵买方需要哪类医疗床？

examples.en: This hospital bed is a medical bed.
examples.zh: 这款病床属于医疗床。

examples.en: Please clarify whether the medical bed inquiry concerns home care or hospital use.
examples.zh: 请明确医疗床询价涉及居家护理还是医院使用。

examples.en: Our medical bed proposal identifies the selected model before listing its documented functions.
examples.zh: 医疗床方案先明确所选型号，再列明文件规定功能。

examples.en: When a customer requests a medical bed, confirm the intended application and product category before discussing specifications, because the general term does not establish one particular design.
examples.zh: 客户要求医疗床时，应先明确应用和产品类别，再讨论规格，因为这一通称不确定具体设计。

examples.en: This adjustable care bed has powered sections.
examples.zh: 这款可调护理床配有电动床面分区。

examples.en: Please show the adjustable care bed sample.
examples.zh: 请展示可调护理床样品。

examples.en: Our adjustable care bed quotation lists which movements are included in the proposed configuration.
examples.zh: 可调护理床报价列明拟定配置包含哪些动作。

examples.en: Please confirm adjustable care bed dimensions before approving the customer showroom delivery plan.
examples.zh: 批准客户展厅交付计划前，请确认可调护理床尺寸。

examples.en: If the adjustable care bed requires a different control arrangement, engineering should review the proposed components and operating limits before sales confirms that the requested changes are feasible.
examples.zh: 若可调护理床需要不同控制方案，工程部门应评估拟用零件及操作限制，再由销售确认修改可行性。

zh: 床面平台；bed platform的常见替代表达

examples.en: Please inspect the hospital bed deck surface.
examples.zh: 请检查病床床面平台表面。

examples.en: The care bed deck has separate sections.
examples.zh: 护理床床面平台分为多个区段。

examples.en: Our hospital bed drawing identifies the bed deck interfaces with the support frame.
examples.zh: 病床图纸明确床面平台与支撑车架的接口。

examples.en: Please email bed deck material requirements before we prepare the nursing bed proposal.
examples.zh: 准备护理床方案前，请邮件发送床面平台材料要求。

examples.en: If your hospital bed specification uses bed deck instead of bed platform, confirm the drawing reference and required dimensions so both parties discuss the same structural assembly.
examples.zh: 若病床规格使用bed deck而非bed platform，应确认图纸编号及所需尺寸，使双方讨论相同结构组件。

examples.en: Please check the hospital bed back section.
examples.zh: 请检查病床床面背部区段。

examples.en: The back section matches this care bed drawing.
examples.zh: 背部区段符合这份护理床图纸。

examples.en: Our nursing bed inspection records identify the back section movement checked against the specification.
examples.zh: 护理床检验记录注明按规格检查的背部区段动作。

examples.en: The buyer needs back section dimensions before reviewing the hospital bed accessory arrangement.
examples.zh: 买方评审病床配件方案前，需要背部区段尺寸。

examples.en: Before changing the back section on the care bed, engineering must review the related mechanism and required documentation so the revised assembly does not rely on outdated specifications.
examples.zh: 变更护理床背部区段前，工程部门必须评审相关机构和所需文件，避免修改组件依赖过时规格。

examples.en: Please identify the care bed knee section.
examples.zh: 请确认护理床膝部区段。

examples.en: The hospital bed knee section needs inspection.
examples.zh: 病床膝部区段需要检验。

examples.en: Our drawing review checks the knee section dimensions and interfaces on the nursing bed.
examples.zh: 图纸评审检查护理床膝部区段尺寸及接口。

examples.en: Please describe the knee section movement concern when emailing the hospital bed service team.
examples.zh: 给病床服务团队发邮件时，请描述膝部区段动作问题。

examples.en: If the knee section arrangement differs between care bed versions, the order documents must identify the correct configuration before the supplier produces or packs the relevant components.
examples.zh: 若不同护理床版本的膝部区段结构不同，供应商制作或包装相关零件前，订单文件必须明确正确配置。

zh: 床头或床尾端板；需明确位置

examples.en: Please identify the required bed end panel.
examples.zh: 请确认所需床端板。

examples.en: This hospital bed end panel needs approval.
examples.zh: 这块病床端板需要批准。

examples.en: Our care bed quotation distinguishes each bed end panel by its mounting position.
examples.zh: 护理床报价按安装位置区分各床端板。

examples.en: Please confirm whether the requested bed end panel is the hospital bed headboard or footboard.
examples.zh: 请确认所需床端板是病床床头板还是床尾板。

examples.en: Before ordering a replacement bed end panel for the nursing bed, verify its position and attachment details so the supplier does not dispatch a similar but incompatible version.
examples.zh: 订购护理床替换端板前，应核实位置和连接细节，避免供应商发运相似但不兼容的版本。

examples.en: Please check the hospital bed patient handset.
examples.zh: 请检查病床患者手控器。

examples.en: This patient handset matches the care bed configuration.
examples.zh: 这款患者手控器匹配护理床配置。

examples.en: Our care bed service review needs the patient handset label and connector photographs.
examples.zh: 护理床服务评审需要患者手控器标签及连接器照片。

examples.en: Please confirm patient handset functions before approving the hospital bed specification for production.
examples.zh: 批准病床生产规格前，请确认患者手控器功能。

examples.en: If the patient handset changes on the nursing bed, engineering should assess compatibility with the complete control system before authorizing the replacement in the component list.
examples.zh: 若护理床患者手控器变更，工程部门应评估与整套控制系统的兼容性，再授权修改零件清单。

examples.en: The care bed pendant has labeled buttons.
examples.zh: 护理床悬挂式手控器有标注按钮。

examples.en: Please photograph the hospital bed pendant connector.
examples.zh: 请拍摄病床悬挂式手控器连接器。

examples.en: Our nursing bed quotation identifies the bed pendant supplied with the selected control system.
examples.zh: 护理床报价注明所选控制系统配供的悬挂式手控器。

examples.en: The service team needs bed pendant identification before assessing the hospital bed control concern.
examples.zh: 服务团队评估病床控制问题前，需要手控器标识。

examples.en: Before supplying a different bed pendant for the hospital bed, confirm the approved part number and electrical interface rather than assuming matching button symbols establish compatibility.
examples.zh: 为病床供应不同悬挂式手控器前，应确认批准零件号及电气接口，不能认为按钮图标相同即可兼容。

examples.en: Please inspect the hospital bed side rail latch.
examples.zh: 请检查病床护栏锁扣。

examples.en: This side rail latch needs component identification.
examples.zh: 这个护栏锁扣需要确认零件标识。

examples.en: Our care bed inspection checklist includes the specified side rail latch operation checks.
examples.zh: 护理床检验表包含规定的护栏锁扣操作检查。

examples.en: Please send side rail latch photographs with the affected nursing bed serial number.
examples.zh: 请发送护栏锁扣照片及受影响护理床序列号。

examples.en: If a side rail latch concern affects several hospital beds, quality staff should review batch records and the reported symptoms before proposing a documented corrective action plan.
examples.zh: 若护栏锁扣问题涉及多台病床，质量人员应核查批次记录及症状，再提出有记录的纠正措施计划。

examples.en: Please check the nursing bed caster label.
examples.zh: 请核对护理床脚轮标签。

examples.en: The hospital bed caster has a brake.
examples.zh: 病床脚轮配有制动器。

examples.en: Our hospital bed caster specification includes mounting dimensions and the required operating checks.
examples.zh: 病床脚轮规格包含安装尺寸及所需操作检查。

examples.en: Please identify the bed caster version before placing the nursing bed spare parts order.
examples.zh: 下达护理床备件订单前，请确认床用脚轮版本。

examples.en: When comparing a bed caster proposal for the hospital bed, check the complete mounting and braking arrangement rather than choosing an alternative solely because its wheel diameter matches.
examples.zh: 比较病床脚轮方案时，应检查完整安装及制动结构，不能仅因轮径一致就选择替代件。

examples.en: These underarm crutches come in matched pairs.
examples.zh: 这款腋拐成对供应。

examples.en: Please inspect the underarm crutches sample first.
examples.zh: 请先检查腋拐样品。

examples.en: The buyer used underarm crutches instead of axillary crutches in the inquiry.
examples.zh: 买方在询价中使用underarm crutches而非axillary crutches。

examples.en: Please confirm underarm crutches adjustment positions before approving the factory sample for production.
examples.zh: 批准工厂量产样品前，请确认腋拐调节档位。

examples.en: If your distributor requests underarm crutches in several sizes, we should identify each version and agree the labeling and packing arrangements before confirming the final order.
examples.zh: 若经销商要求多种尺寸腋拐，应明确各版本，并约定标签和包装安排，再确认最终订单。

examples.en: These elbow crutches have molded forearm cuffs.
examples.zh: 这款肘拐配有成型前臂托。

examples.en: Which elbow crutches size does your buyer require?
examples.zh: 贵买方需要哪种肘拐尺寸？

examples.en: Our elbow crutches offer identifies the selected cuff and handgrip design clearly.
examples.zh: 肘拐报价明确注明所选前臂托及握把设计。

examples.en: Please email elbow crutches packaging instructions before the approved production batch is packed.
examples.zh: 批准生产批次包装前，请邮件发送肘拐包装要求。

examples.en: Before comparing elbow crutches and underarm crutches, clarify the customer's required product type, because the alternative names refer to different structures rather than interchangeable versions of one item.
examples.zh: 比较肘拐与腋拐前，应明确客户所需类型，因为这些名称指不同结构，并非同一产品可随意互换的版本。

zh: 手杖；walking cane的常见替代表达

examples.en: This walking stick has an adjustable shaft.
examples.zh: 这款手杖的杖杆高度可调。

examples.en: Please confirm the walking stick handle style.
examples.zh: 请确认手杖手柄款式。

examples.en: Our walking stick sample review includes the specified tip and handle attachment details.
examples.zh: 手杖样品评审包括规定脚垫及手柄连接细节。

examples.en: The distributor asked whether walking stick refers to the same product as walking cane.
examples.zh: 经销商询问walking stick是否指与walking cane相同的产品。

examples.en: If the buyer uses walking stick as a general description, confirm the actual cane design and specification before issuing a quotation for the approved product configuration.
examples.zh: 若买方宽泛使用walking stick，应明确实际手杖设计及规格，再按批准产品配置签发报价。

examples.en: Please check the walking cane tip condition.
examples.zh: 请检查手杖脚垫状况。

examples.en: This cane tip matches the specified shaft.
examples.zh: 这款手杖脚垫匹配规定杖杆。

examples.en: Our walking cane inspection compares cane tip dimensions with the approved component drawing.
examples.zh: 手杖检验按批准零件图检查脚垫尺寸。

examples.en: Please identify the cane tip material when requesting a replacement walking cane accessory.
examples.zh: 要求替换手杖配件时，请确认脚垫材料。

examples.en: If a customer reports premature cane tip wear, collect the walking cane identification and photographs before assessing the case against the approved specification and applicable warranty terms.
examples.zh: 客户反馈手杖脚垫过早磨损时，应先收集产品标识及照片，再根据批准规格和适用保修条款评估。

zh: 拐杖底部脚套；常见英式用语

examples.en: Please inspect the crutch ferrule dimensions today.
examples.zh: 请今天检查拐杖脚套尺寸。

examples.en: This crutch ferrule matches the approved sample.
examples.zh: 这款拐杖脚套与批准样品一致。

examples.en: Our crutch ferrule quotation identifies the interface dimensions required for the specified crutches.
examples.zh: 拐杖脚套报价注明指定拐杖所需接口尺寸。

examples.en: The buyer uses crutch ferrule when asking about replacement rubber tips for crutches.
examples.zh: 买方询问拐杖替换橡胶脚垫时使用crutch ferrule。

examples.en: Before supplying a different crutch ferrule, engineering should check the approved material and fitting requirements so the replacement is not selected only by its external appearance.
examples.zh: 供应其他拐杖脚套前，工程部门应核对批准材料及配合要求，避免只按外观选择替换件。

examples.en: Please review the crutch grip surface finish.
examples.zh: 请评审拐杖握把表面效果。

examples.en: The crutch grip drawing needs customer approval.
examples.zh: 拐杖握把图纸需要客户批准。

examples.en: Our forearm crutches sample review checks the crutch grip dimensions against the specification.
examples.zh: 肘拐样品评审按规格检查握把尺寸。

examples.en: Please photograph the crutch grip attachment when reporting the affected crutches batch.
examples.zh: 反馈受影响拐杖批次时，请拍摄握把连接处。

examples.en: If your buyer requests a softer crutch grip, we should review the material requirements and proposed sample before accepting the change in the final crutches production specification.
examples.zh: 若买方要求更软的拐杖握把，应先评审材料要求和拟定样品，再接受修改最终生产规格。

zh: 前臂托；在肘拐语境使用

examples.en: This arm cuff fits the specified forearm crutches.
examples.zh: 这款前臂托匹配指定肘拐。

examples.en: Please confirm the crutches arm cuff size.
examples.zh: 请确认拐杖前臂托尺寸。

examples.en: The arm cuff supplier must follow the approved drawing for the forearm crutches.
examples.zh: 前臂托供应商必须遵循批准的肘拐图纸。

examples.en: Our inspection report records arm cuff findings separately from the crutch tip measurements.
examples.zh: 检验报告将前臂托结果与拐杖脚垫测量分开记录。

examples.en: Before accepting a revised arm cuff on the forearm crutches, engineering should review the intended fit and attachment details and approve the updated component inspection requirements.
examples.zh: 接受肘拐修改后的前臂托前，工程部门应评审配合及连接细节，并批准更新零件检验要求。

zh: 调节按钮；不一定等同独立调节销

examples.en: Please check the walker adjustment button movement.
examples.zh: 请检查助行架调节按钮动作。

examples.en: The crutch adjustment button needs clear identification.
examples.zh: 拐杖调节按钮需要明确标识。

examples.en: Our walking cane drawing identifies the adjustment button mechanism and approved component revision.
examples.zh: 手杖图纸注明调节按钮机构及批准零件版次。

examples.en: Please send adjustment button photographs before requesting replacement parts for the walker.
examples.zh: 要求助行器替换零件前，请发送调节按钮照片。

examples.en: If a buyer calls the crutch locking part an adjustment button, clarify the exact mechanism and component number before assuming it is identical to a separate adjustment pin.
examples.zh: 若买方将拐杖锁止件称为调节按钮，应先明确机构及零件号，不假定其等同独立调节销。

examples.en: Please identify the wheelchair frame tubing specification.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅车架管材规格。

examples.en: The walker frame tubing awaits incoming inspection.
examples.zh: 助行器车架管材正等待来料检验。

examples.en: Our hospital bed purchase request includes the approved frame tubing material and dimensions.
examples.zh: 病床采购申请包含批准的车架管材材料和尺寸。

examples.en: Please retain frame tubing batch details when preparing the patient lift traceability records.
examples.zh: 准备移位机追溯记录时，请保留车架管材批次细节。

examples.en: Before changing the frame tubing supplier for the crutches, purchasing must obtain the required engineering and quality approvals for the material specification and applicable inspection evidence.
examples.zh: 更换拐杖车架管材供应商前，采购必须取得材料规范及适用检验证据所需的工程和质量批准。

examples.en: Please review the wheelchair frame coating sample.
examples.zh: 请评审轮椅车架涂层样品。

examples.en: This walker frame coating needs color approval.
examples.zh: 这款助行器车架涂层需要颜色批准。

examples.en: Our hospital bed inspection compares frame coating appearance with the approved finish reference.
examples.zh: 病床检验按批准表面基准比较车架涂层外观。

examples.en: Please describe the frame coating concern when emailing patient lift batch photographs.
examples.zh: 邮件发送移位机批次照片时，请描述车架涂层问题。

examples.en: If the frame coating process changes on the care bed, the supplier must obtain approval for the revised requirements before producing parts intended for the customer's confirmed order.
examples.zh: 若护理床车架涂层工艺变更，供应商必须先取得修订要求的批准，再为客户确认订单制作零件。

examples.en: Please confirm the hospital bed product dimensions.
examples.zh: 请确认病床产品尺寸。

examples.en: The wheelchair brochure lists its product dimensions.
examples.zh: 轮椅宣传册列明产品尺寸。

examples.en: Our patient lift quotation distinguishes product dimensions from the measurements of the shipping carton.
examples.zh: 移位机报价区分产品尺寸与运输外箱尺寸。

examples.en: Please state the measurement units when sending walker product dimensions to your purchasing team.
examples.zh: 向采购团队发送助行器产品尺寸时，请注明测量单位。

examples.en: Before comparing product dimensions for the care beds, confirm the measurement points and configuration so folded, assembled, and packaged measurements are not treated as the same information.
examples.zh: 比较护理床产品尺寸前，应确认测量点和配置，避免将折叠、装配及包装尺寸当作同一信息。

zh: 包装后尺寸；不同于产品折叠尺寸

examples.en: Please check the manual wheelchair packed dimensions.
examples.zh: 请检查手动轮椅包装后尺寸。

examples.en: The walker packed dimensions include protective packaging.
examples.zh: 助行器包装后尺寸包含防护包装。

examples.en: Our care bed freight estimate uses packed dimensions rather than the assembled bed dimensions.
examples.zh: 护理床运费估算采用包装后尺寸，而非整床装配尺寸。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift packed dimensions after the final carton arrangement is approved.
examples.zh: 最终装箱方案获批后，请确认移位机包装后尺寸。

examples.en: If your buyer requests additional protection for the hospital bed, we should review the packed dimensions and weight again before confirming the shipment volume and freight estimate.
examples.zh: 若买方要求病床增加防护，应重新核查包装后尺寸及重量，再确认货物体积和运费估算。

examples.en: Please send the sales quote for these walkers.
examples.zh: 请发送这批助行器销售报价。

examples.en: The wheelchair sales quote needs a revision.
examples.zh: 轮椅销售报价需要修订。

examples.en: Our patient lift sales quote identifies the selected sling and agreed delivery basis.
examples.zh: 移位机销售报价注明所选吊带及约定交付依据。

examples.en: Please compare the care bed sales quote with the approved configuration before ordering.
examples.zh: 下单前，请将护理床销售报价与批准配置比较。

examples.en: If the buyer requests a lower sales quote for the hospital beds, we should review quantities and included items before considering an authorized revision to the commercial offer.
examples.zh: 若买方要求降低病床销售报价，应先评估数量和所含项目，再考虑获授权的商务报价修改。

examples.en: Please review our price offer for crutches.
examples.zh: 请评审我们的拐杖价格方案。

examples.en: This wheelchair price offer excludes international freight.
examples.zh: 这份轮椅价格报价不含国际运费。

examples.en: Our care bed price offer is based on the configuration identified in the attachment.
examples.zh: 护理床价格方案基于附件注明的配置。

examples.en: Please state the patient lift quantity when requesting an updated price offer by email.
examples.zh: 邮件要求更新价格方案时，请说明移位机数量。

examples.en: Before accepting the walker price offer, confirm its validity, included items, and delivery terms so the agreed transaction is not based only on a headline unit price.
examples.zh: 接受助行器价格方案前，应确认有效期、所含项目和交付条款，不能仅按表面单价达成交易。

examples.en: Please review the hospital bed commercial offer.
examples.zh: 请评审病床商务报价方案。

examples.en: Our walker commercial offer includes payment terms.
examples.zh: 助行器商务报价方案包含付款条件。

examples.en: The wheelchair commercial offer should define the product package and price validity clearly.
examples.zh: 轮椅商务报价方案应明确定义整套产品及价格有效期。

examples.en: Please identify requested changes before we revise the patient lift commercial offer.
examples.zh: 修改移位机商务报价前，请明确所要求变更。

examples.en: If your distributor compares our care bed commercial offer with another supplier's proposal, both parties should check the same configuration, accessories, delivery basis, and written warranty terms.
examples.zh: 若经销商将护理床商务报价与其他供应商方案比较，双方应核对同样的配置、配件、交付依据及书面保修条款。

examples.en: Please send an itemized quotation for wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请发送逐项列明的轮椅报价单。

examples.en: The care bed itemized quotation lists accessories.
examples.zh: 护理床逐项报价单列明配件。

examples.en: Our patient lift itemized quotation separates the equipment, sling, and additional packaging charges.
examples.zh: 移位机逐项报价单区分设备、吊带及额外包装费用。

examples.en: Please use the itemized quotation to identify which walker costs your buyer wants reviewed.
examples.zh: 请用逐项报价明确买方希望评估哪些助行器费用。

examples.en: Before comparing the hospital bed itemized quotation with a single-price offer, confirm that every required component and service is included so the comparison reflects the complete purchase.
examples.zh: 比较病床逐项报价与整包价格前，应确认包含每个所需零件和服务，确保比较反映完整采购内容。

examples.en: Please explain the wheelchair price breakdown today.
examples.zh: 请今天解释轮椅价格明细。

examples.en: Our walker price breakdown separates packaging charges.
examples.zh: 助行器价格明细单列包装费用。

examples.en: The care bed price breakdown identifies the options that change the proposed unit price.
examples.zh: 护理床价格明细注明影响拟定单价的选项。

examples.en: Please review the patient lift price breakdown before requesting a further discount.
examples.zh: 要求进一步折扣前，请评审移位机价格明细。

examples.en: If the buyer disputes the hospital bed price breakdown, we should review the agreed configuration and included services together before proposing any change to the authorized offer.
examples.zh: 若买方对病床价格明细有异议，应共同评审约定配置及所含服务，再提出修改授权报价。

examples.en: What unit price applies to these walkers?
examples.zh: 这批助行器适用什么单价？

examples.en: The wheelchair unit price excludes extra accessories.
examples.zh: 轮椅单价不含额外配件。

examples.en: Our patient lift unit price depends on the confirmed configuration and order quantity.
examples.zh: 移位机单价取决于确认配置及订单数量。

examples.en: Please compare hospital bed unit price figures using the same delivery and packaging terms.
examples.zh: 请按相同交付和包装条款比较病床单价。

examples.en: Before accepting a lower care bed unit price, check whether the quoted configuration, included accessories, and warranty terms remain equivalent to the package originally reviewed by your team.
examples.zh: 接受更低护理床单价前，应确认所报配置、所含配件和保修条款仍等同贵团队原评审方案。

examples.en: Please confirm the total wheelchair order value.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅订单总金额。

examples.en: The care bed order value has changed.
examples.zh: 护理床订单金额已变更。

examples.en: Our patient lift order value includes the accessories identified in the approved quotation.
examples.zh: 移位机订单金额包含批准报价列明的配件。

examples.en: Please check walker quantities and unit prices before confirming the revised order value.
examples.zh: 确认修改订单金额前，请核查助行器数量和单价。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order value changes after a configuration revision, both parties should approve the updated commercial documents before purchasing commits to the affected components.
examples.zh: 若配置修订后病床订单金额变化，双方应先批准更新商务文件，再由采购承诺受影响零件的采购。

examples.en: What target price do you have for wheelchairs?
examples.zh: 您的轮椅目标价格是多少？

examples.en: Please share your target price for walkers.
examples.zh: 请告知助行器目标价格。

examples.en: We can review the patient lift target price after confirming the required accessory package.
examples.zh: 确认所需配件包后，可评估移位机目标价格。

examples.en: Please state the delivery basis when discussing your hospital bed target price.
examples.zh: 讨论病床目标价格时，请说明交付依据。

examples.en: If the requested care bed target price is below our current offer, we should review specifications and order volume before deciding whether an approved alternative can meet your budget.
examples.zh: 若护理床目标价低于现有报价，应先评估规格和采购量，再判断获批替代方案能否满足预算。

examples.en: What budget range covers your wheelchair purchase?
examples.zh: 您的轮椅采购预算区间是多少？

examples.en: Please confirm the walker sample budget range.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器样品预算区间。

examples.en: Our patient lift proposal can be reviewed against your budget range once requirements are clear.
examples.zh: 需求明确后，可按预算区间评审移位机方案。

examples.en: Please clarify whether your care bed budget range includes freight and local import costs.
examples.zh: 请明确护理床预算是否包含运费及当地进口费用。

examples.en: Before suggesting a hospital bed within your budget range, we should confirm the required functions and cost assumptions so a cheaper configuration does not omit a necessary item.
examples.zh: 建议预算内病床前，应确认所需功能和费用假设，避免较低价配置漏掉必要项目。

examples.en: Can we discuss a volume discount for walkers?
examples.zh: 可以讨论助行器采购量折扣吗？

examples.en: The wheelchair volume discount needs commercial approval.
examples.zh: 轮椅采购量折扣需要商务批准。

examples.en: We can assess a patient lift volume discount after reviewing the confirmed purchasing plan.
examples.zh: 评审确认采购计划后，可以评估移位机采购量折扣。

examples.en: Please provide care bed quantities by configuration before requesting a volume discount.
examples.zh: 要求采购量折扣前，请按配置提供护理床数量。

examples.en: If the distributor requests a hospital bed volume discount based on annual demand, we should distinguish a forecast from a confirmed commitment before approving revised pricing.
examples.zh: 若经销商按年度需求要求病床量价折扣，应区分预测与已确认承诺，再批准修改价格。

examples.en: Please review the quantity discount for crutches.
examples.zh: 请评估拐杖数量折扣。

examples.en: Does this wheelchair quantity discount require standard packaging?
examples.zh: 这项轮椅数量折扣要求标准包装吗？

examples.en: Our care bed quantity discount proposal identifies the order level and applicable configuration.
examples.zh: 护理床数量折扣方案注明订单档位及适用配置。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift quantities before we seek approval for a quantity discount.
examples.zh: 申请数量折扣批准前，请确认移位机数量。

examples.en: Before accepting the walker quantity discount, check the required order size and included items so the buyer understands exactly which conditions apply to the revised offer.
examples.zh: 接受助行器数量折扣前，应核对所需订单量及所含项目，让买方明确修改报价适用条件。

examples.en: The hospital bed price revision needs approval.
examples.zh: 病床价格调整需要批准。

examples.en: Please explain the wheelchair price revision clearly.
examples.zh: 请清楚说明轮椅价格调整。

examples.en: Our patient lift price revision follows the approved changes to the accessory package.
examples.zh: 移位机价格调整依据配件包获批的变更。

examples.en: Please identify the affected walker quotation before requesting a price revision by email.
examples.zh: 邮件要求调价前，请确认受影响的助行器报价。

examples.en: If the care bed price revision changes the agreed order value, both parties should confirm the updated documents in writing before treating the new price as effective.
examples.zh: 若护理床调价改变约定订单金额，双方应先书面确认更新文件，再将新价格视为生效。

examples.en: Please check the walker quotation validity period.
examples.zh: 请检查助行器报价有效期。

examples.en: The wheelchair quotation validity ends on the stated date.
examples.zh: 轮椅报价有效期截至所列日期。

examples.en: Our patient lift quotation validity is stated alongside the proposed configuration and payment terms.
examples.zh: 移位机报价有效期与拟定配置及付款条款一同列明。

examples.en: Please reconfirm care bed quotation validity if the buyer changes the intended order date.
examples.zh: 若买方修改拟定下单日期，请重新确认护理床报价有效性。

examples.en: Before accepting a hospital bed order after the quotation validity period, sales should review current costs and availability rather than assuming the previous commercial offer still applies.
examples.zh: 报价过期后接受病床订单前，销售应评估当前成本及可供情况，不能假定原商务报价仍适用。

examples.en: Please note the wheelchair offer expiry date.
examples.zh: 请留意轮椅报价到期日。

examples.en: The care bed offer expiry date is approaching.
examples.zh: 护理床报价到期日临近。

examples.en: Our patient lift follow-up email reminds the buyer of the stated offer expiry date.
examples.zh: 移位机跟进邮件提醒买方注意所列报价到期日。

examples.en: Please request a fresh walker quotation if approval comes after the offer expiry date.
examples.zh: 若批准时间晚于到期日，请索取新助行器报价。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer cannot decide before the offer expiry date, we can review whether an extension is commercially acceptable and confirm any approved change in writing.
examples.zh: 若病床买方无法在报价到期前决定，可以评估是否接受延期，并书面确认获批变更。

zh: 到岸综合成本；所含项目须说明

examples.en: Please define the wheelchair landed cost calculation.
examples.zh: 请明确轮椅到岸综合成本算法。

examples.en: Our walker quotation is not a landed cost estimate.
examples.zh: 我们的助行器报价不是到岸综合成本估算。

examples.en: The care bed landed cost comparison should identify freight, duties, and other included charges.
examples.zh: 护理床到岸成本比较应明确运费、关税及其他所含费用。

examples.en: Please confirm the destination before discussing landed cost for the patient lift shipment.
examples.zh: 讨论移位机到岸综合成本前，请确认目的地。

examples.en: When comparing hospital bed landed cost estimates, check the delivery basis and local charge assumptions so a supplier's product price is not mistaken for the total import expense.
examples.zh: 比较病床到岸综合成本估算时，应核对交付依据和当地费用假设，不能把供应商产品价误当进口总支出。

zh: 价格计算依据或所采用贸易条件

examples.en: Please confirm the walker quotation price basis.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器报价价格依据。

examples.en: The wheelchair price basis affects freight responsibility.
examples.zh: 轮椅价格依据影响运费责任。

examples.en: Our hospital bed price basis is stated explicitly in the approved commercial offer.
examples.zh: 病床价格依据在批准商务报价中明确列出。

examples.en: Please use the same price basis when comparing patient lift quotations from suppliers.
examples.zh: 比较供应商移位机报价时，请采用相同价格依据。

examples.en: Before negotiating the care bed price, confirm the price basis and named delivery location so both parties understand which transport costs and responsibilities are included in the offer.
examples.zh: 谈判护理床价格前，应确认价格依据及指定交付地点，让双方了解报价包含哪些运输费用及责任。

examples.en: Please confirm the hospital bed delivery terms.
examples.zh: 请确认病床交付条款。

examples.en: The walker offer states its delivery terms.
examples.zh: 助行器报价说明交付条款。

examples.en: Our patient lift delivery terms identify the agreed delivery basis and named location.
examples.zh: 移位机交付条款注明约定交付依据及指定地点。

examples.en: Please compare wheelchair delivery terms before deciding which quotation has the lower total cost.
examples.zh: 判断哪份报价总成本更低前，请比较轮椅交付条款。

examples.en: If the buyer changes the care bed delivery terms after approval, logistics and sales must review the revised responsibilities and costs before accepting the amendment in writing.
examples.zh: 若买方在批准后修改护理床交付条款，物流和销售必须评估责任及费用变化，再书面接受修改。

zh: 运输相关条款；不等于全部付款条款

examples.en: Please review the wheelchair shipping terms carefully.
examples.zh: 请仔细评审轮椅运输条款。

examples.en: Our care bed shipping terms need clarification.
examples.zh: 护理床运输条款需要明确。

examples.en: The patient lift shipping terms should explain the agreed freight and collection arrangements.
examples.zh: 移位机运输条款应解释约定运费及提货安排。

examples.en: Please confirm walker shipping terms separately from the proposed payment schedule in your email.
examples.zh: 请在邮件中将助行器运输条款与拟定付款安排分别确认。

examples.en: Before agreeing to revised hospital bed shipping terms, both parties should identify the affected transport responsibilities and documentation requirements rather than assuming the product quotation covers every logistics service.
examples.zh: 同意修改病床运输条款前，双方应明确受影响的运输责任及文件要求，不能假定产品报价包含所有物流服务。

zh: 预付款；具体比例按约定

examples.en: The walker order requires the agreed upfront payment.
examples.zh: 助行器订单需要支付约定预付款。

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair upfront payment amount.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅预付款金额。

examples.en: Our patient lift offer defines when the upfront payment is due under the agreement.
examples.zh: 移位机报价按协议明确预付款到期时间。

examples.en: Please send the care bed payment reference after arranging the approved upfront payment.
examples.zh: 安排批准的护理床预付款后，请发送付款参考信息。

examples.en: Before confirming the hospital bed production start, we must verify the upfront payment status and required technical approvals according to the terms accepted by both parties.
examples.zh: 确认病床开工前，必须按照双方接受的条款核实预付款状态及所需技术批准。

examples.en: Please arrange the agreed advance payment for wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请安排约定的轮椅预付款。

examples.en: The care bed advance payment is pending.
examples.zh: 护理床预付款尚待支付。

examples.en: Our walker order record identifies the advance payment conditions accepted by the buyer.
examples.zh: 助行器订单记录明确买方接受的预付款条件。

examples.en: Please distinguish patient lift advance payment remittance from confirmed receipt of funds.
examples.zh: 请区分移位机预付款汇出与款项确认到账。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer asks to begin production before the advance payment arrives, sales must obtain the required commercial authorization instead of assuming the exception is approved.
examples.zh: 若病床买方要求预付款到账前开工，销售必须取得所需商务授权，不能假定例外已获批准。

zh: 首付款；通常指总额的一部分

examples.en: Please confirm the down payment for walkers.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器首付款。

examples.en: The wheelchair down payment follows our agreement.
examples.zh: 轮椅首付款按双方协议执行。

examples.en: Our care bed quotation states the down payment amount and remaining payment arrangement.
examples.zh: 护理床报价列明首付款金额及剩余付款安排。

examples.en: Please email the patient lift down payment reference so finance can reconcile the transaction.
examples.zh: 请邮件发送移位机首付款参考信息，方便财务核对交易。

examples.en: Before changing the hospital bed down payment conditions, the authorized commercial team should review the buyer's request and confirm any revised agreement in the order documents.
examples.zh: 修改病床首付款条件前，授权商务团队应评估买方要求，并在订单文件中确认修订协议。

examples.en: Please confirm the remaining payment for these wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请确认这批轮椅剩余应付款。

examples.en: The care bed remaining payment needs reconciliation.
examples.zh: 护理床剩余应付款需要核对。

examples.en: Our patient lift follow-up email identifies the remaining payment and agreed due date.
examples.zh: 移位机跟进邮件注明剩余应付款及约定到期日。

examples.en: Please check walker order amendments before calculating the remaining payment for the shipment.
examples.zh: 计算出货剩余应付款前，请核查助行器订单修改。

examples.en: If the hospital bed remaining payment differs from the buyer's calculation, finance and sales should reconcile the approved order changes before requesting a corrected payment amount.
examples.zh: 若病床剩余应付款与买方计算不同，财务和销售应核对批准的订单变更，再要求更正付款金额。

examples.en: Please review the outstanding payment for care beds.
examples.zh: 请核查护理床尚未支付款项。

examples.en: The wheelchair outstanding payment is still pending.
examples.zh: 轮椅尚未支付款项仍待处理。

examples.en: Our walker payment reminder identifies the outstanding payment without changing the agreed terms.
examples.zh: 助行器付款提醒注明未付款项，不改变约定条款。

examples.en: Please send the patient lift remittance details when settling the outstanding payment.
examples.zh: 结清移位机未付款项时，请发送汇款详情。

examples.en: Before linking the hospital bed outstanding payment to shipment release, confirm the agreed payment terms and any authorized exception so the buyer receives a consistent commercial explanation.
examples.zh: 将病床未付款项与出货放行关联前，应确认约定付款条款及授权例外，确保对买方的商务解释一致。

examples.en: Please settle the agreed unpaid balance for walkers.
examples.zh: 请结清助行器约定未付余额。

examples.en: Our wheelchair record shows an unpaid balance.
examples.zh: 轮椅记录显示尚有未付余额。

examples.en: The patient lift statement identifies the unpaid balance after the recorded advance payment.
examples.zh: 移位机对账单注明已记录预付款后的未付余额。

examples.en: Please review the care bed unpaid balance against the latest approved commercial documents.
examples.zh: 请按最新批准商务文件核查护理床未付余额。

examples.en: If the hospital bed unpaid balance remains unresolved, the authorized team should review the account and agreed shipment conditions before making any exception to the documented payment arrangement.
examples.zh: 若病床未付余额仍未解决，授权团队应评估账户及约定出货条件，再对书面付款安排作出例外处理。

examples.en: What is the wheelchair payment due date?
examples.zh: 轮椅付款到期日是哪天？

examples.en: Please confirm the care bed payment due date.
examples.zh: 请确认护理床付款到期日。

examples.en: Our patient lift order confirmation states the payment due date accepted by both parties.
examples.zh: 移位机订单确认书列明双方接受的付款到期日。

examples.en: Please notify finance if the walker buyer requests a different payment due date.
examples.zh: 若助行器买方要求更改付款到期日，请通知财务。

examples.en: Before accepting a revised payment due date for the hospital beds, the authorized commercial team should assess the request and record the approved change in writing.
examples.zh: 接受病床修订付款到期日前，授权商务团队应评估要求，并书面记录获批准的变更。

zh: 付款确认；须区分汇出与到账

examples.en: Please send payment confirmation for the walker order.
examples.zh: 请发送助行器订单付款确认。

examples.en: The wheelchair payment confirmation needs finance review.
examples.zh: 轮椅付款确认需要财务核查。

examples.en: Our care bed production update distinguishes payment confirmation from specification approval status.
examples.zh: 护理床生产更新区分付款确认与规格批准状态。

examples.en: Please clarify whether the patient lift payment confirmation means remittance or actual receipt.
examples.zh: 请明确移位机付款确认指汇出还是实际到账。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer sends payment confirmation, finance should reconcile the transaction and confirm its status before sales treats the agreed payment condition as satisfied.
examples.zh: 若病床买方发送付款确认，财务应核对交易并确认状态，再由销售认定约定付款条件已满足。

examples.en: Please email remittance advice for the wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请邮件发送轮椅汇款通知。

examples.en: The walker remittance advice includes a reference.
examples.zh: 助行器汇款通知包含参考编号。

examples.en: Our care bed finance team uses remittance advice to help identify the incoming payment.
examples.zh: 护理床财务团队利用汇款通知辅助识别来款。

examples.en: Please include the patient lift order number when sending remittance advice by email.
examples.zh: 邮件发送汇款通知时，请附上移位机订单号。

examples.en: Although the buyer has supplied remittance advice for the hospital beds, finance must still confirm the transaction status before the payment is recorded as received.
examples.zh: 即使买方已提供病床汇款通知，财务仍须确认交易状态，才能将付款记录为已收到。

examples.en: The walker buyer prefers a bank transfer.
examples.zh: 助行器买方希望采用银行转账。

examples.en: Please identify the wheelchair bank transfer reference.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅银行转账参考信息。

examples.en: Our care bed payment instructions describe the bank transfer arrangement approved for the order.
examples.zh: 护理床付款说明描述订单批准的银行转账安排。

examples.en: Please use the verified recipient information when arranging the patient lift bank transfer.
examples.zh: 安排移位机银行转账时，请使用已核实收款人资料。

examples.en: Before treating the hospital bed bank transfer as received, finance should reconcile the amount and reference against the approved order so any difference can be resolved accurately.
examples.zh: 将病床银行转账视为到账前，财务应按批准订单核对金额和参考信息，以准确解决差异。

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair wire transfer reference.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅电汇参考信息。

examples.en: The care bed wire transfer is being reconciled.
examples.zh: 护理床电汇正在核对。

examples.en: Our patient lift payment reminder refers to the wire transfer terms accepted in writing.
examples.zh: 移位机付款提醒依据书面接受的电汇条款。

examples.en: Please send the walker order number with your wire transfer remittance notice.
examples.zh: 发送电汇汇款通知时，请附上助行器订单号。

examples.en: If a wire transfer for the hospital beds arrives with a different reference or amount, finance should investigate the discrepancy before allocating the funds to the order.
examples.zh: 若病床电汇到账参考信息或金额不同，财务应先调查差异，再将款项分配至该订单。

examples.en: Please include the walker payment reference today.
examples.zh: 请今天附上助行器付款参考信息。

examples.en: The wheelchair payment reference helps finance reconciliation.
examples.zh: 轮椅付款参考信息有助于财务核对。

examples.en: Our care bed statement lists the payment reference associated with each recorded transaction.
examples.zh: 护理床对账单列明每笔已记录交易的付款参考信息。

examples.en: Please confirm the patient lift payment reference if the remittance covers several orders.
examples.zh: 若汇款涉及多笔订单，请确认移位机付款参考信息。

examples.en: When one transfer covers hospital beds and wheelchairs, clear payment reference information helps finance allocate the funds correctly and identify any remaining amount due on each order.
examples.zh: 一笔转账涵盖病床和轮椅时，明确付款参考信息有助于财务正确分配款项，识别各订单剩余应付款。

zh: 付款凭证；不一定等于到账确认

examples.en: Please send proof of payment for walkers.
examples.zh: 请发送助行器付款凭证。

examples.en: The wheelchair proof of payment needs verification.
examples.zh: 轮椅付款凭证需要核实。

examples.en: Our finance team reviews care bed proof of payment alongside the actual transaction records.
examples.zh: 财务团队结合实际交易记录核查护理床付款凭证。

examples.en: Please identify the patient lift order when sharing proof of payment with sales.
examples.zh: 向销售提供付款凭证时，请注明移位机订单。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer provides proof of payment, we should acknowledge the document while explaining that finance must confirm receipt before updating the order's payment status.
examples.zh: 若病床买方提供付款凭证，应确认收到文件，同时说明财务须核实到账后才能更新订单付款状态。

examples.en: Please clarify bank charges for the wheelchair payment.
examples.zh: 请明确轮椅付款的银行费用。

examples.en: The walker agreement addresses the applicable bank charges.
examples.zh: 助行器协议约定适用银行费用。

examples.en: Our care bed payment terms should explain responsibility for the agreed bank charges.
examples.zh: 护理床付款条款应说明约定银行费用的承担责任。

examples.en: Please review patient lift bank charges if the received amount differs from the invoice.
examples.zh: 若实收金额与发票不同，请核查移位机银行费用。

examples.en: Before requesting an additional hospital bed payment, finance should check whether bank charges explain the difference and apply the fee allocation accepted in the commercial agreement.
examples.zh: 要求病床补付款前，财务应检查差额是否由银行费用产生，并采用商务协议接受的费用分配方式。

examples.en: Please identify the transaction fees for these walkers.
examples.zh: 请确认这批助行器的交易手续费。

examples.en: The wheelchair payment includes recorded transaction fees.
examples.zh: 轮椅付款包含已记录交易手续费。

examples.en: Our care bed commercial discussion should distinguish transaction fees from the equipment price.
examples.zh: 护理床商务讨论应区分交易手续费与设备价格。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift transaction fees before comparing two proposed payment methods.
examples.zh: 比较两种付款方式前，请确认移位机交易手续费。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer proposes a payment method with different transaction fees, both parties should agree the cost allocation before accepting the revised payment arrangement.
examples.zh: 若病床买方提出交易手续费不同的付款方式，双方应先约定费用分配，再接受修改的付款安排。

zh: 销售订单；不等于买方采购订单

examples.en: Please check the hospital bed sales order.
examples.zh: 请核查病床销售订单。

examples.en: The walker sales order needs technical approval.
examples.zh: 助行器销售订单需要技术批准。

examples.en: Our wheelchair sales order reflects the buyer's approved requirements and accepted commercial offer.
examples.zh: 轮椅销售订单体现买方批准要求及接受的商务报价。

examples.en: Please reconcile the patient lift sales order with the customer's purchase order.
examples.zh: 请将移位机销售订单与客户采购订单核对。

examples.en: If the care bed sales order and buyer purchase order contain different specifications, the discrepancy must be resolved before purchasing releases components or production schedules the affected configuration.
examples.zh: 若护理床销售订单与买方采购订单规格不同，采购下达零件或生产排定配置前必须解决差异。

examples.en: Please review the wheelchair order amendment first.
examples.zh: 请先评审轮椅订单修改。

examples.en: The care bed order amendment needs approval.
examples.zh: 护理床订单修改需要批准。

examples.en: Our patient lift order amendment identifies the changed accessories and revised total price.
examples.zh: 移位机订单修改注明变更配件及修订总价。

examples.en: Please send the walker order amendment in writing before planning changes its schedule.
examples.zh: 计划部门修改排期前，请书面发送助行器订单修改。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order amendment affects components already purchased, we should assess the technical and commercial consequences before accepting the revised requirements and confirming a new schedule.
examples.zh: 若病床订单修改涉及已采购零件，应评估技术和商务影响，再接受修订要求并确认新排期。

examples.en: Please send the revised purchase order for walkers.
examples.zh: 请发送修订后的助行器采购订单。

examples.en: The wheelchair revised purchase order needs checking.
examples.zh: 修订后的轮椅采购订单需要核查。

examples.en: Our care bed team will compare the revised purchase order with the approved change request.
examples.zh: 护理床团队会将修订采购订单与批准变更申请比较。

examples.en: Please identify superseded patient lift quantities in the revised purchase order clearly.
examples.zh: 请在修订采购订单中明确注明已被替代的移位机数量。

examples.en: Before processing the revised purchase order for hospital beds, both parties should confirm which earlier terms remain valid and which quantities, specifications, or dates have changed.
examples.zh: 处理修订病床采购订单前，双方应确认哪些原条款仍有效，以及哪些数量、规格或日期已变更。

examples.en: What order quantity do you need for walkers?
examples.zh: 您需要多少助行器订单量？

examples.en: The wheelchair order quantity affects our quotation.
examples.zh: 轮椅订单数量影响报价。

examples.en: Our patient lift proposal specifies the order quantity for each selected accessory package.
examples.zh: 移位机方案列明各所选配件包的订单数量。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed order quantity by configuration before requesting an updated production schedule.
examples.zh: 要求更新生产排期前，请按配置确认护理床订单数量。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order quantity increases after approval, planning must review materials and available capacity before sales commits to the same completion date for the additional units.
examples.zh: 若病床订单批准后增量，计划部门必须评估物料及可用产能，再由销售承诺新增数量同日完工。

examples.en: Please share your annual purchasing volume for wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请告知轮椅年度采购量。

examples.en: The walker annual purchasing volume is a forecast.
examples.zh: 助行器年度采购量目前是预测。

examples.en: We can review care bed pricing after understanding the proposed annual purchasing volume.
examples.zh: 了解拟定年度采购量后，可评估护理床价格。

examples.en: Please distinguish patient lift annual purchasing volume forecasts from confirmed purchase orders.
examples.zh: 请区分移位机年度采购量预测与已确认采购订单。

examples.en: Before offering hospital bed pricing based on annual purchasing volume, the commercial team should define the qualifying conditions and avoid treating an uncommitted forecast as a guaranteed order.
examples.zh: 按年度采购量提供病床价格前，商务团队应明确适用条件，不将未承诺预测视为保证订单。

examples.en: Would you prefer a trial order for walkers?
examples.zh: 您希望先做一笔助行器试单吗？

examples.en: The wheelchair trial order uses standard packaging.
examples.zh: 轮椅试单采用标准包装。

examples.en: Our patient lift trial order proposal identifies the configuration and sample approval requirements.
examples.zh: 移位机试单方案注明配置及样品批准要求。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed trial order objectives before discussing quantities and delivery arrangements.
examples.zh: 讨论数量和交付安排前，请确认护理床试单目标。

examples.en: If your distributor places a hospital bed trial order, we should agree the evaluation scope and commercial terms without assuming that successful review automatically guarantees future purchase volumes.
examples.zh: 若经销商下病床试单，应约定评估范围及商务条款，不假定评审成功就自动保证未来采购量。

zh: 试行订单；具体用途需确认

examples.en: Please explain the wheelchair pilot order objectives.
examples.zh: 请说明轮椅试行订单目标。

examples.en: The care bed pilot order needs planning review.
examples.zh: 护理床试行订单需要计划评审。

examples.en: Our walker pilot order can support the agreed evaluation of packaging and product configuration.
examples.zh: 助行器试行订单可支持约定的包装及产品配置评估。

examples.en: Please distinguish patient lift pilot order requirements from those of a normal repeat shipment.
examples.zh: 请区分移位机试行订单要求与常规重复出货要求。

examples.en: Before accepting a hospital bed pilot order, both parties should agree what will be evaluated and who approves the results before any decision about regular supply.
examples.zh: 接受病床试行订单前，双方应约定评估内容及结果批准人，再决定是否转入常规供货。

examples.en: Please confirm the repeat order for these walkers.
examples.zh: 请确认这款助行器重复订单。

examples.en: The wheelchair repeat order has new artwork.
examples.zh: 轮椅重复订单采用新设计稿。

examples.en: Our care bed repeat order review checks whether the approved configuration remains unchanged.
examples.zh: 护理床重复订单评审核查批准配置是否保持不变。

examples.en: Please identify any patient lift accessory changes when placing the repeat order.
examples.zh: 下重复订单时，请明确移位机配件的任何变更。

examples.en: Although the hospital bed buyer describes this as a repeat order, we must check current specifications, prices, and delivery requirements rather than copying previous commercial documents without review.
examples.zh: 即使买方称其为病床重复订单，仍须核查现行规格、价格和交付要求，不能未经评审照抄原商务文件。

examples.en: Please review the wheelchair replenishment order today.
examples.zh: 请今天评审轮椅补货订单。

examples.en: The walker replenishment order includes several sizes.
examples.zh: 助行器补货订单包含多种尺寸。

examples.en: Our care bed replenishment order proposal follows the distributor's confirmed configuration requirements.
examples.zh: 护理床补货订单方案遵循经销商确认的配置要求。

examples.en: Please compare patient lift stock levels before confirming the next replenishment order.
examples.zh: 确认下笔补货订单前，请比较移位机库存水平。

examples.en: If the hospital bed replenishment order requires a different component revision, we should review the approved change before assuming the new shipment is identical to the customer's existing stock.
examples.zh: 若病床补货订单需要不同零件版次，应先评审批准变更，不假定新货与客户现有库存完全相同。

examples.en: What initial order quantity suits your wheelchair launch?
examples.zh: 哪种首单数量适合贵方轮椅上市？

examples.en: The walker initial order needs sample approval.
examples.zh: 助行器首笔订单需要样品批准。

examples.en: Our patient lift initial order discussion covers training documents and the included accessory package.
examples.zh: 移位机首单讨论涵盖培训文件及所含配件包。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed initial order requirements before we prepare the final offer.
examples.zh: 准备最终报价前，请确认护理床首单要求。

examples.en: Before placing the hospital bed initial order, the distributor should review product documentation and agree the selected configuration so the first shipment supports the intended market introduction.
examples.zh: 下病床首单前，经销商应评审产品文件并约定所选配置，使首批出货支持预期市场导入。

examples.en: Please confirm the patient lift sample order.
examples.zh: 请确认移位机样品订单。

examples.en: The wheelchair sample order includes its charger.
examples.zh: 轮椅样品订单包含充电器。

examples.en: Our care bed sample order identifies whether custom labeling is required for review.
examples.zh: 护理床样品订单明确是否需要定制标签供评审。

examples.en: Please approve walker sample order details before arranging the proposed exhibition delivery.
examples.zh: 安排拟定展会交付前，请批准助行器样品订单细节。

examples.en: If the hospital bed sample order uses a configuration different from the planned production order, both parties should record the differences before evaluating the sample as representative.
examples.zh: 若病床样品订单配置不同于拟量产订单，双方应先记录差异，再评估样品是否具有代表性。

examples.en: Please confirm the sample charge for walkers.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器样品费。

examples.en: The wheelchair sample charge excludes freight here.
examples.zh: 此处轮椅样品费不含运费。

examples.en: Our patient lift offer identifies the sample charge and any separately quoted delivery costs.
examples.zh: 移位机报价注明样品费及单独报价的交付费用。

examples.en: Please check care bed sample charge conditions before assuming the amount is refundable.
examples.zh: 认为样品费可退还前，请核查护理床样品费条件。

examples.en: Before accepting the hospital bed sample charge, clarify what the fee includes and whether any credit toward a future order has been approved in the written agreement.
examples.zh: 接受病床样品费前，应明确费用包含内容，以及书面协议是否批准抵扣未来订单。

zh: 工装或模具费用；范围须约定

examples.en: Please review the walker tooling cost proposal.
examples.zh: 请评估助行器工装费用方案。

examples.en: The wheelchair tooling cost needs separate approval.
examples.zh: 轮椅工装费用需要单独批准。

examples.en: Our care bed tooling cost estimate identifies the proposed fixture or mold work.
examples.zh: 护理床工装费用估算明确拟开展的夹具或模具工作。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift tooling cost responsibilities before authorizing the supplier's development activities.
examples.zh: 授权供应商开发前，请确认移位机工装费用责任。

examples.en: If a hospital bed design change requires additional tooling cost, both parties should approve the scope, ownership arrangements, and commercial treatment before the supplier starts the work.
examples.zh: 若病床设计变更需要额外工装费用，双方应先批准范围、所有权安排及商务处理，再由供应商开工。

zh: 开机或设置费用；具体项目须说明

examples.en: Please explain the wheelchair setup charge today.
examples.zh: 请今天解释轮椅设置费用。

examples.en: The walker setup charge covers an agreed activity.
examples.zh: 助行器设置费对应约定活动。

examples.en: Our care bed quotation states whether the setup charge applies to the first batch only.
examples.zh: 护理床报价说明设置费是否仅适用于首批。

examples.en: Please identify patient lift setup charge items before comparing the revised supplier offers.
examples.zh: 比较修改的供应商报价前，请明确移位机设置费项目。

examples.en: Before accepting a hospital bed setup charge, confirm the activity covered and how repeat orders will be treated so the buyer does not assume an undefined recurring fee.
examples.zh: 接受病床设置费前，应确认所涵盖活动及重复订单处理，避免买方承担未定义的经常性费用。

examples.en: Please review the care bed development fee.
examples.zh: 请评审核理床开发费。

examples.en: The wheelchair development fee requires written agreement.
examples.zh: 轮椅开发费需要书面约定。

examples.en: Our patient lift development fee proposal separates engineering activities from production unit pricing.
examples.zh: 移位机开发费方案区分工程活动与量产单价。

examples.en: Please confirm walker development fee milestones before approving the supplier's proposed design work.
examples.zh: 批准供应商设计工作前，请确认助行器开发费节点。

examples.en: If the hospital bed project scope changes, both parties should review the development fee and deliverables before engineering accepts additional work outside the previously approved agreement.
examples.zh: 若病床项目范围改变，双方应先评估开发费和交付成果，再由工程接受原批准协议之外的额外工作。

examples.en: Please complete artwork approval for the walkers.
examples.zh: 请完成助行器设计稿批准。

examples.en: The wheelchair artwork approval is still pending.
examples.zh: 轮椅设计稿仍待批准。

examples.en: Our care bed packing schedule depends on artwork approval for the custom cartons.
examples.zh: 护理床包装排期取决于定制外箱设计稿获批。

examples.en: Please record patient lift artwork approval before the printer produces labels for the order.
examples.zh: 印厂制作订单标签前，请记录移位机设计稿批准。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer changes the artwork after artwork approval, we must review printing status and obtain approval for the revised version before applying it to production.
examples.zh: 若病床买方在设计稿批准后改稿，必须评估印刷状态，并取得修订版本批准后再用于生产。

examples.en: Please confirm logo approval for the wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅标志图稿批准。

examples.en: The walker logo approval needs written evidence.
examples.zh: 助行器标志图稿批准需要书面证据。

examples.en: Our patient lift branding record identifies the artwork version covered by logo approval.
examples.zh: 移位机品牌记录注明标志批准涉及的图稿版本。

examples.en: Please obtain care bed logo approval before ordering the branded label production batch.
examples.zh: 订购品牌标签生产批次前，请取得护理床标志批准。

examples.en: Before printing the hospital bed cartons, check that logo approval covers the current artwork and placement so an earlier approval is not applied to a later unreviewed design.
examples.zh: 印刷病床外箱前，应确认标志批准涵盖现行图稿及位置，避免原批准被用于后续未经审核设计。

examples.en: The walker packaging approval is still pending.
examples.zh: 助行器包装仍待批准。

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair packaging approval today.
examples.zh: 请今天确认轮椅包装批准。

examples.en: Our care bed packaging approval record includes the carton arrangement and protective materials.
examples.zh: 护理床包装批准记录包含装箱方式及防护材料。

examples.en: Please resolve patient lift label questions before issuing the final packaging approval.
examples.zh: 签发最终包装批准前，请解决移位机标签问题。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer requests extra protection after packaging approval, the revised arrangement should be reviewed for dimensions, cost, and documentation before regular packing begins.
examples.zh: 若病床买方在包装批准后要求增加防护，开始常规包装前应评审修订方案的尺寸、费用及文件。

examples.en: Please send the walker label artwork today.
examples.zh: 请今天发送助行器标签设计稿。

examples.en: The wheelchair label artwork needs a revision.
examples.zh: 轮椅标签设计稿需要修订。

examples.en: Our patient lift label artwork review checks model identification against the approved configuration.
examples.zh: 移位机标签设计稿评审核对型号标识是否匹配批准配置。

examples.en: Please approve care bed label artwork before the supplier prints the required labels.
examples.zh: 供应商印刷所需标签前，请批准护理床标签设计稿。

examples.en: Before applying revised label artwork to the hospital beds, the responsible reviewer should confirm the approved text and model identification so production does not use unreviewed product claims.
examples.zh: 病床采用修订标签设计稿前，责任审核人员应确认批准文字及型号标识，避免生产使用未经评审的产品声明。

examples.en: Please review the manual wheelchair carton artwork.
examples.zh: 请评审手动轮椅外箱设计稿。

examples.en: The walker carton artwork needs buyer approval.
examples.zh: 助行器外箱设计稿需要买方批准。

examples.en: Our care bed carton artwork includes the shipping marks approved for the order.
examples.zh: 护理床外箱设计稿包含订单批准的运输唛头。

examples.en: Please check patient lift carton artwork against the final packaging dimensions before printing.
examples.zh: 印刷前，请按最终包装尺寸核对移位机外箱设计稿。

examples.en: If the hospital bed carton artwork changes after printing starts, purchasing must confirm the disposition of existing cartons and obtain approval for the revised version before further production.
examples.zh: 若病床外箱开印后改稿，采购必须确认现有外箱处置，并取得修订版本批准后再继续生产。

examples.en: Does your wheelchair order use your own brand?
examples.zh: 您的轮椅订单采用自有品牌吗？

examples.en: Please send own brand artwork for walkers.
examples.zh: 请发送助行器自有品牌设计稿。

examples.en: Our care bed own brand discussion covers approved labeling, packaging, and documentation responsibilities.
examples.zh: 护理床自有品牌讨论涵盖批准标签、包装及文件责任。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift own brand requirements before requesting the final sample quotation.
examples.zh: 要求最终样品报价前，请确认移位机自有品牌要求。

examples.en: Before supplying hospital beds under your own brand, both parties should agree the approved product identity and document responsibilities so branding does not create unsupported regulatory or performance statements.
examples.zh: 以贵方自有品牌供应病床前，双方应约定批准产品身份及文件责任，避免品牌形成无依据的法规或性能声明。

examples.en: Please describe customer branding for the wheelchair order.
examples.zh: 请说明轮椅订单客户品牌方案。

examples.en: The walker customer branding artwork is pending.
examples.zh: 助行器客户品牌设计稿尚待提供。

examples.en: Our patient lift customer branding review includes the logo location and approved label text.
examples.zh: 移位机客户品牌评审包括标志位置及批准标签文字。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed customer branding before ordering the custom packaging materials.
examples.zh: 订购定制包装材料前，请确认护理床客户品牌方案。

examples.en: If customer branding changes the hospital bed documentation or labels, the responsible reviewer must approve the revised materials before sales authorizes printing for the confirmed order.
examples.zh: 若客户品牌方案改变病床文件或标签，销售授权确认订单印刷前，责任审核人员必须批准修订材料。

examples.en: These walkers require approved branded packaging.
examples.zh: 这批助行器需要批准的品牌包装。

examples.en: The wheelchair branded packaging sample is ready.
examples.zh: 轮椅品牌包装样品已备妥。

examples.en: Our care bed quotation identifies any separate charges for the requested branded packaging.
examples.zh: 护理床报价注明所需品牌包装的额外费用。

examples.en: Please inspect patient lift branded packaging before confirming the first production packing run.
examples.zh: 确认首次量产包装前，请检查移位机品牌包装。

examples.en: Before approving branded packaging for the hospital beds, check the product identification, carton arrangement, and approved artwork together so visual branding does not obscure required product information.
examples.zh: 批准病床品牌包装前，应共同核查产品标识、装箱方式及批准图稿，避免视觉品牌遮挡所需产品信息。

zh: 交付周期；须约定起止条件

examples.en: Please confirm the delivery lead time for wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅交付周期。

examples.en: The walker delivery lead time needs review.
examples.zh: 助行器交付周期需要评估。

examples.en: Our care bed offer defines the starting conditions for the quoted delivery lead time.
examples.zh: 护理床报价定义所报交付周期的起算条件。

examples.en: Please clarify whether patient lift delivery lead time includes transit to the named destination.
examples.zh: 请明确移位机交付周期是否包含至指定目的地的运输。

examples.en: Before agreeing to the hospital bed delivery lead time, both parties should define the beginning and end of the period so factory completion is not confused with customer receipt.
examples.zh: 同意病床交付周期前，双方应定义周期起止点，避免把工厂完工与客户收货混淆。

zh: 制造周期；不默认包含运输

examples.en: What manufacturing lead time applies to these walkers?
examples.zh: 这批助行器适用多久制造周期？

examples.en: The wheelchair manufacturing lead time excludes sea transit.
examples.zh: 轮椅制造周期不含海运。

examples.en: Our care bed manufacturing lead time estimate depends on approved specifications and component readiness.
examples.zh: 护理床制造周期估计取决于批准规格及零件齐备情况。

examples.en: Please review patient lift manufacturing lead time before selecting the proposed collection date.
examples.zh: 选择拟定提货日期前，请评估移位机制造周期。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order needs a new component revision, we should assess purchasing and verification activities before confirming the manufacturing lead time for the revised configuration.
examples.zh: 若病床订单需要新零件版次，应先评估采购及验证活动，再确认修订配置的制造周期。

zh: 订单处理完成周期；范围须说明

examples.en: Please define order turnaround time for these wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请定义这批轮椅的订单完成周期。

examples.en: The walker order turnaround time is still estimated.
examples.zh: 助行器订单完成周期仍为估计。

examples.en: Our patient lift email states which approval and production activities order turnaround time includes.
examples.zh: 移位机邮件说明订单完成周期包括哪些批准和生产活动。

examples.en: Please distinguish care bed order turnaround time from international transit when discussing the schedule.
examples.zh: 讨论排期时，请区分护理床订单完成周期与国际运输。

examples.en: When the hospital bed buyer asks about order turnaround time, clarify the measured start and finish events before answering, because customers may use the phrase for different process scopes.
examples.zh: 病床买方询问订单完成周期时，应先明确所指起止事件，因为客户可能用该表达指不同流程范围。

zh: 生产周转周期；须明确统计口径

examples.en: Please review production turnaround for the walker batch.
examples.zh: 请评估这批助行器的生产周转周期。

examples.en: Wheelchair production turnaround depends on the approved plan.
examples.zh: 轮椅生产周转取决于批准计划。

examples.en: Our care bed production turnaround update identifies the activities included in the estimate.
examples.zh: 护理床生产周转更新明确估计包含的活动。

examples.en: Please confirm the patient lift production turnaround definition before comparing performance between batches.
examples.zh: 比较批次表现前，请确认移位机生产周转周期定义。

examples.en: If you compare hospital bed production turnaround figures, use the same measurement boundaries and configuration assumptions so shorter reported time does not simply exclude inspection or required approval activities.
examples.zh: 比较病床生产周转数据时，应采用相同测量边界和配置假设，避免较短时间只是排除了检验或所需批准活动。

examples.en: What delivery window suits your wheelchair launch?
examples.zh: 哪段交付时间适合贵方轮椅上市？

examples.en: Please confirm the walker delivery window first.
examples.zh: 请先确认助行器交付时间区间。

examples.en: Our care bed proposal identifies the planned delivery window and its underlying assumptions.
examples.zh: 护理床方案注明计划交付区间及其基础假设。

examples.en: Please clarify the destination when discussing the patient lift delivery window with logistics.
examples.zh: 与物流讨论移位机交付区间时，请明确目的地。

examples.en: Before accepting the hospital bed delivery window, planning and logistics should review the production and transport assumptions so the range describes a realistic delivery period rather than an unsupported promise.
examples.zh: 接受病床交付区间前，计划及物流部门应评估生产和运输假设，使其反映合理时间，而非无依据承诺。

examples.en: Please review the dispatch window for these walkers.
examples.zh: 请评估这批助行器的发货时间区间。

examples.en: The wheelchair dispatch window needs buyer confirmation.
examples.zh: 轮椅发货区间需要买方确认。

examples.en: Our patient lift dispatch window depends on release approval and the agreed collection arrangement.
examples.zh: 移位机发货区间取决于放行批准和约定提货安排。

examples.en: Please distinguish the care bed dispatch window from estimated arrival at the overseas port.
examples.zh: 请区分护理床发货时间区间与海外港口预计到达时间。

examples.en: If the hospital bed dispatch window changes after booking, logistics should coordinate the revised collection plan and notify the buyer before the forwarder confirms its transport arrangements.
examples.zh: 若病床订舱后发货区间变化，物流应协调修改提货计划，并在货代确认运输安排前通知买方。

zh: 发运日期；须明确指离厂还是承运发运

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair shipping date today.
examples.zh: 请今天确认轮椅发运日期。

examples.en: The walker shipping date is still provisional.
examples.zh: 助行器发运日期仍暂定。

examples.en: Our patient lift email explains whether shipping date means factory dispatch or vessel departure.
examples.zh: 移位机邮件说明发运日期指离厂还是船舶出发。

examples.en: Please obtain the latest care bed shipping date from the responsible logistics contact.
examples.zh: 请向责任物流联系人取得护理床最新发运日期。

examples.en: Before using the hospital bed shipping date in a customer commitment, confirm the event and location it describes so factory collection is not mistaken for international vessel departure.
examples.zh: 将病床发运日期用于客户承诺前，应确认所指事件和地点，避免将工厂提货误作国际船舶出发。

examples.en: Please clarify the arrival date for these wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请明确这批轮椅的抵达日期。

examples.en: The walker arrival date depends on transport updates.
examples.zh: 助行器抵达日期取决于运输更新。

examples.en: Our care bed schedule distinguishes port arrival date from delivery to the customer's warehouse.
examples.zh: 护理床排期区分港口抵达日期与客户仓库交付。

examples.en: Please specify the patient lift destination when requesting a revised arrival date estimate.
examples.zh: 要求修改预计抵达日时，请注明移位机目的地。

examples.en: If the hospital bed arrival date changes, logistics should identify whether the update concerns the destination port or final delivery point before communicating its effect to the buyer.
examples.zh: 若病床抵达日期变化，物流应先明确涉及目的港还是最终交付点，再向买方说明影响。

examples.en: Please confirm the walker ex-factory date first.
examples.zh: 请先确认助行器离厂日期。

examples.en: The wheelchair ex-factory date is not its ETA.
examples.zh: 轮椅离厂日期不等于预计抵达时间。

examples.en: Our care bed ex-factory date estimate includes the required release and collection preparation activities.
examples.zh: 护理床离厂日期估计包含所需放行及提货准备活动。

examples.en: Please review patient lift booking deadlines against the proposed ex-factory date before committing.
examples.zh: 作出承诺前，请按拟定离厂日期核查移位机订舱截止时间。

examples.en: Before confirming the hospital bed ex-factory date, check the inspection status and authorized collection plan so production completion alone is not treated as evidence that dispatch is ready.
examples.zh: 确认病床离厂日期前，应核查检验状态及授权提货计划，不能仅以生产完工作为具备发货条件的证据。

zh: 已具备发货条件；仍须核对授权

examples.en: These walkers are ready for dispatch today.
examples.zh: 这批助行器今天已具备发货条件。

examples.en: Are the patient lifts ready for dispatch?
examples.zh: 这批移位机具备发货条件了吗？

examples.en: Our wheelchair update states which approved units are ready for dispatch under the agreed arrangement.
examples.zh: 轮椅更新说明哪些批准设备按约定安排具备发货条件。

examples.en: Please verify care bed release records before describing the packed units as ready for dispatch.
examples.zh: 将已包装设备称为可发货前，请核查护理床放行记录。

examples.en: If the hospital beds are ready for dispatch but collection is postponed, logistics should confirm the revised arrangement and keep the buyer informed about any resulting storage or booking implications.
examples.zh: 若病床已可发货但提货延后，物流应确认修改安排，并告知买方由此产生的仓储或订舱影响。

zh: 可供发运；数量及状态须核实

examples.en: How many wheelchairs are available to ship?
examples.zh: 有多少轮椅可供发运？

examples.en: These walkers are not yet available to ship.
examples.zh: 这批助行器尚不能发运。

examples.en: Our care bed stock report identifies quantities available to ship after the required release review.
examples.zh: 护理床库存报告明确完成所需放行评审后可发运数量。

examples.en: Please confirm patient lift configuration before quoting units described as available to ship.
examples.zh: 报价所谓可发运设备前，请确认移位机配置。

examples.en: Before telling the buyer that hospital beds are available to ship, verify the specific quantities, release status, and allocation so another customer's reserved stock is not promised accidentally.
examples.zh: 告知买方病床可发运前，应核实数量、放行状态及分配，避免误将其他客户预留库存作出承诺。

examples.en: Please reserve an approved wheelchair production slot.
examples.zh: 请预留获批准的轮椅生产档期。

examples.en: The walker production slot needs planning confirmation.
examples.zh: 助行器生产档期需要计划确认。

examples.en: Our patient lift production slot review considers component readiness and existing confirmed commitments.
examples.zh: 移位机档期评估考虑零件齐备情况及现有确认承诺。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed specifications before asking planning to allocate a production slot.
examples.zh: 要求计划分配生产档期前，请确认护理床规格。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order changes after a production slot is assigned, planning must assess the impact on resources before promising that the original manufacturing window remains available.
examples.zh: 若病床订单在分配档期后变化，计划部门必须评估资源影响，再承诺原制造时间段仍可使用。

examples.en: Which manufacturing slot suits the walker order?
examples.zh: 哪段制造档期适合助行器订单？

examples.en: The wheelchair manufacturing slot is provisionally allocated.
examples.zh: 轮椅制造档期已暂时分配。

examples.en: Our care bed manufacturing slot depends on the approved component plan and available resources.
examples.zh: 护理床制造档期取决于批准零件计划及可用资源。

examples.en: Please obtain patient lift planning approval before presenting the manufacturing slot as confirmed.
examples.zh: 将档期表述为已确认前，请取得移位机计划批准。

examples.en: Before moving the hospital bed order to an earlier manufacturing slot, review material readiness and existing commitments so the change is approved rather than assumed from an empty calendar entry.
examples.zh: 将病床订单移至更早制造档期前，应评估物料齐备及现有承诺，不能因日历空白就假定变更获准。

zh: 尚未完成或结清的订单

examples.en: Please review the open order for these walkers.
examples.zh: 请评估这批助行器未完成订单。

examples.en: The wheelchair open order includes remaining quantities.
examples.zh: 轮椅未完成订单包含剩余数量。

examples.en: Our care bed open order report separates completed deliveries from quantities still awaiting production.
examples.zh: 护理床未完成订单报告区分已交付与待生产数量。

examples.en: Please identify why the patient lift order remains an open order in the system.
examples.zh: 请说明该移位机订单为何在系统中仍未完成。

examples.en: If the hospital bed buyer refers to an open order, confirm whether the outstanding issue concerns production, shipment, or payment before proposing the appropriate follow-up action.
examples.zh: 若病床买方提到未完成订单，应先明确未结事项涉及生产、出货还是付款，再提出相应跟进措施。

zh: 待处理订单；须说明等待事项

examples.en: Why is the wheelchair order a pending order?
examples.zh: 这笔轮椅订单为何处于待处理状态？

examples.en: The walker pending order awaits artwork approval.
examples.zh: 助行器待处理订单正等待设计稿批准。

examples.en: Our patient lift pending order update identifies the approval or information still required.
examples.zh: 移位机待处理订单更新明确仍需的批准或信息。

examples.en: Please resolve the care bed pending order questions before procurement releases component purchases.
examples.zh: 采购下达零件采购前，请解决护理床待处理订单问题。

examples.en: Before committing a delivery date for the hospital bed pending order, clarify the unresolved conditions and obtain the necessary approvals so the estimate is based on confirmed requirements.
examples.zh: 对病床待处理订单承诺交付日期前，应明确未解决条件并取得必要批准，使估计基于确认要求。

examples.en: Please confirm the wheelchair order outstanding quantity.
examples.zh: 请确认轮椅订单尚未交付数量。

examples.en: The walker outstanding quantity needs a revised schedule.
examples.zh: 助行器未交付数量需要修订排期。

examples.en: Our care bed shipment update records the outstanding quantity after the approved partial delivery.
examples.zh: 护理床出货更新记录获批部分交付后的未交数量。

examples.en: Please reconcile patient lift outstanding quantity with the latest dispatch and acceptance records.
examples.zh: 请按最新发货和接收记录核对移位机未交数量。

examples.en: If the hospital bed outstanding quantity differs between the buyer's records and our report, logistics should reconcile the shipment documents before proposing a revised completion or delivery plan.
examples.zh: 若病床未交数量在买方记录与我方报告间不同，物流应先核对出货文件，再提出修改完成或交付计划。

zh: 剩余数量；须说明所指环节

examples.en: Please identify the walker order remaining quantity.
examples.zh: 请确认助行器订单剩余数量。

examples.en: The wheelchair remaining quantity awaits final inspection.
examples.zh: 轮椅剩余数量正等待最终检验。

examples.en: Our patient lift update states whether remaining quantity means unfinished units or unshipped units.
examples.zh: 移位机更新说明剩余数量指未完工还是未出货设备。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed remaining quantity before approving the next proposed collection booking.
examples.zh: 批准下一次拟定提货订运前，请确认护理床剩余数量。

examples.en: When reporting the hospital bed remaining quantity, identify the process stage and order reference so the buyer does not confuse stock awaiting inspection with units already released for shipment.
examples.zh: 报告病床剩余数量时，应明确工序阶段及订单编号，避免买方将待检库存与已获出货放行设备混淆。

examples.en: Please review the wheelchair order backlog today.
examples.zh: 请今天评估轮椅积压订单。

examples.en: Our walker order backlog needs updated priorities.
examples.zh: 助行器积压订单需要更新优先级。

examples.en: The care bed order backlog report includes confirmed demand not yet fully completed.
examples.zh: 护理床积压订单报告包含尚未完全完成的确认需求。

examples.en: Please consider patient lift order backlog when estimating the next available production slot.
examples.zh: 估算下个可用档期时，请考虑移位机积压订单。

examples.en: If the hospital bed order backlog increases, planning should assess capacity and material constraints before accepting additional delivery commitments that would conflict with existing approved customer schedules.
examples.zh: 若病床积压订单增加，计划部门应评估产能及物料限制，再接受可能与现有批准客户排期冲突的额外交付承诺。

zh: 库存可供情况；不等于全部现有库存

examples.en: Please check stock availability for these wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 请检查这批轮椅库存可供情况。

examples.en: The walker stock availability report needs updating.
examples.zh: 助行器库存可供报告需要更新。

examples.en: Our patient lift stock availability check excludes units reserved for other confirmed orders.
examples.zh: 移位机库存可供核查不包括已为其他确认订单预留的设备。

examples.en: Please confirm care bed stock availability by configuration rather than total warehouse quantity.
examples.zh: 请按配置确认护理床可供库存，而非只看仓库总量。

examples.en: Before offering immediate delivery of hospital beds, check stock availability against release status and existing allocations so the quoted quantity represents units genuinely available for the buyer.
examples.zh: 报价病床即时交付前，应按放行状态及既有分配核查可供库存，确保所报数量确实可供该买方。

zh: 有现货；须核对配置及分配状态
